jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Company Details: The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer. Responsibilities: The Software Engineer is a mid\-level contributor responsible for gathering requirements, designing, developing, implementing, and supporting one or more company applications for various subsidiaries, transforming business requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions across the full stack and DevSecOps lifecycle. * Deliver moderately complex features and epics end\-to\-end, decomposing work, estimating, and planning for yourself and small pods while translating business goals into scalable, performant features that drive outcomes for subsidiaries. • Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to ensure solutions fully leverage technology to improve business processes. • Apply engineering best practices across the full stack, authoring comprehensive unit, integration, and contract tests and introducing performance and resiliency testing where appropriate. • Perform and enforce high\-quality peer reviews across the system, upholding and helping refine team development standards and quality expectations. • Strengthen CI/CD pipelines and release practices, including canary, blue/green, and feature flags, owning deployments to non\-production and assisting or leading production releases. • Coordinate safe rollbacks when needed and maintain deployment and runbook documentation to improve stability and supportability. • Co\-lead backlog refinement and clarify acceptance criteria while producing lightweight design specifications and API/interface contracts that reflect understanding of interfacing systems and downstream impacts. • Apply sound design patterns and make informed trade\-offs for performance, stability, and supportability, routinely proposing improvements to reduce technical debt and enhance usability. • Instrument applications with meaningful logging, metrics, and distributed traces; define and tune SLIs/SLOs and alert thresholds. • Analyze telemetry and load/performance test results to identify bottlenecks and implement targeted optimizations and reliability improvements. • Champion secure\-by\-design practices, including threat modeling, least privilege, and safe secrets management, while managing dependencies and remediating findings promptly. • Contribute to SBOM/dependency hygiene and patch planning, ensuring solutions meet internal controls and compliance requirements. • Triage, research, and resolve second\-level incidents, leading or contributing to root cause analysis and post\-mortems. • Improve operational runbooks and support procedures and participate in a rotating on\-call schedule for production systems. • Provide high\-quality support to end users and partner teams. • Lead technical spikes and proof\-of\-concepts to reduce delivery risk and evaluate tools and patterns that improve developer productivity and system reliability. • Use data and A/B experiments where appropriate to validate approaches. • Produce and maintain system\-level documentation, including design decisions, ADRs, interface specifications, and operational runbooks. • Contribute to the internal knowledge base and provide targeted end\-user or peer training in one\-on\-one and small\-group settings. • Collaborate closely with product, design, QA, and operations, actively contributing to Agile ceremonies, including planning, reviews, and retrospectives, and occasionally facilitating them. • Mentor junior developers and interns, providing guidance on development standards and code quality and modeling constructive feedback. • Deepen expertise in BRSS applications, business processes, and system interfaces while staying current on relevant frameworks and cloud/DevSecOps practices. • Set development goals with your manager, share learnings with the team, and adapt to new tools, technologies, and processes to accelerate delivery. Qualifications: **Qualifications:** * At least three years of relevant software engineering experience or equivalent demonstrated proficiency. • Advanced proficiency in front\-end and back\-end engineering, with expertise in one area and a solid foundation in the other (e.g., React/Next.js, Tailwind, Jest for front\-end; Node.js/Java and GraphQL/REST for back\-end), with the ability to design and implement significant new functionality with minimal supervision. • Proficiency in modern web application architecture and API design, including creating and interpreting design specifications and interface contracts with an understanding of interfacing systems and supported business processes. • Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to triage, research, and resolve second\-level support incidents and complex defects spanning application, middleware, and infrastructure layers. • Proficiency with databases and data integration, including SQL, Microsoft SQL Server queries, stored procedures, tables, and views, as well as working knowledge of NoSQL where applicable, with the ability to assess and tune performance and scalability. • Demonstrated competency in SDLC and Agile practices (Scrum and Kanban), including backlog refinement, estimation, code review, documentation, and unit, integration, and contract testing. • Hands\-on DevSecOps experience, including Git\-based workflows, CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, environment management, feature flags, and automated testing to support safe, reliable releases. • Security\-minded engineering with practical knowledge of secure coding, dependency and secrets management, remediation of security findings, and alignment with internal controls and compliance expectations. • Performance and reliability awareness, including the ability to instrument applications using logging, metrics, and traces; interpret performance metrics; and implement targeted optimizations to meet SLIs/SLOs before and after implementation. • Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to interact with technical and business stakeholders at all levels and translate user feedback and business needs into actionable technical improvements. • Ability to thrive with minimal supervision in a fast\-paced environment, demonstrating strong organization, time management, and prioritization skills to manage multiple concurrent tasks and deliver work on time. • Mentorship and collaboration skills, including conducting high\-quality peer reviews, guiding junior engineers on standards and quality expectations, and contributing to team patterns and best practices. • Customer service orientation and a sense of urgency when providing high\-quality support to end users and partner teams, including potential participation in rotating on\-call support for production systems. • Adaptability and commitment to continuous learning, with the ability to quickly learn new technologies, frameworks, and systems and apply them effectively to real\-world projects in the insurance domain. • Proficiency with common IDEs and platforms, including Visual Studio, VS Code, the Atlassian suite, Git source control, and collaboration tools used throughout the delivery lifecycle. • Ability to lead small technical efforts, coordinate contributions across multiple engineers, and deliver system enhancements that consider performance, stability, supportability, and long\-term maintainability. • Demonstrates WRBC core competencies, innovation behaviors, and behavioral competencies while performing essential duties and responsibilities, including accountability, communication, customer focus and teamwork, delivering results, flexibility, and technical and job excellence. • Exhibits behavioral role competencies such as being action oriented, possessing business knowledge, critical thinking, customer service orientation, managing information, process management, quality decision making, being a self\-starter, and being technically astute. **Education Requirement** * Bachelor’s degree in a software development\-related discipline, such as Computer Science, Information Systems Management, Engineering, or a similar field, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience as a full\-stack software engineer. Additional Company Details: We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting agencies or firms. Additional Requirements: Location and Travel: •Primary location Urbandale, IA. Sponsorship Details: Sponsorship not Offered for this Role

jobs.title: ASME Project Engineer
jobs.description: Full Time Experienced **Company Summary** Bio Fab Technologies (“Bio Fab” or the “Company”), headquartered in Pleasant Prairie, WI (on the WI/IL border), is a premier designer and manufacturer of high\-end customized stainless\-steel equipment and components for use in the pharmaceutical, food \& beverage and industrial markets. Founded in 2006, Bio Fab was subsequently acquired by Holland Group, a private family\-owned group of companies, in 2023\. As we continue to grow, the Company is seeking a motivated individual to fill an ASME Project Manager position. **Position Summary** Responsible for all aspects of stainless\-steel fabrication \& repairs/alteration projects designed and built to the ASME Boiler Pressure Vessel Code, Section VIII, Div. 1\. The ASME Project Engineer takes the lead in the design and development of the project from the quoting stage all the way thru equipment installation and start\-up. **Job Responsibilities:** Respond to ASME\-BPVC requests for fabrication quotes. Generate quotes to secure purchase orders. * Create Sales Orders, Order Acknowledgements, Jobs \& shipments in ERP (M1\), as needed. * Material procurement/purchasing as required for ASME projects: ferrules, couplings, sheet metal, plate, heads, tube, pipe, sanitary fittings, leveling feet etc. as required * Create ASME fabrication packages, including, but not limited to travelers, weld Logs, ASME or ASME/PED fabrication drawings, weld maps, nameplate drawings, dye penetrant forms, drain certification forms, spray ball coverage certification forms, \& surface finish certifications (Ra Maps) * ASME/PED Material Receipt for all pressure boundary material. Request updates as needed when documentation is NG or incomplete. * ASME \& PED nameplates: Create design/layout as needed, stamping as required, rolling to match OD as needed. * Schedule management for ASME Inspections thru HSB ASME/PED AI. * Manage/attend to AI visits to the shop and for off\-site visits * Create ASME Data reports for completed projects * Scan \& archive all ASME materials for completed projects, as required by the BPVC. * Create PED PMAs for each material type for every PED project. * Create PED Manufacturer's Declaration of Conformity for every PED project. * Create Certificates of Conformity for all AKBA projects * Curate materials, per job/project, so they are in 1 location, labeled clearly, \& available for fabrication * Management of ASME/PED Master Project List: status of all open projects and priority list of projects currently in the shop. * Update ASME Welder Continuity Logs: 4 logs, each updated/maintained 3x a year. * Calibrate ASME pressure gauges (4 total) vs. master, every 6 months. * Annual Master Gauge for annual calibration **Qualifications:** * Minimum B.S. in Engineering degree from an accredited university preferred but not required * Experience with ASME BPVC and stainless\-steel fabrication, machining (GD\&T) is a definite plus, but not a requirement. * ISO experience is beneficial * Ability to multi\-task, managing a wide variety of priorities simultaneously * Highly computer literate, with experience with Microsoft Office Suite programs and ERP * Experienced with CAD software, ideally AutoCad and Inventor * Excellent written \& verbal communication skills are required along with a high level of attention to detail. **Benefits** * Competitive Base Salary and annual bonus target * Company\-subsidized Health Insurance, Dental Insurance, Life/Disability Insurance (covered by company), HSA/FSA * Retirement savings plan (401k) with net 4% employer match * Industry leading profit share program * Unique schedule / summer days **About The Holland Group** * The Holland Group is a private, family\-owned (but not family\-operated) group of businesses with locations in Illinois, Wisconsin, Indiana, Massachusetts, and Pennsylvania. The family does not believe in short term ownership (i.e. buy and flip) and instead intends to build a business for decades to come built upon integrity, passion for action, and meaningful opportunity for its employees. The group prides itself on being nimble, entrepreneurial, and unencumbered by “big company” items like frequent presentations, bureaucracy, and red tape. The group deploys a best\-in\-class profit share program and is always looking for its next generation of leaders to shepherd it to future growth. While the combined group of businesses are currently \~$120M in annual sales, the Company strives to grow organically and via 1\-2 acquisitions per year to achieve \~$400M in sales by 2030\. * Current Holland Group Businesses (as of April 2024\): *Holland Applied Technologies*, *Liquid Process* *Equipment* (acquired 2020\), *Bio Fab Technologies* (acquired 2023\), *W.A. Tompkins* (acquired 2024\), *Steridos* (acquired 2025\). Bio Fab Technologies Terms and Conditions: 1\. By providing your mobile phone number and opting in, you agree to receive text messages from Bio Fab Technologies regarding your employment application and recruiting process. These messages may include: * Application confirmations * Interview invitations and scheduling * Reminders about upcoming interviews * Requests for additional application information or documents * Updates on your application status * Job offers or other employment related communications 2\. You can cancel the SMS service at any time. Just text "STOP" to the short code. After you send the SMS message "STOP" to us, we will send you an SMS message to confirm that you have been unsubscribed. After this, you will no longer receive SMS messages from us. If you want to join again, just sign up as you did the first time and we will start sending SMS messages to you again. 3\. If you are experiencing issues with the messaging program you can reply with the keyword HELP for more assistance, or you can get help directly at 262\-948\-8130\. 4\. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages 5\. As always, message and data rates may apply for any messages sent to you from us and to us from you. Message frequency may vary based on your application activity. If you have any questions about your text plan or data plan, it is best to contact your wireless provider. 6\. If you have any questions regarding privacy, please read our privacy policy below. Privacy Policy: We collect your mobile number and related opt\-in data for the delivery of SMS messages. Your mobile opt\-in data and consent will not be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (HVAR)
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Black Canyon Consulting **(BCC)** is actively looking for a mid\-level **Full Stack Developer (C\+\+)** to support our work for the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) at the National Library of Medicine (NLM), an institute of the National Institutes of Health. This opportunity is full time and onsite at the NIH\-NCBI in Bethesda, MD and/or remote work. The National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) is part of the National Library of Medicine (NLM) at the National Institutes of Health (NIH). NCBI is the world's premier biomedical center hosting over six million daily users that seek research, clinical, genetic, and other information that directly impacts biomedical research and public health – at NCBI you can literally help to accelerate cures for diseases! NCBI's wide range of applications, platforms (node, python, Django, C\+\+, you name it) and environments (big data \[petabytes], machine learning, multiple clouds) serve more users than almost any other US Government Agency according to https://analytics.usa.gov/. You will join NCBI's team of web developers and software engineers to build robust, flexible web applications, APIs, and services. This role calls for an expert web developer – with knowledge and experience in modern web development, testing, UI design and usability principles, and ability to work effectively with user researchers, designers, product managers, scientists, security and DevOps engineers ### **Role Summary** * This role focuses mainly on C\+\+ development, with significant use of Python. The developer will work on back\-end services, data pipelines, APIs, * command\-line tools, database interactions, and software that supports public\-facing NCBI variation resources. * This is not a front\-end web developer position; However, the developer should be comfortable contributing to back\-end web development. The developer * should also have experience with Python and Django web applications or be willing to learn them, especially for back\-end work. ### **Job Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain high\-performance C\+\+ programs, including public\-facing services that use RESTful APIs, gRPC, and similar technologies. * Develop and maintain internal command\-line applications and libraries written in C\+\+. * Write unit tests for C\+\+ code using or Google Test. Boost.Test * Build and support Python packages, command\-line tools, web services, and web applications with user interfaces. * Work with a variety of data sources, including relational databases, Cassandra keystores, and Solr collections. * Maintain existing web application interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. * Make sure web applications are accessible and mobile\-friendly. * Develop and maintain test suites. * Monitor applications for performance, security, and accessibility compliance. * Work closely with an agile team that shares knowledge and responsibilities. * Contribute to development standards, code reviews, and team process improvements. ### **Required Skills and Experience** * A bachelor's degree in computer science or a scientific field, such as engineering or physics, or equivalent experience. * At least three years of **professional** experience developing high\-performance programs in C\+\+. * Experience writing unit and integration tests for C\+\+ systems. * At least one year of **professional** experience developing programs or libraries in Python. * An understanding of accessibility and security compliance. * Experience with version control systems such as Git or SVN. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * The ability to work well as part of a team. ### **Desired Skills and Experience** * Experience working with Hadoop and related big data technologies. * Experience writing unit tests for Python code. * Experience developing Django web applications and services. * Experience working with JavaScript frameworks such as Angular or React. * Experience using web services and RESTful APIs. * Familiarity with search engines and back\-end technologies such as Lucene and Solr. * Experience with automated regression testing using Selenium. * Strong knowledge of Git. * Experience with agile development processes. * Strong teamwork, communication, and collaboration skills. We attract the best people in the business with our competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision coverage, 401k plan with employer contribution, paid holidays, vacation, and tuition reimbursement. If you enjoy being a part of a high performing, professional service and technology focused organization, please apply today!

jobs.title: Energy Field Engineer
jobs.description: The **Energy Field Engineer** position requires a thorough understanding of controls, AC and DC wiring, switchgear operation and application, and power generation. Candidate must be capable of working with limited supervision and guidance in a challenging environment to commission and test CAT generator set installations per customer specifications. The position requires a high level of customer communication and ability to maintain satisfactory relationship with all customers at all times. Blanchard Machinery Company is committed to fostering a high\-performance work culture with challenging work opportunities that inspire high quality results. Some of the benefits of joining our team are: * Competitive Pay. * Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401K, profit sharing, generous PTO and paid holidays, uniforms, and much more. * Exposure to world\-class CAT training and development. * A friendly and supportive work environment. * Continuous exposure to learning and new technologies * Opportunities for advancement **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Contributes to a positive work environment and promotes the vision, mission and values of BMC. * Completes all job responsibilities in a safe manner, promotes and champions a safe and healthy work environment. * Must be able to interpret, and design custom control schemes, develop schematics and operating instructions. * Must have thorough understanding of fuel systems, governing, excitation, and testing as related to engine driven power generators. * Candidate should have a well\-rounded knowledge of protection schemes and their application within electrical systems. * Must be capable of programming CAT Energy controllers, and various third party supplied controllers. * Must be able to effectively plan, estimate, and execute jobs in accordance with industry standards with safety and profitability as the primary goals. * Must understand electrical installation and safety, and effective interpretation and application of NEC NFPA 70 and NFPA 110 standards. Other duties as assigned. * **Qualifications** * A minimum of 5 years’ experience as an Energy Technician or Journeyman/Master level Industrial Electrician is desired. CAT Energy Certified Analyst is a plus. * The candidate must have a thorough understanding, regarding the CAT product line, but will consider applicants that have experience with other Energy brands. * Must be able to complete technical start\-up of diesel and gas engines and generator sets, automatic transfer switches, and standalone paralleling switchgear. * Must be available to work over\-time on site and in the field. * Must be able to work independently, prioritize tasks that are fluid and constantly changing. * Willing to work as a team member and collaborate with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders. * Excellent written and oral communication skills. Word document and spreadsheet knowledge preferred. * Must possess a valid South Carolina driver’s license with less than three moving violations in the past three years; and, must be able to clear federal background check. * Must demonstrate a high level of value\-added customer facing behavior for both internal and external customers. * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify and resolve problems in a timely manner; gather and analyze information skillfully; develop alternative solutions; works well in a group problem solving situations’ use reason even when dealing with emotional topics. * Ability to read drawings, one\-lines and specifications to discuss projects with contractors, engineers and architects. * Excellent written and oral communication skills \- must possess the personal discipline to establish the proper image as a representative of Blanchard Machinery. * Enthusiastic \- hard worker with the ability to complete work with minimal supervision. * Organizational and time management skills required. * Personal commitment to continuous improvement and service excellence. * Experience with CAT Electronic Technician, SAP, DBS, Lotus Notes, and EOMP systems **Working Conditions** * The physical environment requires the employee to work inside as well as in shop/machine environments (non\-climate controlled) and on customer job sites. * Position requires employee to be physically present at the job site location. * Job requires standing, stooping, squatting, pushing, pulling, twisting, turning, and lifting. * Use of computer and other forms of technology to complete job responsibilities.

jobs.company: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Massachusetts
jobs.title: Associate Director, AI Solution Architecture
jobs.description: Ready to help us transform healthcare? Bring your true colors to blue. We are looking for an Associate Director, AI Solution Architecture to lead our Enterprise AI and Solution Architecture group. In this leadership role, you will translate enterprise AI strategy into coherent, governed, and production\-viable solution architectures that span business lines, platforms, and geographies. This role does not build the core platform or own feature delivery; rather, you will define how AI capabilities are assembled into complete, end\-to\-end business solutions. Operating as a critical technical peer to the AI engineering and delivery function, you will bridge the gap between complex business needs and scalable architecture to drive the adoption of intelligent AI assistants and agentic workflows across the enterprise. What You'll Do **Team Leadership \& Mentorship:** Lead, mentor, and manage a high\-performing team of AI solution architects, providing technical guidance, architectural oversight, and career development. **Solution Design \& Engineering Partnership:** Partner with the AI Engineering team to conduct business needs assessments and identify high\-impact agentic use cases. Translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable technical blueprints that enable production\-grade engineering delivery. **Architect Agentic Solutions:** Oversee the architectural design of AI assistants, establishing enterprise best practices for model selection, prompt orchestration, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and agent orchestration. **Multi\-Agent Orchestration:** Guide the design of intelligent, multi\-step AI agents, defining patterns for sequential, loop, parallel, and hierarchical architectures to handle multi\-turn, multi\-domain use cases. **System Integration:** Architect secure, scalable tool\-use and function\-calling patterns, ensuring AI agents connect seamlessly to enterprise APIs, databases, and third\-party systems. **Responsible AI \& Governance:** Partner with AI Governance to structurally embed ethical considerations, fairness, transparency, hallucination mitigation, and strict data privacy into all AI solutions. **Production Scalability:** Design highly available, production\-grade solutions, collaborating closely with engineering leads to ensure architectural concepts translate into reliable, high\-performance deployments. **Communication:** Serve as the primary architectural liaison, effectively articulating the value, mechanics, and design of agentic AI solutions to non\-technical business leaders and executive stakeholders. Required Qualifications **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). **Experience:** 8\+ years in software engineering or solution architecture, with 3\+ years specifically focused on designing large\-scale AI/ML or LLM\-based agentic solutions. **Leadership:** 3\+ years of experience directly managing and leading teams of technical architects or systems designers. **Cloud Expertise:** Hands\-on architectural experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, including Vertex AI Agent Builder, Vertex AI Search, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Cloud Run. **AI Architecture:** Proven expertise in designing solution architectures leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) , including RAG, embeddings, complex function calling, and multi\-agent frameworks. **Integration \& Systems:** Strong command of API design , microservices, cloud\-native development patterns, and integrating AI capabilities into existing enterprise product ecosystems. **MLOps Foundations:** Solid knowledge of MLOps practices, including designing frameworks to measure and monitor LLM quality, latency, and cost in production. **Communication:** Exceptional ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured technical architectures and present them clearly to diverse audiences. Preferred Qualifications **Certifications:** Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Machine Learning Engineer. **Advanced AI Orchestration:** Deep exposure to designing architecture for autonomous tool\-use patterns and frameworks such as Google ADK, LangChain, or LlamaIndex. **Data Retrieval:** Experience integrating and scaling enterprise vector databases (e.g., Vertex AI Vector Search, AlloyDB, Pinecone) for high\-performance, embedding\-based retrieval. **Regulated Industries:** Experience working in healthcare, insurance, or finance, with a strong understanding of data privacy frameworks (e.g., HIPAA) and compliance requirements in solution design. **Minimum Education Requirements:** High school degree or equivalent required unless otherwise noted above Location Boston Time Type Full time **Salary Range:** $215,010\.00 \- $262,790\.00 The job posting range is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue\-based metrics, and business or organizational needs and affordability. This job is also eligible for variable pay. We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), and a suite of well\-being benefits to eligible employees. **Note:** No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, or any other form of compensation that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law. WHY Blue Cross Blue Shield of MA? We understand that the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can prevent amazing candidates coming our way, so please don’t hesitate to apply. We’d love to hear from you. You might be just what we need for this role or possibly another one at Blue Cross Blue Shield of MA. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be brilliant. We encourage you to bring us your true colors, , your perspectives, and your experiences. It’s in our differences that we will remain relentless in our pursuit to transform healthcare for ALL. As an employer, we are committed to investing in your development and providing the necessary resources to enable your success. Learn how we are dedicated to creating an inclusive and rewarding workplace that promotes excellence and provides opportunities for employees to forge their unique career path by visiting our Company Culture page. If this sounds like something you’d like to be a part of, we’d love to hear from you. You can also join our Talent Community to stay “in the know” on all things Blue. At Blue Cross Blue Shield of Massachusetts, we believe in wellness and that work/life balance is a key part of associate wellbeing. For more information on how we work and support that work/life balance visit our " How We Work " Page.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking exceptionally talented, high\-agency Software Engineers to join our core team in Palo Alto. In this role, you will design, architect, and ship high\-impact features that directly drive revenue for our customers and transform how healthcare organizations operate. We move fast, iterate aggressively, and value high\-throughput execution. You will work alongside seasoned founders in a tight\-knit, high\-urgency environment where your contributions directly shape our technology stack and product roadmap, allowing us to outpace and edge out the competition. You will own critical subsystems from day one and play a defining role in our engineering culture. You will work with the latest cloud infrastructure, deep analytics tools, and AI\-accelerated development environments. **What You’ll Do** * **Build High\-Throughput Data Pipelines:** Architect and optimize robust parsers and ingestion engines for complex healthcare data formats. * **Develop AI \& SQL\-Driven Analytics:** Build deep analytics engines that combine classical database optimization with modern AI\-assisted workflows to automate complex denial resolutions and financial predictions. * **Ship Full\-Stack Solutions:** Design, build, and maintain sleek, highly responsive UI interfaces backed by robust, scalable microservices and APIs. * **Drive Cloud Infrastructure:** Manage and scale multi\-cloud deployments leveraging both GCP and AWS environments. * **Leverage Modern AI Tooling:** Maximize your development speed using modern AI\-assisted coding tools while maintaining rigorous standards for code quality, system architecture, and performance. **Who You Are** * **Proven Engineering Excellence:** You hold a degree in Computer Science (or equivalent) or have a track record of building production systems at tech companies or high\-growth startups. * **Full\-Stack / Core Backend Mastery:** Strong foundations in backend engineering (distributed systems, database architecture, complex data parsing) paired with the ability to build clean, intuitive UI components. * **Data \& Cloud Native:** Proficient in SQL\-based deep analytics, modern database management, and cloud ecosystems across GCP and AWS. * **High\-Agency \& Fast\-Paced:** You operate with a strong sense of urgency, take ownership of end\-to\-end outcomes, and thrive in dynamic environments with minimal supervision. * **Pragmatic AI Power User:** You embrace AI\-assisted coding tools to accelerate iteration while maintaining deep domain mastery over manual system architecture and low\-level engineering. * **Mission\-Driven:** You are eager to apply top\-tier engineering principles to solve real\-world efficiency challenges in the healthcare industry. **Technology Must\-Haves** * Deep Python experience, including production experience with Django or a comparable framework (Rails, Flask \+ SQLAlchemy). You are comfortable across ORM patterns, migrations, management commands, and background workers. * Strong Postgres experience in a managed cloud environment (Google Cloud SQL, AWS RDS, or equivalent). Comfortable with schema design under evolving requirements, query performance and indexing, migration strategies for large tables, and read\-vs\-write scaling tradeoffs. * Production data\-pipeline experience. You have built ingest, validation, and transformation code that runs against real customer workloads and holds up under load, drift, and messy input formats. * Task orchestration with Celery, RQ, Sidekiq, or comparable—focusing on the underlying pattern more than the specific tool. * 5–8 years of engineering experience, including end\-to\-end ownership of at least one significant system in production. * Bias toward shipping under uncertainty. jobs.description: **DevOps / Test Engineer – Job Description** Boon Logic, Inc. Hybrid Boon Logic Inc. is looking for a DevOps/Test Engineer to help us build, test, and ship reliable software. jobs.title: Product Manager II, Workflows
jobs.description: **WHAT IS BOX?** Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia. By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift. **WHY BOX NEEDS YOU** Box's Workflows team builds how content moves through an organization: routing, approvals, forms, document generation, e\-signature, and AI\-powered automation. As PMII, you'll own two connected motions. **Enterprise workflows** are cross\-department processes that IT governs and runs at scale. **Line\-of\-business (LOB) workflows** are solutions built for the teams that run the business, such as finance, legal, HR, procurement, and regulated industries. Your job is to make Box the place where content\-centric work gets automated, adopted and evangelized **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * **Work on strategy and roadmap.** Set a multi\-year vision for enterprise and LOB workflows. Decide what becomes a platform capability and what ships as a solution, and own the success metrics: adoption, workflow volume, time\-to\-value, and expansion revenue. * **Land line\-of\-business solutions.** Find the highest\-value use cases by function and vertical (contract approvals, vendor onboarding, loan origination, claims intake, clinical document exchange, HR case management). Ship the templates, data models, agents, skills and integrations that deliver value in days. * **Make workflows AI\-native.** Define how AI agents, extraction, and classification plug into workflows, with human\-in\-the\-loop review, exception handling, and guardrails for accuracy, cost, and trust. * **Integrate with the ecosystem.** Work with partners such as Salesforce, Microsoft, ServiceNow, Workday, and SAP. Shape the APIs, events, and connectors that put Box workflows inside the systems where work already happens. * **Stay close to customers and go\-to\-market.** Spend real time with customers, sales engineers, and partners, and turn what you hear in the field into clear requirements. Work with product marketing, sales, and customer success on positioning, packaging and pricing, launches, and enablement. **WHO YOU ARE** We are an AI\-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box. * 3\+ years of product management, with experiences on workflow automation, business process management (BPM), data, AI or enterprise SaaS platforms. * A track record of shipping products that large enterprises adopt and expand. You understand the difference between the IT buyer and the business buyer and can design for both. * Fluency in enterprise requirements: security, compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GxP), admin, and governance. * Domain depth in at least one line of business or regulated vertical, such as financial services, life sciences, public sector, legal, or HR. * Hands\-on experience shipping AI/LLM features, including evaluation, human\-in\-the\-loop design, and managing quality in production. Box lives its values, with community and in\-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week.Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process. At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high\-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in.If you are head\-over\-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply! **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY** We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. the Design Technology Department and the roadmap for success working in concert with Design Technology leadership across all of T\&D. * Establish clear and concise expectations and accountability measures for staff within the Design Technology Department. * Establish and communicate a vision for technology and staff that supports profitability growth within the changing business landscape and work with each department and section manager to develop short\-term and long\-term goals in support of that vision. * Continuously advocate for the Design Technology Department staff to T\&D and Burns \& McDonnell leadership. * Prioritize the needs of the Design Technology Department team members and quickly follow up on any outstanding items. * Strive to offer the Design Technology Department team the maximum amount of transparency in your processes, procedures and decision making. * Make concerted efforts to be accessible and approachable to the Design Technology Department staff. * Interpret policies and establish procedures and strategic goals for the department in collaboration with T\&D leadership. **Culture** * Inspire, motivate, and support the Design Technology Department to promote a culture of excellence. * Develop and foster an innovation culture that challenges the norm and utilizes tools, technology, and processes to drive continuous improvement and efficiency. * Actively foster a culture that promotes team cohesion and camaraderie. * Drive a culture focused on safety and compliance with company and client safety policies. **Career Development and Performance Management** * Inspire and lead the Midwest Design Technology Department to be the top performing Design Technology design team in the country by continually seeking new and innovative ways to improve. * Own the implementation of a competency\-based development roadmap for entry\-level Designers. * Meet with the Design Technology Department team on a regular basis. Listen to their short\- and long\-term goals, and provide guidance, direction, and facilitation of opportunities to meet those goals. * Annually organize, lead, and conduct the performance appraisal process for Design Technology Department staff. * Continuously educate Design Technology Department staff about the various career paths offered within T\&D, and work with the team to develop the knowledge, skills, abilities, and opportunities to pursue their desired career path. * Identify training needs and develop training programs in collaboration with technical teams and business line leadership. * Work with Human Resources and staff to identify, prepare, communicate, and monitor performance plans for employees with areas of needed improvement. **Collaboration \& Communication** * Communicate the vision, mission, and values of the Design Technology Department to all members to enrich a sense of identity and community. * Coordinate and collaborate with business line and technical leadership to build cohesion and tie the needs of our people to the needs of our business. * Transparently communicate annual initiatives and how they will impact the future of the department. * Identify the most effective means to communicate with the Design Technology Department, and to each of the individual contributors within the department and proactively share information. * Communicate and coordinate regularly with Design Technology Department leadership in all locations across the T\&D global practice regarding staffing, initiatives, and overall business line strategy. **Recruiting and Onboarding** * Develop and maintain an annual personnel growth strategy that directly ties to the Design Technology Department the MWR T\&D plan. * Proactively work with the HR Recruiting team to identify and recruit candidates that align with our MacCulture principles and the Design Technology Department’s growth strategy. * Purposefully interview, assess, and hire prospective candidates utilizing processes and procedures that increase overall equity within the hiring process including but not limited to ensuring: a diverse candidate pool, a diverse interview panel, interview questions that tie directly to the necessary qualifications of the position and a consistent candidate experience. * Lead, manage, and deploy the onboarding process for all new staff transitioning into the Design Technology Department. This includes but is not limited to interns, new graduates, experienced hires, transfers and converted contract employees. **Resource Management** * Create, evolve, and build the organizational structure for the Design Technology Department to maximize engagement, proficiency, and satisfaction for personnel. * Manage and coordinate resource needs on project and account teams with business line and technical leadership. * Regularly review team utilization of staff to make sure employees have a clear path of development and support and are adequately leveraged and empowered to their strengths and skillsets. * Oversee and manage the chargeability of the Design Technology Department. **Technology \& Innovation** * Foster a culture of automation, innovation and inspire team members to think creatively. * Work closely with the Technology Operations Manager and Digital Delivery Manager to manage the implementation of T\&D's Digital Delivery Roadmap * Maximize various software, such as Bentley MicroStation, OpenUtilities, Autodesk AutoCAD, Inventor, Revit, and ACADE, to optimize workflows and enhance collaboration. * Act as a mentor to encourage the development of digital delivery ideas that align with our * Business Lanes and Design Technology business plans. * Collaborate with project teams, project engineers, project management, department managers, and leadership to identify and implement novel solutions that enhance efficiency and deliverable quality. * Demonstrate the ability to participate and present at industry events to identify emerging trends and technologies. * Take the lead in initiating and executing innovation initiatives that aim to enhance the quality, efficiency, and profitability of design technologies usage within the organization. **Qualifications** Bachelor’s degree in engineering, architecture, construction, business, or related degree for an accredited program and a minimum 7 years of related professional experience required, or an associate degree with 9 years of professional experience, or 11 years applicable experience may be substituted for degree requirement. Other qualifications include: * Must demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to clearly and effectively present complex information to all levels of employees, management, and clients. * Position requires the ability to influence, lead and manage change thoughtfully and positively. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * This position requires an individual capable of applying intensive and diversified knowledge of principles and practices to broad areas of assignments. * Must be capable of devising new approaches to problems encountered. * Professional Engineering licensure preferred. * Previous leadership and/or management experience preferred. * Previous consulting experience preferred. **Compensation** $135,000\.00\-240,000\.00 Yearly The expected compensation range for this position is displayed in compliance with all local/state regulations. The expected compensation range for this position is based on a number of factors, including but not limited to: individual education, qualifications, prior work experience and work location. The total annual compensation package will consist of a base salary and eligibility to participate in our discretionary year\-end incentive bonus program. **Benefits** Our extensive benefits package takes care of you so that you can focus on doing great work. From insurance and disability to time off and wellness programs, we provide the tools to meet your needs. As part of being 100% employee\-owned, eligible employees participate in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) in addition to our 401(k) retirement program. For more information, please visit the Benefits \& Wellness page. This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled. jobs.title: Industry Solution Leader - Power and Utilities (Power Generation and Battery Storage Dispatch Optimization)
jobs.description: C3 AI (NYSE: AI), is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end\-to\-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry\-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain\-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise. Learn more at: **C3 AI** C3 AI is seeking an Industry Solution Leader (ISL) for Power and Utilities to lead the design and delivery of enterprise AI solutions for its clients with a specialization in Power Generation and Battery Storage Dispatch Optimization. Industry Solution Leaders combine deep industry and engineering expertise with end\-to\-end ownership of customer solutions. They are expected to understand a customer's operations deeply enough to challenge assumptions, identify and quantify the highest\-value opportunities, define the right technical solution, and lead cross\-functional teams through design, deployment, validation, and scale. The role combines the responsibilities of a senior domain expert and solution leader. Industry Solution Directors work directly with customer engineering, operations, maintenance, and executive teams while leading C3 AI Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product teams, and other technical resources to deliver measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate brings significant hands\-on experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, or maintenance and has the technical judgment, customer leadership, and delivery ownership required to lead complex enterprise AI solutions from problem definition through production. The ISL, Power and Utilities \- Power Generation and Battery Storage Dispatch Optimization should have **hands\-on experience operating, engineering, or optimizing power\-generation assets, including gas turbines, boilers/HRSG, fuel cells, or balance\-of\-plant equipment, with ownership of heat rate, output, availability, degradation, dispatch, or equipment performance.** **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own the overall solution strategy, technical direction, and delivery outcomes for assigned customer engagements, maintaining accountability from initial problem definition through production deployment and scale. * Serve as the primary customer\-facing solution leader and domain expert, developing a detailed understanding of customer operations, equipment, processes, constraints, and business objectives. * Identify and quantify high\-impact business opportunities across equipment reliability, maintenance, production performance, process optimization, throughput, yield, quality, energy efficiency, and operating economics. * Translate complex engineering and operational challenges into tractable AI, machine learning, optimization, and software problems with clearly defined requirements, success criteria, and expected business value. * Lead engagements through use case definition, requirements gathering, solution architecture, application configuration, validation, production deployment, user adoption, and scale\-out. * Apply deep engineering and industry expertise to challenge assumptions, evaluate technical approaches, interpret analytical results, and ensure solutions are consistent with engineering fundamentals and operational realities. * Lead cross\-functional teams of Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product managers, engineers, and industry experts, establishing technical priorities and driving alignment around customer outcomes. * Work directly with customer engineers, operators, reliability teams, maintenance organizations, and executives to validate requirements, solution performance, operational workflows, and business impact. * Guide the interpretation and use of industrial data, including process signals, equipment attributes, operating states, maintenance history, production information, alarms, quality data, and other engineering information required to solve customer problems. * Maintain accountability for solution quality, business value, technical risks, delivery progress, customer adoption, and executive communication throughout the engagement. * Partner with C3 AI product management and engineering teams to identify reusable capabilities, inform product development, and scale successful solutions across assets, production lines, facilities, and business units. * Support sales teams during opportunity assessment and capture by helping define customer problems, solution approaches, business value, technical requirements, deployment strategy, and demonstrations. * Support development of statements of work and deployment plans, ensuring scope, deliverables, assumptions, data requirements, risks, timelines, and resource requirements are clearly defined. * Develop repeatable industry methodologies, solution patterns, and best practices and represent C3 AI in relevant customer, industry, and technical forums. **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Industrial, Mining, Metallurgical, Petroleum, Materials, or similar engineering backgrounds are preferred. * 7\+ years of experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, maintenance, industrial technology, or technically focused consulting. * Deep experience in one or more asset\-intensive industries, including high\-tech or semiconductor manufacturing, steel and metals, minerals and mining, utilities and power generation, oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals, LNG, pharmaceuticals, or heavy manufacturing. * Demonstrated experience solving complex operational problems and improving equipment reliability, production performance, throughput, yield, quality, maintenance effectiveness, energy efficiency, or operating economics. * Strong understanding of industrial equipment, manufacturing or production processes, process controls, maintenance practices, and operational workflows. * Experience working with industrial data including sensor and time\-series data, equipment states, alarms, maintenance history, production data, laboratory or quality information, equipment hierarchies, and engineering data. * Experience with industrial systems such as process historians, SCADA, DCS, MES, EAM/CMMS, ERP, advanced process control, or industrial analytics platforms. * Demonstrated ability to reason from engineering fundamentals and determine whether analytical and AI\-driven recommendations are physically, technically, and operationally credible. * Demonstrated experience leading complex, customer\-facing technical engagements and working directly with engineering, operational, and executive stakeholders. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, establish priorities, and drive teams toward practical solutions. * Ability to work effectively with software engineers, data scientists, product managers, and customer technical teams and translate between domain, business, and technical requirements. * Excellent presentation, written communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills. * Ability to travel to customer locations as required. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience delivering AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, optimization, predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, process optimization, or industrial digital transformation solutions. * Hands\-on technical experience working with industrial data, SQL, Python, analytics tools, application configuration, scripting, or similar technologies, with the ability to directly inspect data, prototype analyses, and troubleshoot solution behavior. * Experience with rotating equipment, electrical equipment, production equipment, manufacturing lines, process units, mining systems, utility assets, or other complex industrial systems. * Experience taking technical solutions from initial proof of value through production deployment and scale. * Experience scaling solutions across multiple assets, plants, facilities, or business units. * Advanced degree in Engineering, Science, or a related technical discipline. **Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future company sponsorship.** C3 AI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics, including disabled and veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer, Algorithm Development
jobs.description: CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi\-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats. CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com. **Role Overview:** * Support the Systems Engineering design and development of cutting\-edge radar capabilities **Responsibilities:** * Design and develop advanced radar signal processing algorithms for target detection, tracking, and classification * Lead the development of new radar capabilities with minimal guidance * Optimize algorithms for real\-time performance and resource constraints * Implement algorithms in software (e.g., C\+\+, Python, MATLAB) and/or hardware (e.g., FPGAs, DSPs) * Analyze radar data to evaluate system performance and identify areas for improvement * Develop and maintain system simulations and models to support algorithm development and performance evaluation. * Design and development of radar modes * Contribute to the development of system requirements and specifications * Modeling and Simulation of radar systems and sub\-systems as well as the signal processing chain * Plan and lead field tests and data collection activities * Document and present technical findings and progress to leadership * Mentor and guide junior engineers * Work full\-time onsite at our office in Hawthorne, CA **Minimum qualifications**: * Bachelor's degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) or another related field or equivalent work experience * Deep understanding of radar systems and modes * Strong understanding of radar principles, signal processing techniques, and algorithms * Strong familiarity with programming languages like Python or MATLAB * Systems Engineering experience with RF (Radio Frequency) Systems * Expertise in digital signal processing (e.g. modulation, filtering, and detection) * Expertise in algorithm development * Expertise in data analysis * Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills * Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team **Preferred qualifications:** * Graduate degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) or another related field or equivalent work experience * Expertise with radar waveform design, matched filtering, doppler processing, and clutter rejection techniques * Strong foundation in both sides of the Systems Engineering V * Experience with C\+\+ **Why CHAOS?** * **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company * **Additional benefits**: 401k (\+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more * **Our Perks:** Free daily lunch, 'No meeting Fridays', unlimited PTO, casual dress code * **Compensation Components:** Competitive base salaries, generous pre\-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses * **Team Growth:** 350 employees and counting across 5 global offices ***Salary Range: $140,000 \- $280,000*** *The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.* ### **Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.** *\#LI\-onsite*

jobs.title: Information Services Developer II - IM Application Development
jobs.description: **Description** **Summary:** The Information Services Developer II is primarily responsible for designing, developing, and implementing systems based on requirements. The candidate should have good knowledge of development methodologies and follow them while designing and coding. This role requires collaborating and working with another team member focusing on quality support to both internal and external users, focusing on customer services and timeliness. **Responsibilities:** * Analyze ideas and business and functional requirements to formulate a design strategy. * Act as a tenant to draw out a workable application design and coding parameters with essential functionalities. * Work in collaboration with the team members to identify and address the issues by implementing a viable technical solution that is time and cost\-effective and ensuring that it does not affect performance quality. * Develop code following the industry's best practices and adhere to the organizational development rules and standards. * Develop and deploy code using existing tools and platforms utilized for automation and testing. * Involved in the evaluation of proposed system acquisitions or solutions development and provides input to the decision\-making process relative to compatibility, cost, resource requirements, operations, and maintenance * Integrates software components, subsystems, facilities, and services into the existing technical systems environment; assesses the impact on other systems, and works with cross\-functional teams within information Services to ensure positive project impact. Installs configure and verify the operation of software components * Participates in the development of standards, design, and implementation of proactive processes to collect and report data and statistics on assigned systems * Participates in the research, design, development, and implementation of application, database, and interface using technologies platforms provided. * Researching, enterprise adoption. * Experience modernizing on\-premises SQL Server, ETL, warehouse, and reporting workloads for Azure and Microsoft Fabric. * Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse ownership mindset and the ability to manage competing priorities and drive complex issues to resolution. * Ability and willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation and support scheduled production changes, incident response, and business\-critical release activities outside standard working hours, including evening or nighttime windows when required. **Preferred Skills** * Advanced hands\-on experience with enterprise Akamai implementations, including relevant capabilities such as Property Manager, Edge DNS, Global Traffic Management, Web Application Firewall, Bot Manager, EdgeWorkers, API Acceleration, and Enterprise Application Access. * Experience designing reusable, enterprise\-scale CDN solutions that support multiple application teams, business units, or cloud environments. * Experience creating enterprise\-scale CDN automation and self\-service capabilities using Terraform modules, GitOps workflows, APIs, CI/CD integrations, configuration validation, policy enforcement, automated testing, compliance checks, and remediation. * Experience with real\-user monitoring, synthetic testing, CDN telemetry, log and traffic analytics, application performance monitoring, service\-level objectives, reliability indicators, operational health metrics, and error\-budget\-based engineering practices. * Experience integrating CDN and edge platforms with multi\-cloud, hybrid\-cloud, or enterprise application environments, including edge\-security controls, web application protection, bot mitigation, API security, and zero\-trust access patterns. * Experience leading platform modernization or operational\-simplification programs and mentoring experienced engineers through standards, workshops, coaching, and reusable guidance; relevant CDN, cloud, networking, security, DevOps, site reliability engineering, or infrastructure\-automation certifications are a plus. **Education** Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience (HS diploma \+ 4 years relevant experience) **Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $106,605\.00 \- $260,590\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. * Experience with test\-driven development and automated testing frameworks * Experience with Scrum/Agile development methodologies. * Individually motivated to be able to see the big picture and At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **POSITION SUMMARY** CVS Health Digital is looking for hands\-on, passionate people who want to join a high energy and growing team to make a difference in customers’ lives and who want to be on the forefront of digital innovation that aims to reinvent what a pharmacy and a health care company can be in the digital world. Currently, we are seeking a Staff Software Development Engineer – Fulfillment who as both a Technical Lead and Individual Contributor will help build our next\-generation platform to promote the delivery of use cases into products focused on helping people live healthier lives. This Engineer with expert level backend engineering knowledge will brainstorm with architects, product managers, data scientists and fellow engineers to build data products used improve the health outcomes of millions of people. The right candidate will be a strong Analytical thinker and be able to simplify complex problems, processes or projects into component parts explore and evaluate them systematically. We love to collaborate and help each other and we want someone to share that ideology *Expectations for the Role:* * Architect, design, and implement highly scalable, fault tolerant, cloud native services using container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes) and fully automated CI/CD pipelines following DevOps principles * Apply advanced software engineering practices across the full SDLC—including domain driven design (DDD), design patterns, secure coding, automated testing strategies (unit, contract, integration), code quality gates, trunk based development, and continuous observability * Troubleshoot and lead resolution of complex distributed system issues, including data consistency challenges, cross service dependency failures, performance bottlenecks, and distributed tracing analysis using tools * Collaborate with product, architecture, and business stakeholders to define long term technical roadmaps, shape functional and non functional requirements, influence prioritization, and define measurable KPIs to evaluate engineering and business outcomes * Design and enforce microservice resiliency patterns such as circuit breakers, bulkheads, retries with exponential backoff, rate limiting, and service discovery, ensuring consistent adherence across all service integrations * Build and optimize real time streaming data pipelines leveraging event streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Pub/Sub) and CDC frameworks to propagate data from SQL/NoSQL stores to analytics and ML systems with strict latency and throughput requirements * Collaborate closely with engineering, platform, and business teams to deliver cost optimized, scalable solutions—leveraging cloud cost profiling tools, storage tiering strategies, service right sizing, and architectural simplification * Own the reliability, performance, and lifecycle of existing platforms, including production support, SRE aligned operational excellence, automated recovery strategies, and incremental modernization/refactoring * Influence and standardize the use of emerging technologies, frameworks, and tooling to streamline development processes and advance overall search quality * Lead technical risk assessments, architectural reviews, compliance validation, and engineering audit activities, providing mitigation strategies aligned with security, governance, and regulatory frameworks * Mentor and develop engineers across levels, providing architectural guidance, conducting design reviews, establishing engineering standards, and promoting a culture of technical excellence and knowledge sharing **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * 7\+ plus years of software development in enterprise / web / cloud applications * 5\+ years of backend software development experience with programming languages/tools including: Java, Spring Boot, Kafka * 3\+ years of distributed caching experience * 3\+ years of experience having a track record developing in AWS or GCP or Azure or similar public cloud environments (GCP preferred) * 3\+ years of experience in design, development and operationalizing microservices based web/webservices application in cloud native environment * 3\+ years of technical lead experience within a matrixed environment, including mentoring junior engineers and working cross collaboratively between architecture, product, etc **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Understand security threats and patterns and ensure adherence to all regulatory initiatives, HIPAA, PHI, PII, locational and contractual data restrictions * Experience with build automation technologies like Maven, Gradle, Jenkins, Harness * Expert knowledge with functional, imperative and object\-oriented languages and methodologies * Experience with Cassandra and Postgres \- preferred * Experience with test\-driven development and automated testing frameworks * Experience with Scrum/Agile development methodologies. * Individually motivated to be able to see the big picture and prioritize their work to make the largest impact on the business and customers vision and requirements * Analytical thinking \- able to simplify complex problems, processes or projects into component parts explore and evaluate them systematically **EDUCATION** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience (HS diploma \+ 4 years relevant experience) **BUSINESS OVERVIEW** Bring your heart to CVS Health Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health. This purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human\-centric health care for a rapidly changing world. Anchored in our brand — with heart at its center — our purpose sends a personal message that how we deliver our services is just as important as what we deliver. Our Heart At Work Behaviors™ support this purpose. We want everyone who works at CVS Health to feel empowered by the role they play in transforming our culture and accelerating our ability to innovate and deliver solutions to make health care more personal, convenient and affordable. We strive to promote and sustain a culture of diversity, inclusion and belonging every day. CVS Health is an affirmative action employer, and is an equal opportunity employer, as are the physician\-owned businesses for which CVS Health provides management services. We do not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, promotion, or any other personnel action based on race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We proudly support and encourage people with military experience (active, veterans, reservists and National Guard) as well as military spouses to apply for CVS Health job opportunities. **Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $106,605\.00 \- $284,280\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short\-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program. Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. **Great benefits for great people** We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments. We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/27/2026 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.
