Our time off benefits include Paid Time Off (PTO), paid holidays, bereavement, and jury duty. In addition, we offer paid pregnancy and parental leave, and supplemental paid military leave to eligible employees. *Temporary or Part\-Time* In geographic areas with statutory paid sick leave, part\-time and temporary employees will receive a paid sick leave benefit that meets the mandated requirements. **Pay:** We offer competitive wages that are commensurate with job\-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, and geographic location, starting in the range of $20\.54 \- $27\.21 USD per hour.**Artificial Intelligence Statement** We recognize that applicants for positions at any organization may view AI tools for tasks such as drafting a resume or cover letter, provided the information is accurate and truthful. jobs.title: Advanced Field Service Engineer - DCS Process Automation
jobs.description: The future is what you make it. When you join Honeywell, you become a member of our global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers and doers who make the things that make the future. We are recruiting for an **Advanced Field Service Engineer** . The incumbent will perform maintenance, audits, configuration, programming, installation/commissioning, upgrades, and migration of complex/advanced Honeywell control systems (EXPERION PKS, TPS/TDC300\). Your time will be spent validating customer requests, developing/maintaining/improving customer relationships, upgrades/migration planning and execution, all while ensuring Right and Fast Delivery. You will report directly to our **Field Service Manager** , and you’ll work out of our **Houston, TX** location on an **On\-site** work schedule. Honeywell Process Solutions is a pioneer in automation control, instrumentation and services for oil and gas; refining; energy; pulp and paper; industrial power generation; chemicals and petrochemicals; biofuels; life sciences; and metals, minerals, and mining industries. A leader in digitization, Honeywell delivers software and services that help customers overcome competitive pressures and uncertain market conditions to achieve game\-changing business outcomes. jobs.title: Data Architect - Healthcare Insights, Pharmacy
jobs.description: Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes. Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long\-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer\-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future. This role sits within a strategic investment to embed AI into how we operate, serve customers, and make decisions within our healthcare business. We're building a healthcare\-wide AI data and context platform with a focus on deep domain expertise embedded throughout our architecture. Our goals are: * Turn structured and unstructured information into trusted, reusable "building blocks" (semantic layers, retrieval services, and agent\-ready interfaces) that accelerate product innovation * Deliver transformational speed and leverage — faster time\-to\-insight, higher automation of knowledge work, and a foundation that scales AI safely and reliably as adoption grows * Unlock new capabilities across our business and create the foundation that drives deeper domain innovation and cross\-domain collaboration This is a hands\-on technical architect who owns the design and delivery of core AI/context data capabilities. The role is responsible for end\-to\-end architecture decisions across the platform — unstructured ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, semantic layers, and governance — while partnering across engineering, product, and AI teams to ship production\-grade AI data products. Leadership is through technical ownership, design authority, and cross\-functional influence.**Key Responsibilities** *Architect and own the AI context platform* Design end\-to\-end platform architecture: ingestion parsing/chunking enrichment embeddings vector indexing* retrieval/serving * Define scalable patterns for incremental refresh, backfills, re\-embeddings, deduplication, and lineage across unstructured sources * Set technical direction for retrieval quality (query strategies, hybrid search, metadata filtering, reranking) in partnership with AI engineers * Evaluate and select infrastructure, tooling, and cloud services to support platform needs across AWS/Azure/GCP environments *Design and deliver semantic and governed data products* * Architect and implement semantic layers (metrics/entities) that power BI and agent reasoning consistently across the platform * Define data contracts and context contracts for AI inputs (schemas, metadata requirements, freshness, citation expectations) * Establish standards for discoverability, documentation, and reusability across datasets and indexes * Own the dbt or semantic layer tooling strategy and ensure consistent application across workstreams *Operational excellence* * Own reliability and performance at the platform level: monitoring, alerting, SLAs/SLOs, runbooks, incident response, and postmortems * Drive cost and latency optimization across Snowflake, lakehouse, and vector infrastructure * Set engineering standards for CI/CD, testing, and evaluation (retrieval eval sets, regression tests, online telemetry) *AI safety, governance, and compliance* * Implement security\-by\-design: RBAC/ABAC patterns, PII redaction, retention controls, audit logging, and safe access pathways for agent tools * Partner with Security/Legal/Compliance to define and enforce guardrails for AI access to enterprise knowledge * Own governance patterns for sensitive data handling across the platform *Lead through influence* * Drive technical roadmap decomposition with product, AI, and application stakeholders * Facilitate architectural decisions across teams and functions, building alignment without direct authority * Set best practices and mentor engineers via design reviews, code reviews, and documentation **Future Scope** This role is expected to grow into direct people leadership over time. As the platform matures and the engineering team expands, the Architect will take on formal responsibility for leading a small team of engineers — owning hiring input, technical d nces **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting LLM applications (RAG, agent tool interfaces, evaluation/observability) * Knowledge of knowledge graphs, semantic modeling, or metrics layers at scale * Experience in regulated environments and mature data governance programs * Familiarity with Iceberg, Delta Lake, or other open table formats in a lakehouse context * Prior experience in a formal or informal technical lead or staff engineer capacity **Example Success Measures** * Measurable improvement in AI outcomes: higher retrieval precision/recall, better citation coverage, fewer "missing context" failures * Reduced latency/cost per retrieval and improved platform reliability (SLO attainment, lower MTTR) * Broad adoption of semantic definitions, context contracts, and platform standards across teams * Architecture decisions are well\-documented, defensible, and enable downstream engineers to deliver faster * Platform design earns trust from Security, Compliance, and business stakeholders **Behavioral Attributes** * **Business\-curious and domain\-eager:** Proactively learns healthcare processes, terminology, and KPIs — can speak credibly with SMEs and business leaders, not just translate requirements but help shape the right questions and success measures * **Stakeholder\-first collaborator:** Builds strong relationships with stakeholders, SMEs, and consultants; clarifies goals, constraints, and tradeoffs early; communicates progress and risks clearly; sets realistic expectations around timelines, scope, and quality * **Consultative problem\-solver:** Approaches requests with a "diagnose before prescribe" mindset — asks smart questions, proposes options, and guides teams toward durable solutions rather than one\-off fixes * **Influence without authority:** Leads through expertise and trust — drives alignment, facilitates decisions, and unblocks teams across functions without relying on positional authority * **High ownership and follow\-through:** Treats reliability, documentation, and operational readiness as part of the work; finishes what they start; holds a high bar for production quality * **Clear communicator for mixed audiences:** Can go deep with engineers and explain concepts plainly to non\-technical partners; writes crisp architecture docs, designs, and runbooks * **Pragmatic builder mindset:** Biases toward shipping value in iterations, validating with users, and improving based on feedback — balancing innovation with maintainability and risk * **Comfortable with ambiguity:** Thrives in early\-stage or evolving spaces, adapts quickly, and turns unclear goals into actionable architectural plans * **Integrity and stewardship:** Handles sensitive data responsibly, advocates for secure\-by\-design patterns, and enables the business to move fast without cutting corners on governance **The estimated base salary for this job is $140,000 \- $190,000 USD. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $168,000 \- $228,000 USD. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future.** **\#LI\-CL1** **\#LI\-REMOTE** **Position Level** ------------------ Manager**Country** ----------- United States of America

jobs.title: Cybersecurity, Principal
jobs.description: **ABOUT THE ROLE** The Cybersecurity, Principal is a senior technical security leader responsible for executing Hut 8's cybersecurity strategy and turning it into secure architecture, operating capabilities, and measurable control improvements. This role is designed for an experienced security architect and builder who can work across corporate IT, mining operations, data centers, cloud, and AI/compute environments. The Principal will own major security work streams, design practical solutions, guide implementation, validate controls, and help establish the foundations of Hut 8's security program. This is not an entry\-level engineering role. It requires the technical depth to operate across architecture, identity, cloud, endpoint, network, application, data, and OT environments, together with the judgment to prioritize risk and deliver in a fast\-moving organization. The Principal executes against the strategy set by the Cybersecurity, Partner and works closely with Software, Networking, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Applied AI, Technology Operations, and Mining Operations. This role reports into the Technology organization, with a preferred growth path toward broader enterprise security ownership. What You'll Do * Translate Hut 8's cybersecurity strategy, principles, and roadmap into executable technical plans and prioritized workstreams. * Design and implement defense\-in\-depth security architecture across identity and access management, networks, endpoints, cloud, SaaS, data, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and OT or industrial control environments. * Establish secure architecture patterns, reference designs, technical standards, and security\-by\-default practices for new systems and major changes. * Lead implementation of core security capabilities, including SIEM or security monitoring, EDR, vulnerability management, security tooling, identity governance, and incident response processes. * Improve identity and access controls, including MFA, SSO, privileged access, least privilege, joiner\-mover\-leaver workflows, access reviews, and service\-account governance. * Build and maintain practical security controls for cloud, SaaS, data, application, and AI/compute environments. * Partner with engineering and technology teams to secure integrations, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, production platforms, and enterprise data throughout the technology lifecycle. * Support the design and execution of incident response, including detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery, root\-cause analysis, and post\-incident remediation. * Lead vulnerability management activities, including prioritization, remediation planning, exception handling, validation, and reporting. * Contribute to the security governance, risk, and compliance program by documenting controls, gathering evidence, testing effectiveness, and closing audit findings. * Support security assessments, third\-party reviews, risk analyses, architecture reviews, and control\-validation exercises. * Develop technical runbooks, operating procedures, diagrams, standards, and decision records that make the security program repeatable and scalable. * Work with external security partners and vendors to drive delivery, validate outcomes, and progressively build internal capability. * Provide clear technical advice, risk\-based recommendations, and status reporting to the Cybersecurity, Partner and technology leadership. * Mentor engineers and technical stakeholders on secure design, operational discipline, and incident readiness. **ABOUT YOU** * 5\+ years of progressive cybersecurity or information security experience, with substantial experience in security architecture, engineering, operations, or a comparable technical leadership role. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field; security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, GIAC, or relevant cloud security certifications are preferred. * Strong hands\-on knowledge of security architecture, cloud and SaaS security, identity and access management, network security, endpoint security, application security, data security, and OT or industrial control environments. * Experience designing and delivering security capabilities such as SIEM or SOC, EDR, vulnerability management, incident response, IAM, privileged access, and security monitoring. * Experience securing platform integrations, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, cloud and data architectures, and production systems. * Working knowledge of security frameworks and control environments, including NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, SOX ITGC, PCI, or comparable standards. * Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous requirements, identify the material risks, design a practical solution, and drive the work through implementation and validation. * Strong technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to explain security decisions to engineers, operators, executives, and non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience working with security vendors, MSSPs, auditors, and third parties; ability to hold partners accountable for measurable outcomes. * Comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor and technical leader who can lead through influence, coordinate cross\-functional delivery, and mentor others. * Pragmatic, collaborative, and willing to work hands\-on to establish the foundational capabilities required for a maturing security program. **ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT** This role is in office at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.description: ### **The role** We are hiring a hungry, driven **Sales Hunter** to grow Ideas2IT's AI and product engineering revenue in the US. AI POCs reach a working demonstration in two to four weeks and production in sixty to ninety days. Modernization starts with a one\-week codebase assessment and incremental delivery from the next sprint. ### **Why here** We started by solving hard problems and building products, and that is still how the firm behaves. Four of the products we built for ourselves, Pipecandy, Element5, IdeaRx and Carefi.in, were spun out as separately funded companies. A Sales Hunter's role is only as good as what happens after the signature. At most typical services firms you close a logo, delivery underwhelms, and you spend the next year selling around the damage instead of expanding into it. Our 99% renewal rate is why that does not happen here. Whatever you land compounds instead of leaking, and that compounding is a real part of your number rather than someone else's. Six proprietary platforms handle the most expensive parts of an engagement, meaning discovery, analysis, architecture and test generation, so engineers work only on the twenty to thirty percent that needs human judgment. * **Anticlock** runs the AI\-native SDLC * **Explayn** does source code intelligence * **Legacyleap** handles agentic modernization * **MigratiX** does data estate migration * **DataStoryHub** is conversational BI * **Qadence** auto\-generates around 70% of test cases. Delivery runs forty to seventy percent faster than a conventional engineering team, and our forward\-deployed engineers embed inside the client organization, share their OKRs and work on their stack rather than reporting in from a delivery center. Just two of the many outcomes you will carry into a room: * **Medtronic LABS** saw sixty percent faster patient information retrieval and a threefold increase in concurrent users. * **For St. Louis University** we took a data processing job that would have run four and a half years down to a week. For regulated buyers we hold SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA compliance and AWS Healthcare Competency. Leadership has carried P\&L, written code and shipped products. **Murali Vivekanandan** is Founder and Chairman, **Gayathri Vivekanandan** is CEO, **Robert Lang** is Chief Revenue Officer, and **Arunkumar Ganesan** is Co\-Founder and Senior Director of Technology. ### **Why this, why now** In August 2026, Ideas2IT was named an **OpenAI Select Partner**. That gives us early access and direct support, so new frontier capability reaches client systems close to when it exists rather than a year later. For you, it is leverage in a room and a credential the prospect's own board will recognize, and it arrived exactly as enterprise buyers stopped experimenting and started committing production budget. Sell for a bloated consultancy and the brand opens doors, the deal desk is mature, and you are one of thirty business development directors working a carved\-out patch. At Ideas2IT, you get **real influence** over which verticals we chase and how we price, because there is no committee between you and the people who decide. You will work directly with leadership, speak without filters, and have your growth personally championed by the people who founded and grew this company. ### **What you own** * Net\-new logo acquisition across the US market * Account\-based prospecting into a named target list, and the research and multi\-threading that makes it work * Direct outreach to CXOs and senior decision\-makers, self\-sourced rather than inbound * Ideas2IT's presence at executive forums and industry events, and the pipeline that comes out of them * The full cycle, from first conversation to signed SOW * Multi\-million\-dollar, multi\-year AI and modernization programs * Converting free assessments into scoped, paid engagements * Proposal shaping alongside Practice Heads and Solution Architects * Forecasting and CRM discipline that leadership can plan against ### **What you bring** * 8 to 15 years in US enterprise sales * A track record of closing $3M to $10M\+ in annual new revenue, with the attainment numbers to back it * Experience selling AI, data, cloud, modernization or platform engineering services * A working ABM discipline: you build the target list, do the research, and multi\-thread rather than working a single contact * The ability to build pipeline yourself rather than waiting on inbound * Comfort running complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise deals, with MEDDICC, Challenger or something comparable behind you * Executive presence and real consultative range ### **What sets you apart** * You have sold AI\-led transformation or GenAI programs and know where those deals actually stall * You have a live CXO network in healthcare, financial services or SaaS, which is where our strongest references sit * You work events properly, meaning a target list going in and a follow\-up motion coming out * You have sold in regulated environments and use compliance credentials as an accelerant rather than a checkbox ### **The numbers matter** To Sales Hunters at this level, whether a quota is credible tends to matter more than a headline OTE, so we are happy to walk you through the math before our first conversation, if you'd like. Write to us and we will share everything relevant. *Ideas2IT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from every background.* ### **About Us:** Ideas2IT stands at the intersection of Technology, Business, and Product Engineering, offering high\-caliber Product Development services. Initially conceived as a CTO consulting firm, we've evolved into thought leaders in cutting\-edge technologies such as Generative AI, assisting our clients in embracing innovation. Our forte lies in applying technology to address business needs, demonstrated by our track record of developing AI\-driven solutions for industry giants like Facebook, Bloomberg, Siemens, and others. Harnessing our product\-centric approach, we've incubated several AI\-based startups—including Pipecandy, Element5, IdeaRx, and Carefi. in—that have flourished into successful ventures backed by venture capital. With fourteen years of remarkable growth behind us, we're steadfast in pursuing ambitious objectives.‍ P.S. We're all about diversity, and our doors are wide open to everyone. jobs.title: Principal Structural Engineer – Data Center Infrastructure (FE)
jobs.description: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe. **How will you make an impact?** The Principal Structural Engineer is a core member of the Facility Enablement team, responsible for the structural integrity of both the data center products we build and the manufacturing facilities used to produce them. This role spans the full product lifecycle, from early stage design through factory integration, deployment, and field installation, with a focus on scalable, repeatable, and manufacturable structural solutions aligned with hyperscale delivery models. The position requires deep expertise in structural steel and concrete design, seismic analysis, and equipment support systems, combined with a practical understanding of how structural systems integrate with high\-density MEP environments and modular construction workflows. The role is customer\-facing and works closely with mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, BIM, and product engineering teams to deliver code\-compliant, platform\-based, and production\-ready data center solutions. **Location:** Remote\* OR Austin, TX * Requires up to 30% domestic and/or international travel (rare) **What will you do?** Structural Design \& Analysis * Evaluate structural solutions through the lens of technical risk, cost efficiency, and schedule \- ensuring designs are robust, buildable, and aligned to delivery timelines. * Lead gravity, wind, seismic, and vibration analysis for modules, frames, racks, and support structures per IBC, ASCE 7, AISC, ACI, and applicable local codes. * Analyze and provide structural recommendations for MDCs, equipment skids, enclosures, and factory\-built assemblies. * Validate structural solutions for HAC systems across overhead, rack\-integrated, and floor\-supported configurations. * Develop seismic bracing and restraint strategies for MEP systems, cable trays, pipe racks, and modular assemblies. * Engineer foundations, steel frames, and anchorage solutions for chillers, generators, UPS systems, pumps, heat exchangers, and fluid distribution equipment. * Define structural strategies for thermal loads, vibration\-sensitive equipment, and deflection\-managed assemblies. * Develop and maintain DFMEA documentation to identify structural risks and drive mitigation across product families. Optimize recurring product families for weight, manufacturability, cost, and platform scalability. * Manufacturing Facility \& Production Space Support * Support structural design and coordination for manufacturing and production facilities, including floor loading, equipment pads, overhead crane rails, mezzanines, dock infrastructure, and material handling systems. * Evaluate structural implications of factory layout changes, new production equipment installations, and capacity expansions. * Ensure production floor structural systems are compatible with the weight, dynamic loading, and footprint of the data center products being manufactured. Collaborate with facility planning and operations teams to define structural requirements for new or modified production spaces. * Factory Integration \& DFx Enablement * Support factory layout and integration efforts, including load paths, transportation loads, and installation constraints. * Collaborate with manufacturing teams to ensure structural designs meet DFMA requirements; develop standard design templates and modularization strategies to enable repeatability across programs. * Define structural requirements for transportation, lifting, and placing equipment and skids; validate shipping and logistics requirements including OTR dimensional and load limitations. Ensure structural designs align with factory automation, material\-handling capabilities, and assembly workflows. * BIM \& Cross\-Discipline Coordination * Collaborate with the BIM/Revit team to ensure structural models are integrated, clash\-free, and current within the master coordination model. * Participate in multi\-discipline model coordination reviews, resolving structural clearances, anchorage zones, and maintenance envelopes across MEP disciplines. * Review and contribute to coordination drawings, ensuring structural elements are accurately represented and conflict\-free. Maintain structural model quality and LOD standards in adherence with the project BIM Execution Plan (BEP). * Fabrication \& Implementation * Collaborate with fabrication shops and factory teams to ensure structural designs are buildable, manufacturable, and installation\-ready. * Review shop d tchgear, switch panels, busways, ATS units, EDPM, BMS systems, and control panels, as well as cooling solutions ranging from traditional evaporative and indirect cooling systems to emerging liquid cooling technologies including chillers, heat exchangers, CDUs, pumps, and secondary fluid networks. The team also addresses the mechanical structures that house these systems \- hot aisle containment, steel enclosures, blanking panels, cable trays, and fiber and networking infrastructure. The DCI team operates as a cross\-industry center of excellence, partnering primarily with various cloud providers across the industry. Team members function as deeply technical subject matter experts who engage directly with customers and supply chain partners to assess requirements, identify challenges, and design infrastructure solutions end\-to\-end. The ideal contributor brings engineering\-level expertise in either power or cooling disciplines, a working knowledge of the full infrastructure dependency chain, and the ability to translate that expertise into clear recommendations and collaborative problem\-solving with both technical and business stakeholders. The pay range for this role is $132,400 \- $238,400\. Job\-related, non\-discriminatory factors used to determine the actual offered rate include qualifications and experience, geographic location, education, external market data, and consideration of internal equity. The anticipated close date of this job requisition is: November 30, 2026\. As part of the total rewards package, this position is eligible for a short\-term incentive based on performance. In addition, Jabil offers benefits to enhance your health, wealth, and resilient self. These include medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; paid time off accruing at a rate of 3\.07 hours during your first year of employment; 4 weeks of paid parental leave; in 2027, 11 company\-paid holidays (9 fixed holidays and 2 optional floating holidays), subject to change yearly; 401(k) retirement plan; and employee stock purchase plan. jobs.title: Director, AI First Enterprise Architecture
jobs.description: **About JSSI** Founded in 1989 and headquartered in Chicago, Jet Support Services, Inc. (JSSI) is the largest independent provider of hourly cost maintenance programs for business aviation. JSSI delivers comprehensive coverage for engines, airframes, and auxiliary power units (APUs) across more than 300 different aircraft makes and models, helping owners and operators stabilize maintenance budgets, maximize aircraft availability, and protect asset value throughout the lifecycle of ownership. JSSI has built a portfolio of complementary business lines designed to simplify the economic and technical complexity of business aviation; these include **Maintenance teams**, **Traxxall** maintenance tracking software, **Parts \& Engines**, **Conklin** aircraft cost and performance data, and **Aviation Capital** asset\-based financing solutions. Together, these offerings support owners, operators, and maintenance providers with integrated tools spanning ownership and maintenance planning, execution, and financial management. With more than 6,500 aircraft supported through programs and software platforms, JSSI leverages its unique independence, unmatched scale, and data\-driven insight to deliver customized solutions and support models aligned to the interests of each client — regardless of aircraft platform. JSSI is backed by leading institutional investors GTCR, Genstar Capital, and Blackstone. Learn more at *jetsupport.com*. **Position Summary**: As Director, AI First Enterprise Architecture, you define and own the enterprise architecture vision and standards that shape how JSSI builds software in an AI First, agentic engineering model. Reporting to the SVP of Engineering \& AI Transformation, you set the reference architectures, API and integration standards, and architectural guardrails that every engineering vertical follows, converting JSSI’s investment in Claude Code Enterprise and the Microsoft/Azure platform into consistent, secure, and scalable systems. This is a hands\-on, high\-influence leadership role. You chair JSSI’s Architecture Review Board (ARB), where you advocate and uphold shared architecture standards across the AI Solution Architects embedded in each engineering vertical. You directly lead two AI Solution Architects who serve as your enterprise architecture team, and you partner closely with the Directors of Engineering so that delivery teams build on common patterns rather than divergent one\-offs. Success is measured by outcomes: the consistency and reuse of architecture across the organization, the security and reliability of what teams ship, the speed at which proven patterns spread, and the trust the business places in JSSI’s engineering decisions. You will balance architectural rigor with delivery pace, holding clear human accountability for AI\-generated systems while driving the organization toward its AI First goals. **Position Responsibilities:** AI First Enterprise Architecture \& Strategy * Define and own JSSI’s AI First enterprise architecture vision, aligning agentic engineering, product platforms, data strategy, and modernization with business priorities across maintenance, parts, leasing, programs, asset management, and customer operations. * Architect enterprise\-scale AI ecosystems spanning multi\-agent systems, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and knowledge platforms, MCP\-enabled tooling, model lifecycle management, and AI\-assisted SDLC capabilities. * Establish the Microsoft/Azure\-first architecture posture (C\#/.NET, ASP.NET Core, React/TypeScript, Azure SQL, Service Bus, Entra ID, Key Vault, App Services, AKS/ACR, Application Insights, and secure CI/CD) as the default for new and modernized systems. * Operationalize Claude Code Enterprise as a strategic accelerator across specification, code generation, refactoring, testing, documentation, and review, supporting JSSI’s goal of 100% AI\-generated code with human accountability for intent, architecture, and quality. Architecture Review Board, Standards \& Governance * Chair the Architecture Review Board (ARB), setting the agenda, cadence, and decision rights that drive consistent architecture across engineering verticals. * Advocate and uphold shared standards across the AI Solution Architects embedded in each vertical, ensuring teams build on common patterns, contracts, and guardrails rather than divergent implementations. * Define and maintain API design, event\-driven, data contract, versioning, and interoperability standards, along with the agent behavior boundaries and evaluation frameworks that keep AI deployment responsible and predictable. * Establish governance for AI First development: code ownership, review expectations, IP and secrets protection, auditability, approved model usage, and human\-in\-the\-loop accountability, in partnership with Security, Legal, and Infrastructure. * Ensure responsible AI across everything that ships: fairness, explainability, model monitoring, security posture, and regulator standards, review processes, and governance that improved consistency, security, and delivery speed across multiple teams. * Proven ability to influence executives and cross\-functional leaders, and to mentor senior architects and engineers through influence rather than direct people management. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate complex technical concepts for technical and non\-technical audiences alike. AI \& Claude Ecosystem Proficiency (Claude Strongly Preferred) * Hands\-on experience with AI coding agents and agentic workflows (Claude Code strongly preferred; GitHub Copilot, Codex, or equivalent), including CLI integration and multi\-agent pipelines. * Hands\-on experience with multi\-agent design patterns (planning, orchestration, observability) and MCP server implementation against enterprise data sources. * Production expertise with LLM APIs (Claude API preferred): tool use, structured outputs, document processing, streaming, and rate\-limit management. * Strong prompt engineering skills, including structured outputs and retrieval\-augmented prompting. * Working knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks (quality, cost, latency) and responsible\-AI design aligned with Anthropic’s principles. Highly Desired Qualifications * Experience in aviation, transportation, asset management, maintenance, aftermarket services, or other complex operational B2B domains. * Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Fabric/OneLake, Semantic Kernel, Power Platform, or comparable AI engineering ecosystems. * Experience modernizing legacy platforms through incremental architecture, API\-led integration, event\-driven patterns, cloud migration, and test automation. * Familiarity with DORA metrics, SPACE concepts, and developer productivity telemetry. * Integrations with Dynamics 365 F\&O, Salesforce or equivalent CRM, and Microsoft Fabric. * Experience in regulated, safety\-sensitive, or audit\-heavy environments where security, governance, and operational reliability matter. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience; advanced degree a plus. At JSSI, we are committed to rewarding our team members with competitive and comprehensive compensation packages that reflect their contributions and talent. For this role, the annual base pay generally ranges from $170,000 to $220,000, with the final offer determined by variable factors including but not limited to market location, job\-specific knowledge, skills, education, and experience. In addition, your total rewards package may include an annual discretionary bonus plan, incentive or sales bonus plan, or other form of additional compensation, based on your role. Additionally, for full\-time employees based in the USA, Canada, or the Philippines, we are proud to offer a robust suite of benefits. This ranges from insurance offerings such as medical, dental, vision, retirement savings programs, among others, starting day one of employment. For a full overview of our offerings, visit the JSSI Benefits Page on our company website. *JSSI is an equal opportunity employer. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team.* Pay: $170,000\.00 \- $220,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Professional development assistance * Referral program * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60607

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer - Cloud Architecture, Fleet Delivery, and Engineering Infrastructure
jobs.description: #### **Summary** This role owns the engineering spine underneath that: how the platform is designed, how software reaches machines already installed in plants, what we know about the state of every one of them, and how a problem found in the field becomes a tracked defect and a delivered fix. The center of gravity is the cloud and central services side. The real\-time inspection software on the machines is built by product teams; this role owns the mechanisms that deliver it, record it, and watch over it, and the interfaces the two sides meet across. On\-site \- Westborough, MA. Full\-time, permanent, senior/staff\-level position, with occasional travel to customer sites required. #### **Duties and Responsibilities** * Set and document the architecture of the central platform and every contract the products meet it across: service boundaries, data schemas, versioning and compatibility rules, edge\-to\-cloud protocols, and tenant isolation. Architecture here is written down, reviewed, and revisited \- decision records, interface specifications, and diagrams that other teams build against. Holds review authority on changes that cross those boundaries. * Lead the contract between the machines and the central platform, and the tooling that lets every product line meet it the same way, including on the constrained, real\-time side. The goal is one supported path to the cloud rather than one integration per product. * Take platform and infrastructure workstreams from written design to delivered, operated software. Decompose the work, sequence it across contributors and sites, run the review cadence, surface risk early, and be accountable for the date. * Define and build the mechanism by which software reaches systems already running in production plants: release channels, compatibility checks, staged rollout to named sites, resumable transfer over constrained and intermittent links, tested rollback, and confirmation that the machine ended up running what it was told to run. * Maintain a durable, queryable record of every deployed system \- hardware, software versions, optics, and configuration, and the history of every change made to it. Own its design and the discipline that keeps drift visible rather than silent. * Design and deliver the path by which installed systems report what is true of them \- health, uptime, alarms, running versions, live configuration \- back to a central view, over intermittent, locked\-down, customer\-controlled networks. * Direct how evidence gets off a machine in the field: structured logs, diagnostic bundles, reproducible capture of the conditions around a fault, and secure retrieval that a support engineer can run without a developer present. * Run one path from field observation to tracked defect to delivered fix: internal defect tracking, triage that assigns ownership, and a hotfix route that reaches a single site fast without leaving the record behind it inaccurately. * Be accountable for the tooling engineers depend on: CI/CD, build agents, artifact and package hosting, code signing, test and simulation harnesses, and reproducible development environments, plus release engineering for the central services, including AI\-agent tooling and harnesses, treated as production infrastructure. * Govern the ground everything runs on: infrastructure as code for computing, managed databases, storage, networking, identity, and secrets; containerized service deployment; per\-customer isolation enforced in infrastructure and proven by automated tests; metrics, logs, and alerting wired per service and per tenant. #### **Qualifications Required** * 7\+ years of professional software engineering, several of them owning systems that ran in production for real users, not only contributing to them. * Architecture ownership across more than one team or product, with a written record: designs, decision records, or specifications authored that others built against. * Experience building or operating software delivery to installed/remote machines you cannot reach release channels, compatibility gating, staged rollout, rollback, and verification of end state, over intermittent links and customer networks you do not control. * Experience building or operating a source of truth for deployed state, versions, configuration, change history, kept reconciled against reality. * Infrastructure as code delivered to production (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or equivalent) that provisioned environments people depended on, with a defensible state, drift, and rollback story. * Containers and CI/CD as daily working tools, containerized services operated under an orchestrator or managed container service, and pipelines built rather than inherited. * Hands\-on production use of at least one major public cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP): networking, managed databases, storage, identity and access control, TLS, secrets handling, and least privilege. * Strong programming in at least two languages used for real services or automation. * Systems\-level C or C\+\+ experience, including shipping a library other teams embedded into products you did not own, with the versioning, memory discipline, and support that followed. * Linux and Git as daily working tools. * Observability practice, instrumented systems you operated and used what you built to find real faults. * AI\-assisted development ("vibe coding") as a working skill: directing an AI coding agent through real, multi\-step work, and critically reviewing, testing, and correcting what it produces. * Independent delivery and technical leadership, able to take an ambiguous problem, produce a written design, decompose and sequence work across a distributed team, and deliver on a cadence. * Clear written communication and professionalism to have work reviewed critically and to review others' the same way. * Eligible to work on\-site in Westborough, MA, on a permanent basis. #### **Language Skills** Clear written and verbal English communication required. Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double\-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. capabilities for the future. #### **Product \& Pricing Capabilities in Scope:** * **Product Configuration:** Product configuration using the Revenue Cloud configurator, Product attribute selection and validation. * **Product Catalog Management:** Product creation and onboarding, SKU management, Product hierarchy management, Product master data governance, Oracle synchronization. * **Product Governance:** Product intake process, data dictionary management, Integration dependency documentation, revenue recognition and billing metadata * **Pricing Management Capabilities:** Pricing Waterfall,Discount Management, Renewal Pricing, Dynamic Pricing, Pricing Governance, Promotions * **Bundle Management Capabilities:** Bundle Modeling, Configuration, Ownership Validation, Cart updates, Instance identity management, Zone and sub\-domain assignment * **Entitlement Management:** License Provisioning, Entitlement Lifecycle Management * **Usage \& Rating:** Support for subscription, usage\-based, hardware, and one\-time products; usage consumption and rating; overage management; and related billing and revenue treatment. #### **Key Responsibilities:** * **Product Ownership \& Strategy** + Define and manage the product roadmap for Product and Pricing, Fulfillment \& Provisioning capabilities + Serve as the PBS subject matter expert across current and future\-state systems, including Salesforce, Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced, NetSuite, Oracle ERP, MuleSoft / Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kaseya One, and key boundary applications. + Partner with Finance, Billing Operations, Revenue Operatio ross\-Functional Collaboration** + Work closely with technical leads, engineers, QA, enterprise architecture, fulfillment operations, finance operations and customer support teams to deliver end\-to\-end solutions. + Act as a liaison between business users and technical teams, translating operational pain points and business needs into system requirements and scalable design decisions. + Drive alignment across upstream and downstream teams to ensure impacts are understood before changes are introduced into production. + Facilitate issue resolution across complex, integrated workflows where ownership spans multiple teams, platforms, or business functions. * **Governance, Risk \& Compliance** + Ensure solutions meet applicable compliance standards, including internal controls, data privacy, and security requirements. + Partner with governance, architecture, security, integration, and release management teams to maintain alignment with enterprise policies. + Ensure changes include clear documentation, approved requirements, defined business rules, traceable decisions, test coverage, and operational readiness. * **Continuous Improvement** + Monitor system performance, user adoption, data quality, defect trends, and operational outcomes to identify opportunities to optimize workflows. + Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, billing accuracy, customer fulfillment and provisioning, software usage and overage, and operational scalability. + Stay current on industry trends, technology innovations, and best practices in subscription management, usage, and overage user experiences. + Support Kaseya's broader transformation goals by helping move from fragmented, manual processes to standardized, automated, and scalable global PBS capabilities. #### **Required Qualifications:** * 7\+ years of experience in product ownership, business systems analysis, CRM systems, revenue operations systems, jobs.title: Senior GIS Applications Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary** ----------- The King County Information Technology (KCIT) GIS Center is looking for an experienced **Senior GIS Applications Engineer** to join the Geo Engineering team. You'll build and modernize the GIS applications and automated workflows that King County departments depend on, across application development, spatial analysis, and data development and maintenance. The systems this team builds get used across nearly every part of county government. Your first major project will involve a full redesign of legacy GIS workflows for one of our King County agencies, partnering with another senior engineer to understand current processes, interfaces, and database structures, then rebuilding them into clear, automated workflows a junior analyst can operate day\-to\-day while you own and evolve these systems over time. You'll then work on migrating our ArcGIS Enterprise environment from on\-premises to Azure which includes applications, services, and databases. It isn't a lift\-and\-shift, but a thoughtful re\-imagining of how our GIS infrastructure should work. The King County GIS Center has earned national recognition, winning Esri's Enterprise GIS Award in 2025 for more than three decades of GIS leadership, as well as Exemplary Systems in Geospatial awards from the Geospatial Professional Network for work ranging from our Aerial Imagery Program to an AI\-assisted SEPA response letter generator. You’ll join a collaborative team of ten, working in small project groups using Agile practices, leading meaningful initiatives while working closely with experienced engineers and GIS professionals. We invest in professional growth through an annual training budget and regular conference attendance, including the Esri Developer and Technology Summit and the Esri User Conference. Strong GIS fundamentals and solid Esri experience are the key foundations we're looking for, along with the drive to keep learning. If you do your best work with people to review your approach, share the hard parts, and build on each other's thinking, you'll like it here. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we want to hear from you. We’re excited to hear from candidates who bring different strengths and perspectives. **About King County Department of Information Technology (KCIT)** King County is committed to being the best\-run government in the nation, and King County Information Technology (KCIT) is helping lead that transformation. KCIT harnesses the power of technology to modernize operations, advance digital equity and social justice, and deliver innovative solutions that engage, empower, and serve our residents, businesses, and community partners. Recognized by the National Association of Counties (NACo) for excellence in vision, strategy, innovation, and collaboration, KCIT is focused on delivering smart, secure, and customer\-centered technology services that strengthen county operations and support thriving, resilient communities. As the technology business partner to all 18 County departments, KCIT provides the foundational systems and services that power many of the region’s most essential functions. We work side\-by\-side with our partners to design and deliver technology solutions that enhance customer experience and advance King County’s mission. Learn more about KCIT at: http://kingcounty.gov/depts/it.aspx. This recruitment may be used to fill additional vacancies that may occur. **Job Duties** -------------- * Develop critical and complex systems and applications using Python, other languages and tools, and vendor\-managed platforms including ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Experience Builder, and ArcGIS Solutions. * Build documented, automated workflows on a SQL Server backend using Python and other scripting, replacing manual and undocumented processes. * Produce the documentation and training that lets analysts run those workflows day to day. * Design approaches that align with requirements, architecture and design, technical, and end\-user documentation standards. * Acquire and incorporate relevant spatial and tabular data for project themes. Where that data doesn't already exist internally or externally, develop it yourself. Keep all project\-related GIS data up to date as new or improved information becomes available. * Perform and report on detailed research and spatial analysis to meet business requirements, and design, produce, and deliver the maps, tables, and other graphic products that communicate those findings. * Apply AI\-assisted tools to GIS development and automation work, and help the team figure out where they genuinely earn their place in a workflow. * Contribute to the development of governance, group charters, and agreements. * Build and maintain effective working relationships with clients and stakeholders. Consult with them as needed to assess results, identify any necessary refinements, and revise products and services to reach a satisfactory outcome. **Experience, Qualificati tance to their King County worksite to respond to workplace reporting requirements. King County has a robust collection of tools and resources to support working remotely. jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive
jobs.description: ### **Job description** Kontent.ai is redefining what enterprise content management can do in the AI era. Our Agentic CMS helps global organizations create, govern, optimize, and deliver content at scale — giving business and technical teams the control, speed, and confidence they need to manage complex digital experiences. Leading brands including WebMD Ignite, Elanco, Zurich Insurance, Cadbury, and the University of Oxford use Kontent.ai to modernize content operations, improve governance, and accelerate time to market. We are hiring a **UK\- or NL\-**based expansion seller to turn the significant, largely untapped expansion potential within Kontent.ai's large enterprise client base into revenue. This is a **full\-cycle commercial role** within the Customer Success organization, **focused entirely on existing clients**, for a seller who can uncover expansion opportunities, build the business case, engage the right stakeholders, and close. You will work **alongside Customer Success Managers**: they own the client relationship, and you own the commercial motion. This is a rare opportunity to work with warm enterprise logos, with no cold prospecting, and to help clients adopt and monetize a product that is moving fast into agentic AI. **About the role** ------------------ This is a roving expansion role. You are deployed to the accounts with the highest expansion potential rather than a fixed portfolio. When you close, you hand back to the CSM and move to the next opportunity. The upside for you: you are always working the best opportunities, free of portfolio admin, with your compensation protected across handoffs. * Identify, qualify and develop expansion opportunities across existing clients: upsell, and cross sell. Building Pipeline is part of the win. * Map group and subsidiary structures within accounts, and develop and close cross\-sell into affiliated entities. * Build ROI\-driven, evidence\-backed business cases tied to client outcomes, not product features. * Engage credibly and independently with VP and C\-suite stakeholders, leading business conversations. * Partner with CSMs and the CS Director to prioritize the highest\-potential accounts and shape account\-entry strategies. * Run the full commercial cycle: opportunity creation, stakeholder engagement, proposal, negotiation, close. * Own pipeline discipline in Salesforce through the Upgrade/Upsell stage\-gate process (Zero Stage to Won). * Partner with Solutions Engineers on technical demos while owning the commercial conversation yourself. * Drive the AI ARR pipeline: translate agent value into business outcomes and build the commercial case for AI credits adoption. * Feed market and product signals back to Product, Marketing and CS leadership. **What does success look like?** -------------------------------- * First 6 months qualified pipeline creation minimal of USD 750k. * USD 1M\+ expansion ARR closed annually at full productivity (Year 1 ramp expected). * Self\-generated pipeline: you build it and you close it. * Cross\-sell closed into affiliated and group entities. * Accurate Salesforce data at every stage. * Accurate Planhat data at every stage. * CSMs tell us your involvement accelerated deals they could not close alone. **You will thrive here if you..** --------------------------------- * Have a proven full\-cycle expansion or growth\-sales track record in B2B SaaS: you build pipeline and close it, you do not just manage relationships. * Have carried and hit a quota with lean support, comfortable operating without a dedicated SDR or SE. * Can build an ROI business case independently, without a template. * Sell credibly at VP and C\-suite level and lead business conversations, not product ones. * Are self\-directed: you can prioritize a large opportunity space, set your own account plan and drive forward without close management. * Work a structured qualification method (MEDDICC or equivalent) and keep clean pipeline hygiene. * Bonus: experience in content, digital experience (DXP), composable/MACH or agentic AI. A strong advantage, and we build deep Kontent.ai product depth during onboarding. *One honest note on fit:* ***this is a closing role****, not an account\-management one. If your track record is managing warm books that someone else built, this seat will not play to your strengths, and there are better ones out there for you.* **With whom will you cooperate?** --------------------------------- * **CSMs:** your primary partners. They brief you on the account, you run the commercial motion. You share pipeline records and do not compete on compensation. * **CS Director:** your direct manager, involved in account prioritization and strategy. * **Solutions Engineers:** available for complex technical demos, but you lead and they support. * **Sales team:** adjacent, not overlapping. They own new logos, you own existing clients. Cross\-sell into known subsidiaries stays with you. * **Marketing and Deal Desk:** your sources of proof points, collateral, AI adoption assets and contract execution.

jobs.title: CAE IT Support Engineer
jobs.description: LTTS US Branch Raymond, Ohio **Job Description** Job Description \& Skill Requirement: The CAE IT Support \& Ticket Management Specialist is responsible for providing technical support for Computer\-Aided Engineering (CAE) applications, infrastructure, and end\-user environments. This role serves as the primary point of contact for incident resolution, service requests, and problem management, ensuring timely support for engineering teams. The position requires strong troubleshooting skills, ticket lifecycle management experience, and the ability to collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, software vendors, and business stakeholders. * Provide Level 1 and Level 2 support for CAE applications and engineering software. * Support installation, configuration, testing, and maintenance of CAE tools and related software. * Troubleshoot application performance, licensing, connectivity, and user access issues. * Assist engineering users with software usability, workflows, and technical issues. * Coordinate with software vendors and internal teams to resolve complex technical problems. * Document known issues, workarounds, and standard operating procedures. * Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets through the IT Service Management (ITSM) platform. * Monitor ticket queues and ensure compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs). * Prioritize tickets based on business impact and urgency. * Provide timely communication and status updates to end users and stakeholders. * Escalate unresolved issues to appropriate support teams while maintaining ownership through closure. Qualification: * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience. * 3\+ years of experience in IT support, help desk, application support, or engineering systems support. * Experience with ticket management systems such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms. **Job Requirement** Skills: • Experience supporting CAE applications such as Ansys, Abaqus, MSC Nastran, HyperWorks, STAR\-CCM\+, COMSOL, MATLAB, or similar tools. * Knowledge of HPC clusters, simulation environments, and engineering workflows. * Experience with software license management (FlexLM/FlexNet or equivalent). * Familiarity with PLM platforms such as Teamcenter or 3DEXPERIENCE. * Understanding of cloud\-based engineering environments and virtualization technologies. * ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent. * Experience with scripting and automation (PowerShell, Python, Bash). jobs.title: Principal Developer
jobs.description: Summary **Title:** Principal Developer **ID:** 22933 **Department Name:** Information Technology **Location:** Atlanta, GA (Hybrid) Description **About Us**: Recognized as the trusted source for industry knowledge, LIMRA AND LOMA provides research, training, development, and networking solutions to financial services companies. In a rapidly changing marketplace, companies rely on us for our industry insight, practical solutions, and unwavering commitment to their success. **Why Join Us:** Leading life insurance and financial services organizations around the world rely on our membership to make bottom\-line decisions with greater confidence. **They turn to us for:** **Research:** Catalysts for new ideas, industry benchmarking, and strategic planning. **Learning \& Development:** Programs to assess, train, and increase productivity, and develop future corporate leaders. **Networking:** Connections with industry leaders and peers through study groups, committees, and conferences. **The Opportunity**: We are seeking a **Principal Software Developer** for our Application Development team, to help identify, design, build, and support web\-enabled and artificial intelligence solutions that create measurable value across the organization and for our members. **What You’ll Do:** This role will work closely with business leaders, product teams, technology teams, and other stakeholders to implement best\-in\-class applications as well as identify opportunities where AI can improve internal processes, enhance employee productivity, and create new or improved member\-facing capabilities. The Principal Software Developer will help translate business challenges into practical solutions and will play a hands\-on role throughout the lifecycle (from ideation and prototyping to implementation, adoption and support). The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering and AI expertise with excellent communication, curiosity, and business acumen. This person should be comfortable working directly with business stakeholders who may be early in their AI journey, helping them understand what is possible, determining where AI is and is not the right solution, and guiding ideas from concept to production. **Responsibilities** We are seeking a Principal Software Developer for our Application Development team, to help identify, design, build, and support web\-enabled and artificial intelligence solutions that create measurable value across the organization and for our members. This role will work closely with business leaders, product teams, technology teams, and other stakeholders to implement best\-in\-class applications as well as identify opportunities where AI can improve internal processes, enhance employee productivity, and create new or improved member\-facing capabilities. The Principal Software Developer will help translate business challenges into practical solutions and will play a hands\-on role throughout the lifecycle (from ideation and prototyping to implementation, adoption and support). The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering and AI expertise with excellent communication, curiosity, and business acumen. This person should be comfortable working directly with business stakeholders who may be early in their AI journey, helping them understand what is possible, determining where AI is and is not the right solution, and guiding ideas from concept to production. **What You Bring:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 4\+ years of demonstrated experience designing, developing, and deploying AI or machine\-learning solutions in a production environment. * 5\+ years of strong experience with engineering tools (Git, DevOps, VSCode etc.), programming languages (C\#, Python, JavaScript) and environments (Azure/AWS). * 4\+ years of hands\-on experience developing applications using large language models and generative AI. * 4\+ years of experience designing and implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions. * 4\+ years of experience with cloud\-based AI platforms such as Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, or comparable technologies. * 5\+ years of demonstrated software engineering practices, including source control, testing, CI/CD, APIs, cloud development, and application support. * 5\+ years of developing and utilizing patterns and leveraging industry best practices. * Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and enterprise knowledge retrieval. * Demonstrate advanced business and technical acumen for applications. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and technical concept to non\-technical audiences. * Demonstrated ability to work directly with business stakeholders to understand problems and develop technology\-enabled solutions. * Strong consultative mindset and the ability to guide stakeholders from an initial idea through solution definition and implementation. * Ability to evaluate business cases and estimate value and risk. * Ability to operate effectively in situations where requirements may initially be ambiguous or evolving. * Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across business, product, data, security, architecture, and technology teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building AI\-powered conversational applications, copilots, assistants, or agentic AI solutions for externally facing audiences. * Experience guiding business stakeholders through the adoption of AI and emerging technologies, including change management, user enablement, communication, and ongoing solution refinement. * Experience working in the insurance, financial services, association, research, education, or professional services industries is a plus. * Experience working within Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum preferred). * Experience with automated builds and deployments (CI/CD). * Experience with automated testing (UI, TDD, Integration etc.). * Champions and provide guidance with an innovative mind set to deliver product solutions. **What Success Looks Like** A successful Principal Software Developer will be someone who can sit with a business leader, understand a problem that may initially have little technical definition, determine whether AI can meaningfully improve it, and then take ownership of turning that opportunity into a secure, practical, and supportable solution. Success in this role will be measured by the ability to deliver AI capabilities that are adopted, improve business outcomes, enhance our products and services, and provide meaningful value to our employees and members. Join Us: If you are someone who values collaboration, continuous learning, and making meaningful contributions, we encourage you to apply and explore this opportunity at LIMRA AND LOMA. LIMRA and LOMA are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where individuals feel valued and empowered to contribute. We welcome people with unique perspectives and backgrounds, recognizing that a wide range of experiences strengthens our ability to help members navigate with confidence. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, ancestry, color, religion, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, medical condition, disability, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. This Employer Participates in E\-Verify. See the E\-Verify notices. Este Empleador Participa en E\-Verify. Ver el E\-Verify avisos.

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer II – AWS & Data Platforms
jobs.description: **Where Ambition Meets Innovation** Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting\-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals. **Job Overview:** At LPL Financial we consider it our mission to take care of our advisors so they can take care of their client. Joining as a Software Engineer II, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the sustainable, scalable capabilities that support delivery of the highest standards of software products, processes for our Advisors and End Clients. **Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and maintain Python\-based applications and services. * Build and optimize data pipelines using AWS Glue and PySpark. * Develop and deploy containerized applications on AWS EKS. * Implement API and Microservices patterns using API Gateway and AWS Lambda. * Integrate with AWS DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, and other data stores. * Implement messaging and streaming solutions using Kafka. * Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following Test Driven Development (TDD) principles. * Collaborate in an Agile Scrum environment, participating in sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives. * Document technical designs and processes in Confluence and manage tasks in JIRA. * Work with GitHub for version control and CI/CD pipelines. * Apply basic Terraform skills for infrastructure as code. * Ensure application security, scalability, and performance. * Communicate effectively with stakeholders and team members, providing clear documentation and status updates. **What are we looking for?** We want **strong collaborators who can deliver a world\-class client experience**. We are looking for people who thrive in a **fast\-paced environment, are client\-focused, team oriented**, and are able to execute in a way that encourages **creativity** and **continuous improvement**. **Requirements:** * Minimum of 3 years of Proficiency in Python and related frameworks (e.g., Flask, FastAPI, Django). * Minimum of 2 Strong experience with AWS services: Lambda, API Gateway, Glue, EKS, DynamoDB, S3\. * Experience with PySpark for data processing. * Solid understanding of relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB). * Hands\-on experience with GitHub and CI/CD workflows. **Core Competencies:** * Excellent knowledge of OOP concepts, data modeling design patterns/frameworks using Search, Index, and Distribute Caching tools such as Coherence, Apache Solr, etc. * Experience with Agile development process * Excellent knowledge in designing and developing micro services * Ability to lead design discussions with Architecture Team * Good analytical, problem solving skills, communication, and documentation skills * Ability to handle multiple projects and with strong interpersonal skills and ability to work in a collaborative team environment * Great track record of implementing the distributed systems with legacy and modern technical tools * Problem\-solving mindset with attention to detail. * Ability to adapt to changing priorities and technologies. * Strong collaboration and proactive communication. * Eagerness to learn new technologies and continuously improve skills. **Preferences:** * AWS Associate\-level certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Developer – Associate, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate). * Additional AWS or cloud\-related certifications are a plus. * Experience with Kong API Gateway. * Familiarity with GitHub Copilot and other AI\-assisted development tools. * Basic knowledge of Terraform for infrastructure automation. * Experience with Agile Scrum methodology and tools like JIRA. * Familiarity with Kafka for event\-driven architectures. * Strong understanding of TDD and unit testing frameworks (pytest, unittest). This is a **hybrid role**, requiring onsite presence at our **Fort Mill SC** office **2–3 days per week**, as much of the team and leadership are based there. **Pay Range:** $40\.10\-$66\.83/hour### Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer! **Company Overview:** LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor\-mediated marketplace(6\) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2\.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. Join the LPL team and help us make a difference by turning life’s aspirations into financial realities. Please log in or create an account to apply to this position. Principals only. EOE. **Information on Interviews:** LPL will only communicate with a job applicant directly from an **@lplfinancial.com** email address and will never conduct an interview online or in a chatroom forum. During an interview, LPL will not request any form of payment from the applicant, or information regarding an applicant’s bank or credit card. Should you have any questions regarding the application process, please contact LPL’s Human Resources Solutions Center at (855\) 575\-6947\. EAC 5\.19\.26
