jobs.description: **Position Overview:** This position is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting enterprise integrations across ODL Oracle Cloud Applications and internal or external business systems. The role focus is on building and secure, scalable, and reliable end\-to\-end integration solutions using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) among other technologies. The position works closely with cross\-functional teams to analyze business requirements, architect and implement integration strategies, troubleshoot issues, and ensure future high performance and compatibility with ongoing system updates. **Who We Are:** Driven by continual innovation and trusted partnerships, ODL is a global leader in high\-quality door and insulated glass solutions. For decades, our purpose has been simple: **Make Your Life Better™**—for our customers, our communities, and our people. With 14 global locations and thousands of employees, ODL has been recognized as a **Great Place to Work®** across all countries of operation. We invest in our people, celebrate growth, and foster a culture where accountability, innovation, and excellence thrive. **Essential Job Functions:** * Administer Oracle Integration Cloud to support integrations within the ODL application architecture. * Administer security and configuration in the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. * Independently, efficiently, and effectively self\-manage priorities, tasks, and small projects. * Collaborate cross\-functionally to gather information and provide analysis of goals, complexity/feasibility, resource, cost, and time. * Design, develop, implement, and monitor integrations solutions. * Provide technical support and resolve issues related to Oracle Fusion Cloud application integrations. * Define, implement, and follow best practices for integrations to ensure future upgrade and release compatibility. * Identify risks, problems, or opportunities in existing applications integrations and develop solutions to continuously improve, to mitigate challenges, to ensure operational stability, and to ensure scalability and overall solution effectiveness and efficiency. * Ensure quality of development deliverables by applying proven testing methodologies. * Maintain comprehensive documentation of customizations, configurations, and integrations. * Stay updated with Oracle Fusion Cloud updates, patches, and new features. * Build and maintain strong relationships with the business. * Build and maintain Integration roadmaps with high quality and on\-time execution. * Continuously improve your knowledge and skills in Oracle Fusion Cloud technologies, keeping apprised of and making recommendations based on new developments, opportunities and offerings in the vendor ecosystem. * Evaluate emerging integration and middleware technologies and recommend adoption where it creates business value. * Train and mentor others, guiding based on project requirements and best practices; Provide oversight and coordination with external partners. **Experience and Education****:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience. * 5\+ years of experience in Software engineering with a focus on data integration, data processing, data quality, data migration and data governance. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud and Oracle SOA Suite. * Experience using Oracle tools and technologies such as VBCS, BIP, OTBI, CMK, ADW, PL/SQL, SOAP, REST, XML, JSON. * Knowledgeable with EDI * Experience with multiple systems in the Oracle Cloud Application Suite (Preferred: ERP, SCM, OTM, WMS, OCC, CPQ, FDI, EPM). * Experience working with other leading cloud\-based data warehouses and platforms. – Preferred * Certification in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). – Preferred * Excellent written/verbal communication and listening skills. * Demonstrated fast learner, strong analytical and problem\-solving track record; able to independently own backlog, lead solutions and develop action plans and roadmaps. * Proven experience challenging the status quo and implementing continuous improvements to technology products, services and processes. * Possesses flexibility to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment. **What you’ll get:** * Health, Dental, and Vision insurance * Prescription Plan * 401(k) with company match * Tuition Reimbursement * Disability Plan * Paid Vacation and 10 Holidays * Health Club Reimbursement * Bonus program * Wellness program **Shift** First Shift (United States of America)

Recognize and be recognized! We celebrate service anniversaries and offer spot performance bonus opportunities to show our appreciation. * We will train you intensively in the areas of technology, processes \& soft skills and you can exchange ideas with experienced colleagues at any time. **Apply today to join us and build what’s next!.** If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day. Today, the Data Platform team solves challenges and enables: * Streaming analytics * Interactive end\-user reporting * Data and ML platform for Okta to scale * Telemetry of our products and data Our elite team is fast, creative and flexible. We encourage ownership. We expect great things from our engineers and reward them with stimulating new projects, new technologies and the chance to have significant equity in a company. Okta is about to change the cloud computing landscape forever. ### **About the Position** This is an opportunity for experienced Software Engineers to join our fast growing Data Platform organization that is passionate about scaling high volume, low\-latency, distributed data\-platform services \& data products. Brings the right attitude to the team: ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and customer focus. * Track record of delivering work incrementally to get feedback and iterating over solutions. * Comfortable in React or similar front\-end UI stacks; if not comfortable yet, you are willing to learn ### **Nice to have** * Experience using a cloud\-based distributed computing technologies such as * + Messaging systems such as Kinesis, Kafka + Data processing systems like Flink, Spark, Beam + Storage \& Compute systems such as Snowflake, Hadoop + Coordinators and schedulers like the ones in Kubernetes, Hadoop, Mesos * Maintained security, encryption, identity management, or authentication infrastructure * Leveraged major public cloud providers to build mission\-critical, high volume services * Hands\-on experience in developing Data Integration applications for large scale (petabyte scale) environments with experience in both batch and online systems. * Contributed to the development of distributed systems or used one or more at high volume or criticality such as Kafka or Hadoop **Additional requirements:** * There is no citizenship requirement. In addition, Okta offers equity (where applicable), bonus, and benefits, including health, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), flexible spending account, and paid leave (including PTO and parental leave) in accordance with our applicable plans and policies. To learn more about our Total Rewards program please visit: https://rewards.okta.com/us. The annual base salary range for this position for candidates located in California (excluding San Francisco Bay Area), Colorado, Illinois, New York, and Washington is between:$147,000—$202,000 USD **The Okta Experience** * Supporting Your Well\-Being * Driving Social Impact * Developing Talent and Fostering Connection \+ Community We are intentional about connection. Your journey begins with an immersive, in\-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one. Okta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!** We are Optimum, a leader in the fast\-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is no longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high\-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities. If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you! **Job Summary** --------------- Seeking a highly skilled **IP Network Engineer** to design, implement, and maintain advanced networks. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in IP routing, and a proven ability to manage complex network projects. The Network Engineer will be responsible for optimizing the performance of high\-capacity IP networks, ensuring scalability, reliability, and minimal latency. Ability to plan, design and engineer regional multi\-state network, which include Layer I, II and III , aggregate infrastructure, and MPLS technologies. Conduct and participate in the evaluation and validation of new equipment, software releases, and document procedures for implementation in the network infrastructure. Work with team to build/re\-use open source or common systems wherever possible to accelerate development and delivery of new services and value\-added features in production network. Provide diagnosis, resolution, and documentation in all aspects of supporting, implementing and managing a core network environment consisting of IOS\-XR and IOS. Resolve hardware and software network problems in a timely and accurate manner. Provide engineering guidelines and Network Support to Fulfillment and Operations to roll out new hardware and services to our customers. Work with the Application Support team to capture new product requirements in network tools and defining the parameters needed for service activation. Perform failure analysis of all service impacting hardware, software, and application related failures. A strong focus on ensuring we deliver the best experience for all customers. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Performs engineering activities with specific knowledge and skills associated with the following technologies: + IP Routing Protocols and technologies such as: OSPF, ISIS, BGP, MPLS\-TE, QoS Capabilities + IP Backbone capacity management and traffic engineering (TE) + Core IP routing technologies and vendors, specifically Cisco and Nokia + IPv4 and IPv6 subnetting and address planning for large\-scale ISP networks * Develops and executes detailed network designs, specifications, and architectural plans for IP Backbone architectures in support of ISP and commercial service delivery infrastructure, including BGP, OSPF, RSVP, LDP, and quality of service architectures. * Creates test plans; tests and validates functionality, management, and performance for existing and new technologies supporting metro, regional, and backbone IP networks. * Designs and tests for IP service integration, including internet, VPN, VoIP, and video delivery services over IP/MPLS networks. * Determines, tests, and validates code functionality to be used in the production network for all IP routers and various Ethernet switches across multiple vendors. * Conducts equipment evaluations, equipment selection, pilot testing, and network designs to ensure reliability and scaled expansion of the network. * Supports deployments of new IP services, systems, applications, and architectures with strict adherence to SLAs and change management policies. * Partners with change management for impact identification, network validation, MOP creation and execution of activities in a live production ISP network. * Defines and compiles methods, procedures, and documentation to support personnel in the installation, maintenance, and removal of network equipment. * Coordinates with regions to ensure the network is available and configured to exceed market demand and customer growth requirements. * Applies best practices pertaining to router security design, including authentication, access lists, and control plane protection. * Acts as an escalation from our NOC for critical network incidents and customer\-impacting outages. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or equivalent * CCNP required or equivalent experience; CCIE plus * Experience working in a Service Provider / ISP environment supporting commercial or enterprise services * Experience with routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, ISIS) * Experience with MPLS\-TE, L2VPN, L3VPN, and traffic engineering concepts * Experience with IPv4 and IPv6 * Experience writing Engineering guidelines and procedures * Familiarity with fiber optic technology and transport networks * Scripting languages are recommended (such as BASH, Python, etc.) * Strong interpersonal and communication skills * Ability to work in a 24x7 operational environment with on\-call rotation * Proven ability to troubleshoot large\-scale outages under pressure and meet SLA commitments At Optimum, every action and interaction we take part in, is driven by our three Guiding Principles: Do What’s Right, Drive One Optimum, and Make It Happen. These aren’t just words, they help us build trust, create real community, and embrace new ways of thinking. Our employees are empowered to do the right thing for our customers and co\-workers and to recognize and reward these behaviors when we see them. It’s all part of the bigger picture of “Be The Difference” where each employee knows they have the power to enact real change, share new ideas, and understand that learning never stop. If you have the drive to succeed and are ready to embark on a thrilling career, seize this opportunity today, and join our winning team. Together, we'll shape the future of connectivity. jobs.title: Manager, Core Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description: Job Description Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building some of the world's largest and most advanced GPU clusters to power the next generation of AI. The Strategic Customer Engineering (SCE) Core Infrastructure team—also known as the AI/ML Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineering team—provides white\-glove engineering and operational support to OCI's most strategic AI/ML infrastructure customers. As a trusted partner to our customers, we play a critical role in designing, deploying, operating, and optimizing the infrastructure that powers some of the largest and most demanding GPU and AI/ML environments in the world. Our team works closely with customers and internal engineering organizations to ensure exceptional reliability, performance, and scalability for mission\-critical AI workloads. We are seeking a Manager to lead and develop a class of early\-career Infrastructure Engineers. This leader will create the conditions for new professionals to build sound technical judgment, strong customer habits, and the practical skills required to support strategic AI/ML infrastructure customers on OCI. The manager will combine people leadership with hands\-on operational guidance, helping the class grow into effective engineers who can independently contribute to customer execution, automation, troubleshooting, and infrastructure performance. \#LI\-ES2 Lead, mentor, and develop a class of early\-career Engineers, setting clear expectations for technical growth, customer engagement, quality, and ownership. Design and run an onboarding and development program that gives early\-career professionals progressive experience with GPU cluster deployment, Slurm and/or Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE), automation, monitoring, multicloud, database and operational readiness. Provide regular coaching, feedback, career guidance, and practical learning opportunities. Pair team members with appropriate mentors and create stretch assignments that build confidence and sound engineering judgment. Guide the team in building collaborative relationships with OCI Services, customers, sales, and core engineering teams. Model clear technical communication and help team members become effective, trusted customer partners. Establish a safe, accountable environment where early\-career professionals learn to take ownership of problems, investigate issues thoroughly, document risks, and escalate with context when needed. Coach team members on infrastructure performance fundamentals, including parameter tuning, resource utilization, caching, and data pre\-processing techniques for AI/ML workloads. Oversee the team's approach to troubleshooting performance, scalability, and reliability issues. Review complex cases, remove barriers, and ensure lessons learned are incorporated into team practices. Ensure the team documents infrastructure designs, configurations, runbooks, and procedures so knowledge is shared, work is maintainable, and new professionals can learn from repeatable practices. Help team members develop into credible customer advocates who can explain advanced GPU solution best practices and support customers and partners as they migrate workloads to the cloud. Partner with senior technical leaders to calibrate the class's development progress, staffing needs, and readiness for increasingly independent customer\-facing and engineering responsibilities. **Qualifications:** 7\+ years of relevant infrastructure, cloud, platform, or software engineering experience, including experience leading or mentoring engineers. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to coach early\-career professionals and translate technical concepts for customers, partners, and non\-technical stakeholders. Demonstrated people\-management, mentoring, or talent\-development skills, with a thoughtful and consistent approach to feedback and performance management. Experience building, operating, or supporting distributed and cloud infrastructure solutions in a customer\-focused environment. Demonstrated ability to: * Develop short\-, medium\-, and long\-term development plans that connect individual growth to team and business objectives. * Work across functional areas with senior leaders and technical partners to secure opportunities, support, and clear expectations for an early\-career class. Influence through coaching, sound judgment, and clear communication in situations involving competing priorities or sensitive feedback. * BS or MS degree, or equivalent experience, relevant to the functional area. Working knowledge of infrastructure automation and orchestration tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, Docker, Kubernetes, and related tooling. Solid understanding of networking concepts, security principles, and operational best practices. Excellent problem\-solving skills, with the ability to guide others through structured troubleshooting and drive timely resolution in a fast\-paced environment. Strong Linux skills with hands\-on experience in Oracle Linux/RHEL/CentOS, Ubuntu, or Debian, including system administration, package management, shell scripting, and performance optimization. Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Rust, Go, Java, or Scala, and the ability to use code reviews and pairing to develop others. Experience designing, implementing, managing, or supporting infrastructure for AI/ML, HPC, GPU, or similarly complex cloud workloads. **Core Responsibilities** **Planning \& Execution:** Plan and guide the class's work across onboarding, customer support, automation, and development goals. Set clear priorities, assign work that matches each person's readiness, monitor delivery, and adjust learning plans as business needs change. **Collaboration \& Partnership:** Build productive cross\-functional partnerships that give early\-career professionals access to the expertise and context they need. Model inclusive collaboration, actively seek diverse perspectives, and help the team communicate expectations clearly with stakeholders and customers. **Problem Solving:** Coach the team to analyze operational and technical issues using sound problem\-solving practices. Review complex or ambiguous cases, help identify root causes, and turn lessons learned into guidance that prevents recurrence. **Continuous Learning:** Create structured opportunities for team members to build expertise through training, paired work, technical reviews, and hands\-on customer scenarios. Track individual skill growth, identify gaps early, and reinforce a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous learning. **Continuous Improvement:** Enable the team to improve processes, protocols, runbooks, and workflows. Gather feedback from early\-career professionals and partners, prioritize practical improvements, and help the team learn how to turn ideas into durable operational practices. **Performance and Development:** Drive consistent performance and development through timely, specific feedback, regular coaching, and clear growth expectations. Support hiring, onboarding, talent reviews, and promotion readiness in partnership with leadership and HR, while aligning individual development plans to organizational needs.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Europe; Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Department** -------------- Software Engineering AI companies need inference that’s fast, reliable, and economical at scale. Parasail delivers it. We’re building an enterprise\-grade inference cloud for open\-weight models where customers pay for the tokens they use, and we handle everything required to serve them. Behind one OpenAI\-compatible API, we pool GPU capacity from providers around the world and continuously optimize where and how workloads run. That means turning a changing mix of hardware, networks, and infrastructure into a service customers can trust. We’ve raised a $32 million Series A, and we’re scaling beyond trillions of tokens a day. You’ll have the ownership and reach to shape how we get there. **The Role** ------------ At Parasail, reliability is an engineering problem that spans the entire stack. A GPU fails. A provider goes down. Traffic spikes. Customers still expect their inference to work. We’re hiring Site Reliability Engineers to build the systems that make that possible. You’ll own infrastructure across our global GPU fleet, write software that automates operations, and make the platform better at detecting, surviving, and recovering from failures. You’ll work directly with infrastructure, platform, and inference engineers in a flat organization. We welcome SREs, software engineers, platform engineers, and systems engineers who want to build ambitious systems and take responsibility for how they perform in production. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Scale a global GPU fleet.** Build and improve the Kubernetes infrastructure behind provisioning, networking, storage, and service deployment across providers and regions. * **Make failure survivable.** Design better isolation, failover, and recovery so hardware and infrastructure failures have less impact on customers. * **Build software that runs infrastructure.** Automate capacity expansion, deployments, and maintenance, eliminating manual work and making changes safer. * **Make the system understandable.** Develop observability and diagnostics that reveal bottlenecks, surface failures, and help engineers act quickly. * **Own the production feedback loop.** Respond to incidents, get to the root cause, and turn what you learn into stronger systems. * **Push the platform forward.** Work across the stack to improve performance, utilization, security, and reliability as inference demand grows. **What You Bring** ------------------ * Experience building and operating production infrastructure or distributed systems, with real ownership of reliability. * Strong Linux fundamentals and practical knowledge of networking, storage, and containers. * Hands\-on experience running Kubernetes in production. * The ability to write maintainable software and automation to solve infrastructure problems. * A systematic approach to debugging problems that cross application, cluster, network, and hardware boundaries. * Good judgment about when to move quickly, when to simplify, and where reliability matters most. * The initiative to take a problem from investigation through implementation and work closely with teammates along the way. Your strongest skill might be software development, distributed systems, or infrastructure operations. We’re building a team with complementary strengths; your previous job title matters less than what you can build and own. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with multi\-region, multi\-provider, or bare\-metal infrastructure. * Familiarity with GPUs, model serving, or inference systems such as vLLM or SGLang. * Experience with infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, or automated recovery. * Experience building highly available services, multi\-tenant platforms, or distributed data systems. **Why Join Parasail** --------------------- The systems you build will determine how reliably and efficiently customers can run AI in production. You’ll work close to the hardware, deep in distributed systems, and alongside engineers optimizing the inference stack. This is a small team tackling problems at substantial scale. You’ll own meaningful architecture decisions, ship improvements directly into production, and help build the foundation for the next stage of AI infrastructure.

jobs.description: **Purpose in Every Position** Pebl puts a world of talent at your fingertips. With our AI\-powered Global Work Platform, companies can hire, pay, and manage employees in 185\+ countries—removing risk, red tape, and guesswork from global growth. Backed by more than a decade of compliance leadership and local expertise, Pebl helps businesses move fast, stay compliant, and scale with confidence. With Pebl, companies everywhere can hire great talent anywhere. **Where Your Work Moves the Needle.** At Pebl, every team member drives our success. Joining us means more than filling a role—you’re accountable for results and impact. Our values guide how we operate, execute, and collaborate across borders. By putting them into action, you’ll help us scale faster, compete harder, and lead the future of global work. **What Makes You a Great Fit** Pebl moves over a billion dollars across 180\+ countries to make sure each employee gets paid every cent on time. In order to achieve this, Pebl needs both a consistent money movement system to pay out payroll cross border, and a flexible invoicing system to facilitate Pebl customers with the exact amount they need to pay. Every country and every customer’s requirements are different, and so navigating complex forms and dashboards are critical. The more intuitive and straightforward this experience is, the more stress free people can look to pay and get paid. We’re a primarily backend focused team with fullstack capabilities, and are looking for someone to really take our domain’s frontend user experience to the next level. We’re searching for a frontend engineer that knows how to bring the user experience to life, but understands how to navigate the entire stack all the way to the database and infrastructure level. They’ll work closely with product and design to transform what at times is boring and frustrating as bank forms and invoice dashboards into something delightful, while collaborating closely with other engineers on the team to stitch together a stable system and set the standard for effective frontend practices. They should prioritize simplicity and reliability in the face of unknown complexities, while also understanding when to make necessary, clear\-eyed tradeoffs to create business impact effectively. If that sounds like you, we’d love to have you on board. ***This role will require in\-office collaboration Monday\-Wednesday in our Palo Alto, CA office.*** **How You’ll Make an Impact:** * Design and build new features that allow users to engage with their paycheck through different financial means * Enhance and reimagine the UX interface for how our users provide their financial information, and how they engage with their monetary accounts associated with their job * Build seamless 3rd party integrations with payment vendors that help enhance Pebl’s capabilities and abilities to pay our users * Sharpen and delight our customers experience invoices to provide rich and robust data and insights * Establish and standardize the frontend best practices for the invoice and payments domain, creating clean, reusable code, readable documentation, and replicable practices. * Be the voice of expertise concerning frontend in a primarily fullstack and backend focused team **Let’s Connect If You Have:** * 8\+ years of professional frontend/UX software engineering experience * 1\+ years of experience building frontends and API frameworks for invoicing or financial systems, or 2\+ years building frontends in a domain with either complex forms and dashboards * Strong command of modern frontend (React/TypeScript) paired with a solid understanding of how frontends integrate with backend services and APIs * Thorough understanding of frontend best practice design patterns and frameworks, and the expertise to dictate best practices for the team while working cross team in an established frontend system * Proven experience working with designers and product managers to go from wireframes and mockups to frontend code that is reusable, scalable, and intuitive to use. * Work with complex forms, such as country or use case specific form generation or validation, is a major plus. * Experience with AWS, PostgresQL or similar RDBMS systems, and Kubernetes. Comfort and willingness to work across the full stack is critical (backend, infra). While 80\-90% of your work will be frontend and API work, this isn’t a pure frontend role. * A flexible but opinionated mindset \- focus on delivering iterative customer impact in a fast paced environment, but also standing firm on building reliably and with an eye for the future. “Strong opinions, held loosely” is the mantra. **Our Commitment to You** At Pebl, we’re committed to supporting our team with comprehensive rewards and benefits designed to meet diverse needs across roles and locations. Our core offerings include: * **Flexible Time Off** – Take the time you need to recharge. * **Parental Leave** – Support for growing families. * **Health and Dental Insurance** – Where applicable, to cover you and your loved ones. * **Retirement Savings \+ Employee Incentive Plan** – Plan for the future while sharing our success. Please visit our career page for more information. **Pebl is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We power global teams and believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and impact. Employment decisions at Pebl are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive and do the best work of their career—anywhere in the world. Compensation Range: $145,600 \- $201,204

jobs.description: Are you an aspiring civil\-structural design engineer or a soon\-to\-be engineering graduate seeking an opportunity to grow your career with hands\-on mentorship and professional development? * A team\-oriented mindset and a willingness to learn from experienced engineers. * Knowledge of basic structural principles and a desire to deepen your understanding of design codes/standards and materials. * Strong communication skills, including technical writing. * Motivation to grow professionally and tackle new challenges. * Willingness to travel occasionally and participate in fieldwork. * A valid U.S. driver’s license, a good driving record, and vehicle insurance. * Legal authorization to work in the United States without employer sponsorship. **Benefits, Perks, and Office Culture** PND offers one of the strongest benefits packages in the industry, including: * Competitive base salary * All overtime paid at 1\.5x the regular hourly rate * Discretionary bonuses * Exceptional, employer\-funded 401(k) profit\-sharing retirement plan—no match required * Comprehensive medical plans * Employer\-paid dental, vision, and life insurance * Disability insurance * 18\-22 days of paid time off and 9 paid holidays annually * Tuition/education assistance up to $3,500 per calendar year Our Anchorage office also values a collegial, connected workplace culture, including biweekly office donuts and bagels and monthly catered all\-office meetings, winter and summer holiday parties, and opportunities to participate in community activities. **About PND** Founded in Alaska in 1979, PND Engineers also has offices in Washington, Oregon, Texas, and Canada. We’re known for our innovation, multidisciplinary expertise, and ability to deliver projects in some of the world’s toughest environments. If you’re ready to bring your skills and make an impact, we want to talk. PND Engineers, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Advanced Computing Growth Marketer
jobs.description: About Parallel Works Parallel Works builds and operates ACTIVATE, a control plane for high performance computing and AI. Our customers run large scientific and AI workloads across on\-premises clusters, government and commercial cloud, and commercial GPU providers, and ACTIVATE gives them one way to access and manage it all. Our technology supports organizations working across weather and climate, defense, aerospace, energy, scientific research, and AI. We are a small technology company, so our team works closely with customers to understand what they are trying to accomplish and how computing infrastructure can help them get there. About the role Parallel Works is hiring an Advanced Computing Growth Marketer to grow awareness of ACTIVATE and generate demand across the HPC, AI, and advanced computing markets. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can understand complex technology and turn it into clear, compelling campaigns and content. You will work across digital marketing, content, events, partner marketing, and sales enablement, with significant opportunity to shape how Parallel Works goes to market. You do not need to be an HPC engineer, but you should be comfortable learning technical concepts and communicating with technical and business audiences. What you will do* Build and execute campaigns that generate awareness, leads, and pipeline across HPC, AI, cloud, and public sector markets. * Create website copy, emails, social content, blogs, case studies, presentations, and other marketing materials. * Translate technical concepts and product capabilities into clear messaging for different audiences. * Develop sales enablement materials that help communicate ACTIVATE's capabilities and value. * Build co\-marketing programs with cloud providers, technology partners, and channel partners. * Support conferences, trade shows, webinars, and customer events, including promotion and follow\-up. * Track campaign performance and use results to improve future marketing efforts. **Requirements** Requirements* 3\+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in technology, enterprise software, cloud, infrastructure, or a related market. * Experience executing digital, content, email, social, or demand generation campaigns. * Strong writing skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly. * Experience creating marketing content and sales enablement materials. * Comfortable owning multiple projects from idea through execution. You do not need every item on this list. If you have most of it and are interested in advanced computing, we encourage you to apply. Preferred Qualifications* Experience marketing HPC, AI infrastructure, cloud computing, GPU computing, enterprise infrastructure, or related technologies. * Experience marketing to technical audiences. * Account\-based marketing or demand generation experience. * Experience with technology or channel partner marketing. * Federal, national laboratory, research computing, or public sector marketing experience. * Experience working at an early\-stage or small technology company. **Benefits** Medical, vision, and dental coverage, a 401(k) with company match, short\-term disability, and generous paid vacation and sick time. Equal employment opportunity Parallel Works is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: AI Workflow & Skills Engineer
jobs.description: About Parker Poe Parker Poe is a business law firm that advises clients on the decisions that define them and the moments in between. Rooted in the Southeast, the firm is committed to providing exceptional client experiences and practical solutions, with the national and international reach to serve clients wherever their business takes them. Our firm offers a career experience built around deep relationships, sophisticated work, collaboration, mentoring, professional development, community, and growth. Position Summary Parker Poe is seeking an AI Workflow \& Skills Engineer to help transform how our attorneys and business professionals work by building custom AI agents, automations, and productivity tools. In this innovative role, you’ll take workflow requirements and turn them into practical, user\-friendly solutions. This is a high\-visibility opportunity to build AI solutions that move from concept to production. Working closely with our AI Enablement Manager and cross\-functional teams, you’ll design, test, deploy, and continuously improve AI\-powered tools that streamline legal work, enhance productivity, and deliver meaningful business value. This role is ideal for someone who is a creative problem\-solver who enjoys building with emerging technologies and wants to play a key role in shaping the future of AI at Parker Poe. This full\-time, exempt position may be based in any Parker Poe office, with a preference for Charlotte, North Carolina and will require periodic travel to support firmwide initiatives. Essential Duties and Responsibilities AI Solution Development * Translate attorney workflows and business needs into practical AI\-powered tools, automations, and solutions. * Build, test, and iterate on custom AI skills and agents using tools such as Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot and related agentic frameworks. * Integrate AI tools with the firm's existing technology ecosystem, creating seamless workflows across document management, practice management, email/calendaring, e\-signature, SharePoint, and other key business platforms. * Develop reusable prompt libraries, templates, and scalable components that accelerate AI adoption and enable solutions to be deployed across multiple practice groups. Quality, Governance and Documentation * Ensure AI solutions are production\-ready through rigorous testing, validation, and quality reviews focused on accuracy, reliability, responsible AI use, and minimizing hallucination risk. * Partner with IT, Information Security, and Risk/Compliance to ensure all tools safeguard client information and comply with firm policies and regulatory requirements. * Create clear documentation and implementation guidance that supports user adoption, ongoing maintenance, and limitations for internal reference. Adoption, Support and Continuous Improvement * Assist attorneys and business professionals in embracing AI technologies through training, best\-practice recommendations, and ongoing support. * Manage and prioritize a portfolio of AI initiatives, focusing on solutions that deliver the greatest value to attorneys and align with firm strategic goals. * Monitor the performance and adoption of AI solutions, leveraging user feedback and data\-driven insights to drive continuous improvement and innovation. * Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications * Associate’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and IT experience. * Experience in a law firm, professional services, or other regulated environment is preferred, particularly where confidentiality and data governance are critical. * Experience building and optimizing AI\-powered solutions using Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or similar large language model (LLM\-based) platforms, including prompt engineering, custom instructions, and agent/tool configuration. * Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams. * Familiarity with legal workflows and legal technology preferred. * Experience working with application programming interfaces (APIs), automation tools, and scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript, or similar technologies to connect AI solutions with business systems and workflows. * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent AI development efforts, communicate clear timelines, and improve solutions through iterative testing and user feedback. * Strong ability to translate business requirements into practical solutions, proactively seeking clarification, identifying gaps, and driving execution. * Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and customer\-service skills, with the ability to provide responsive, solutions\-oriented support. * Excellent attention to detail and a quality\-first mindset. Traits for Success This role is ideal for someone who loves building with emerging technologies, solving complex challenges, and creating real\-world solutions. They are equally comfortable navigating ambiguity, collaborating with stakeholders, and driving projects forward. We are looking for someone who is: * A creative problem\-solver who enjoys transforming complex business challenges into user\-friendly AI solutions. * A quality\-focused builder who takes pride in creating accurate, reliable, and well\-designed solutions that users trust. * A proactive self\-starter who can navigate evolving requirements, ask thoughtful questions, and move projects forward with confidence. * A collaborative partner who works effectively with attorneys, cross\-functional teams, and stakeholders to deliver meaningful results. * A lifelong learner who is passionate about AI, emerging technologies, and continuously improving the way people work. Parker Poe is an Equal Opportunity Employer and makes recruitment, employment, promotional and all other personnel decisions without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Penn Mutual is seeking a **Senior Site Reliability Engineer** (Senior SRE) to help evolve reliability practices across business\-critical systems in a highly regulated financial services environment. This role is a hands\-on technical leader responsible for designing, implementing, and advancing reliability across complex, distributed systems. You will deliver reliability strategy through automation, observability, and architectural guidance while remaining hands\-on in development, release, and incident triage. Senior SREs operate with significant autonomy, tackle ambiguous problems, and influence system design upstream with the overall goal of delivering change in reliable and measurable ways to key stakeholders. **Key Responsibilities** **Reliability Strategy \& Architecture** * Lead reliability availability, scalability, and recovery design for critical systems. * Define and evolve SLOs, SLIs, and error budget practices across services. * Identify systemic reliability risks and drive cross\-team remediation efforts. * Influence application and platform architecture to improve operational outcomes. **Advanced Incident Management** * Act as a technical lead during major incidents and complex outages. * Drive high\-quality root cause analysis and recommend corrective actions. * Improve incident response processes, tooling, and runbooks. **Automation \& Engineering Excellence** * Design and implement advanced automation to eliminate operational toil at scale. * Build and maintain shared SRE tooling and platforms. * Set engineering standards for reliability\-focused code and operational practices. * Review and improve CI/CD, deployment, and rollback strategies. **Release \& Change Leadership** * Partner with Release and Change Management to automate release practices. * Lead risk assessments for high impact changes and releases. * Ensure compliance requirements are met without sacrificing engineering velocity. * Serve as a reliability authority for release readiness decisions. **Mentorship \& Influence** * Mentor junior SREs and junior engineers through technical guidance and review. * Lead by example in operational excellence and engineering rigor. * Influence reliability culture across engineering and product teams. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. * 6–10\+ years of experience in SRE, software engineering, platform, or DevOps roles. * Professional experience in performing root cause analysis on incidents, documenting SRE systems and usage. * Strong programming skills with professional experience in multiple languages. * Deep experience with AWS and distributed systems. * Advanced knowledge of observability, ITSM, and reliability engineering principles. * Proven ability to operate effectively in complex, regulated environments. * Experience with use/implementation of observability tools (metrics, logs, tracing) * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation. * Experience with Root Cause Analysis investigation/documentation * Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies. * Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with IaC (CloudFormation). * Experience with application frameworks (Spring, Spring Boot, React, Angular) * Experience with application servers/containers (Tomcat, Netty, Node.JS, Next.JS) * Experience with relational and non\-relational databases and related ORM/drivers. * Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. * Experience with ITSM tools (ServiceNow or similar). * Experience with ITIL\-aligned change and release processes. * Familiarity of security compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2\). Base Salary Range \- $128,000\-$165,000 For over 175 years, Penn Mutual has empowered individuals, families and businesses on the journey to achieve their financial goals. Penn Mutual and its affiliates offer a comprehensive suite of competitive products and services to meet the unique needs of Financial Professionals and their clients, including life insurance, annuities, wealth management and institutional asset management. jobs.title: Critical Infrastructure Learning Specialist
jobs.description: **ABOUT PER SCHOLAS:** For 30 years, Per Scholas has been on a mission to drive mobility and opportunity in the ever\-advancing technology landscape by unlocking the untapped potential of individuals, uplifting communities, and meeting the needs of employers through rigorous tech training. By teaming up with dynamic employer partners, ranging from Fortune 500 companies to innovative startups, we're forging inclusive tech talent pipelines, fulfilling an ever\-increasing need for skilled talent. With national remote training and campuses in 20\+ cities and counting, Per Scholas offers no\-cost training programs in the most sought\-after tech skills, spanning Cloud, Cybersecurity, Data Engineering, IT Support, Software Engineering, and more. To date, 30,000\+ individuals have been trained through Per Scholas, propelling their professional trajectories into high\-growth tech careers with salaries three times higher than their pre\-training earnings. Learn more by visiting PerScholas.org and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube. **Per Scholas candidates must reside in one of the following states, provided the position does not carry a specific office location requirement:** AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, MD, MA, MI, MO, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TX, WA. **Position Title:** Critical Infrastructure Learning Specialist **Office:** Silver Spring, MD **Work Modality:** Onsite **Work Type:** Contract **Duration**: 3\-6 Months **Hourly Rate**: $26\-29/hr **WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR** Per Scholas is seeking a Critical Infrastructure Learning Specialist to become a member of our National Training Team. The ideal candidate is a technically strong, safety\-minded professional who can support the lead instructor in translating complex electrical and mechanical systems into structured, high\-quality learning experiences. This learning specialist must understand how mission\-critical infrastructure operates in data center environments and possess the ability to teach learners how to operate, monitor, and troubleshoot those systems responsibly. The right candidate is not only technically competent but also able to instill operational discipline, risk awareness, and professional accountability in adult learners preparing for uptime\-sensitive environments. To succeed in this role, candidates must be business\-minded within our mission focus and excel in instructional delivery that meets clients' and learners' high expectations. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Assist the Critical Infrastructure Expert Trainer in delivering instructor\-led training that prepares students for entry\-level to mid\-level careers as Critical Facilities Technicians/Engineers in data center environments and, when necessary, deliver specific training modules as assigned by the lead instructor.. Responsibilities include assistance in daily instruction, assessment administration, attendance tracking, one\-on\-one tutoring, daily evaluation and monitoring of individual student progress, and consistent enforcement of classroom and lab standards. * Assist the instructor in teaching foundational and intermediate technical concepts, including: * + Electrical distribution systems (3\-phase power, switchgear, PDUs) + Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems + Backup generators and Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS) + Cooling systems (CRAC/CRAH, chillers, hydronic loops, coolant distribution units) + Building Management Systems (BMS) and DCIM platforms * Assist in the facilitated hands\-on lab exercises involving electrical panels, monitoring simulations, and mechanical systems while enforcing OSHA and NFPA\-aligned safety practices. * Assist in the evaluation of student troubleshooting performance using scenario\-based diagnostics and structured performance checklists. * Provide students with relevant supplemental resources for deeper learning on technical systems, industry certifications, and best practices. * Dedicate capacity (e.g., 10% of non\-instructional time) to professional development, technical upskilling, curriculum modernization, and contributing to the product's retrospective/evaluation cycle * Work closely with the instructional and curriculum development teams to provide feedback on lab effectiveness, learner pain points, and content clarity. * Maintain and update Salesforce and/or our LMS with student grades, certification scores, attendance, and performance notes. * Support and maintain training curricula, syllabi, lesson plans, and classroom materials, identifying areas for improvement based on delivery experience. **WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO US** ***Instructional Skill Sets*** * 2\-5\+ years of working in data centers as a Critical Facility Engineer/Technician * 1\-3 years of instructional skills teaching technical subjects to technicians and operators. * Strong technical background; able to grasp highly technical subject matter and effectively support its conveyance to learners during instruction and lab sessions * Ability to respond clearly t written skills. * You are tech\-savvy and learn new tools quickly. * You are detail\-oriented, with exceptional organizational management skills. * You have strong public speaking and interpersonal skills. You are a motivator who is personable, approachable, and socially engaging. You can cultivate relationships and build rapport quickly and authentically with people from various professional and cultural backgrounds. * You are adept at managing your time and balancing multiple projects and tasks. * You stand behind our mission, believing that individuals from any community should have access to well\-paying career positions and that talent should be recognized and recruited from diverse sources. ### **COMPENSATION** For this role specifically, we are targeting a hourly rate rate of $26\-29/hr. Final compensation may vary based on several factors including geographic location, experience, and alignment with qualifications. \#LI\-Onsite **Benefits \& Perks** Per Scholas offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well\-being, and overall quality of life! **Holidays \& PTO:** Full\-TimePer Scholas team members enjoy **over 40 days** of paid time off each year through a mix of holidays, vacation, and sick/personal time! All employees are eligible for Holiday pay upon hire (a total of 22 holidays annually, including **a week off for Independence day** and **a week before the New Year**). Full\-Time Benefits Eligible employees also receive 80 Wellness Hours to use for Sick, Safe, or Personal reasons and accrue Vacation at a rate of 8 hours at the beginning of every month, supporting rest, recharge, and work\-life balance. Vacation accruals increase with tenure. Part\-time employees are afforded time off on a prorated basis and in accordance with local requirements. **Comprehensive Medical Coverage**: Benefit eligible employees can choose from multiple medical plans through Cigna or Kaiser Permanente (where available), with options to fit your needs. Eligible employees also have access to a Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) that reimburses eligible out\-of\-pocket expenses, up to $4,000 for individuals and $8,000 for families. **Dental and Vision Insurance**: Eligible employees can select from two dental plan options and a vision plan. Employees who waive medical coverage receive employer paid dental and vision premiums. **Retirement Savings:** 401(k) plan with a current 100% employer match on contributions up to 6%, eligible employees are offered entry and full vesting after 90 days with the company. **Employee Assistance Program (EAP)**: Free, confidential, 24/7 access to counseling, legal support, and financial resources for employees and their household members **Parental Leave:** Eligible employees are offered up to 6 weeks of 100% paid parental leave to support employees as they welcome a new child and bond with their family. **Additional Benefits \& Perks:** Eligible employees have access to employer\-paid life and AD\&D Insurance, as well as employer\-paid short\-term disability coverage, with the option to elect additional life coverage and long\-term disability insurance. Flexible Spending accounts are available for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting expenses. Per Scholas also offers a range of voluntary benefits, including: Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Legal Services, and Pet Insurance. Additional resources include healthcare concierge support, financial wellness tools, and employee discount programs. **QUESTIONS?** If you have any questions about this role, please feel free to email our Talent team at jobs@perscholas.org. We look forward to viewing your application! **Equal Employment Opportunity** We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin. PII Policies Non\-Discrimination Policy

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer, AMS
jobs.description: At Phillips Corporation’s Advanced Manufacturing Solutions (AMS) division, the Service Engineer plays a pivotal role in driving customer uptime and leading the installation, integration, and maintenance of cutting\-edge Hybrid manufacturing systems, CNC machine tools, and additive technologies. Operating in a high\-impact, field\-based capacity, this position combines advanced electromechanical troubleshooting across complex laser, controls, welding, and automation subsystems with proactive remote and on\-site support. By delivering right\-first\-time outcomes, validating system performance, and developing standardized integration protocols, you will directly safeguard operational continuity while building lasting trust as the primary technical partner for our customers. Beyond hands\-on technical execution, success in this role hinges on clear customer communication, continuous knowledge transfer, and operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with internal partners, applications teams, and suppliers to resolve complex engineering challenges, mentor emerging technicians, and keep technical documentation meticulous. Candidates need proven expertise in CNC controls (such as Haas), field service management systems, and multi\-system diagnostics, paired with strong self\-direction and an uncompromised commitment to safety. Join Phillips Corporation to pioneer the future of modern manufacturing through reliable execution and transformative technology. The expected pay range for a qualified person in this role is between $65,000\.00 and $95,000\.00 per year plus overtime, depending on experience level. If you have a different suggestion, please mention it in your application. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package and a profit\-sharing bonus. Phillips Corporation is a global supplier of manufacturing technology products and services primarily focused on machine tools (metalworking). We have been in business for 65 years and have grown from 2 people to over 900 globally \- come grow with us! *Phillips Corporation is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Phillips Corporation is an E\-verify participant.* **Requirements** **Skills and Qualifications:** * Advanced Mechanical \& Electrical Troubleshooting * Strong ability to diagnose and repair complex mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems in CNC and manufacturing equipment. * CNC Controls \& Automation Knowledge * Hands\-on experience with Haas CNC controls, tooling, probing, automation, and peripheral equipment (robots, bar feeders, pallets). * Customer\-Facing Communication Skills * Proven ability to explain technical issues clearly, manage expectations, and build trust with customers under high\-pressure situations. **Computer Skills:** * Email, Calendar \& Communication Platforms * Service Management \& CRM Systems * Technical \& Diagnostic Software **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) * Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) * Short Term \& Long Term Disability * Training \& Development * Profit Sharing * Company Van * Laptop * Required PPE and branded uniform.

jobs.title: MAINTENANCE SUPERVISOR
jobs.description: We are seeking a talented Maintenance Supervisor at our modern manufacturing facility located just east of the US 12 \- US 31 Bypass, 10 miles North of South Bend. This role supervises the lead maintenance tech on each shift and provides the direction and technical support to help the team acheive their goals. In our process, we encapsulate glass with a plastic injection molding process and use robotics and highly automated equipment to assemble windows for the automotive original equipment manufacturer customer. With a broad range of customers and investments in new technology and new model launches you can unleash your potential with us! **Are you looking for a role with better work\-life balance? APPLY TODAY**. Our team technical skills are strong and they are empowered to solve problems independently. You'll set clear expectations and they'll deliver results. **Looking for a company serious about investing in your education and development? APPLY TODAY**. We offer degree completion programs on day \#1 and experienced Maintenance professionals will find continuing education opportunities throughout the year to keep their skills up to date. **Looking for a team focused on innovation, initiative, and results? APPLY TODAY**. We reward innovation through our quick kaizen program and great team results equal monthly bonuses. \_\_\_\_\_ **More about us** \_\_\_\_\_ We offer an excellent compensation and benefits package, which includes a fantastic 401k that DOUBLES your personal contribution, great Anthem benefits; generous vacation and these other great perks: Onsite FREE fitness center; 12 Paid Holidays including the week between Christmas and New Years; Paid Medical Leave; South Bend Cubs Tickets; Site Performance Bonus Program; Birthday and Anniversary Awards; Veteran's Day recognition; Tuition Reimbursement including Graduate Degrees; Onsite Convenience Store; FREE meals and other monthly recognition events; Safe, Secure and Clean Work Environment; Annual Raises; Employee Suggestion Program with prizes; Family Atmosphere \- Respectful \- Community Activities; FREE Safety toed shoes / boots; Environmentally Friendly Reduce \- Reuse \- Recycle; FREE coffee Fridays; MORE! **\_\_\_\_\_\_\_More about the job\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_** **Job Title:** Maintenance Supervisor **Reports To:** Engineering/Maint Manager **Location:** Niles, MI **Department:** Maintenance/Engineering **Employees Supervised:** 15 Hourly technical associates **Purpose:** Supervise and coordinate activities of the Maintenance team members engaged in setting up, installing, repairing, and maintaining machinery and equipment, and in fabricating metal parts and tools. Ensure that work and safety rules, policy, and procedures are followed by team members and contractors. **Essential Functions:** * Directs performance of facility maintenance team to budget. Ensure that process standards correspond to the plant’s objectives, costs and supply in order to meet the needs of the customer. * Maintains an effective preventative maintenance program to ensure maximum equipment reliability. Support continuous improvement activities within the plant (i.e. TPM, 5S). * Provide technical resources for activities related to programming or installation of equipment. Directs troubleshooting where it is necessary. Assists in the training of maintenance personnel in technical areas. * Coordinates design, installation and start up of new/revised equipment with Technical Center engineers and outside vendors. * Maintains the documentation of the plant SOPs, Systems, spec manual, machine manuals and the PM records * Perform hands\-on troubleshooting of numerous types of equipment. Assist Maintenance/Production team members as a resource for trouble shooting equipment. * Provide consultation, analysis, evaluation and review of problems regarding equipment. Assists in the development of new products or processes and systems. Contributes to research and development projects to meet future demands when necessary. * Assist with mechanical improvements through TPM, PM, and Capital Expenditure Projects. Assist with the commissioning of new plant and equipment and other systems to ensure that this introduction into the production facility is handled efficiently and with minimum disruption. * System/Project design, costing and implementation from concept to completion to include capital improvement programs. Coordinate all equipment/hardware installation to ensure that project timing, quality, and cost targets are attained. Supervise and/or direct contractors, suppliers, or other technical people as required. Act at times as overall project manager on installation, movement, or decommission projects * Works in compliance with all safety rules and regulations to provide and support a safe working environment and reliable, ergonomic systems and machines. Will develop safeguards and improve team member safety through process improvements. * Trains team members in Equipment op ne proper actions. * Key relationships with internal leadership team, supplier teams, and customer team to ensure successful and mutual concern resolution. * Demands and priorities need adjusted regularly to provide a high level of service under tight timelines to several customers\-internally or externally. **Physical Requirements:** Position requires on\-site work at manufacturing facility in Niles, MI. ACTIVITY NEVER OCCASIONALLY up to 1/3 of day FREQUENT up to 2/3 of day CONSTANT over 2/3 of day Stand x Sit x Operate Machinery/Equip x Lift/Push/Pull 5\-10 \# x Lift/Push/Pull 11\-20\# x Lift/Push/Pull over 20\# x Bend/Twist at Waist x Bend/Flex Knee x Bend/Flex Arm x Grasp/Grip/Hold x Pinch/Pick/Feel x Reaching overhead x Repetitive Hand Use x Repetitive Foot Use x 9 hour work day M\-F is standard but this role requires availability a wide variety of hours/days including weekends and overnights. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. **Physical Environment:** While performing the duties of this position, the associate frequently works around moving machines/parts in an industrial environment. The associate occasionally works around industrial chemicals and other industrial hazards requiring PPE. The associate must possess a valid driver’s license and acceptable DMV record for use of company vehicles. Regular and predictable attendance at the manufacturing plant is required. Very infrequent domestic and international travel required, primarily to customer and vendor locations. *The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified.* NSG Group/Pilkington is an equal opportunity employer; M/F/D/V encouraged to apply. Qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability or national origin. Applicants have the option to confidentially self\-identify or not self\-identify when applying. Salary Range: $76,152\-$95,183 The Salary Range posted represents Pilkington North America’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the possible compensation at the time of the posting.
