jobs.title: Senior Manager / Director, Emerging Applications & Technology Architecture
jobs.description: **Job Description** Renesas is seeking a visionary and highly influential Sr.Manager / Director of Emerging Applications \& Technology Architecture to lead the exploration, definition, and commercialization of next\-generation semiconductor\-enabled system solutions. In this role, you will guide a team of world\-class architects focused on identifying and developing opportunities in emerging applications and disruptive technologies, including AI, robotics, autonomous systems, drones/UAVs, industrial automation, functional safety, edge intelligence, and other high\-growth market segments. You will serve as a strategic bridge between customers, ecosystem partners, product groups, and engineering organizations, transforming market opportunities into differentiated system solutions and future product requirements. Success in this role requires a combination of deep technical expertise, business acumen, leadership excellence, and the ability to influence across multiple organizations. Key Responsibilities Technology \& Market Leadership * Define and drive Renesas' system architecture strategy for emerging applications and emerging technologies. * Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new market opportunities, technology trends, and high\-growth application segments. * Translate customer challenges, technology disruptions, and market requirements into actionable system architectures and solution roadmaps. * Lead competitive benchmarking and technology assessments to identify capability gaps and future investment opportunities. * Act as a thought leader internally and externally, representing Renesas at customer meetings, industry forums, ecosystem events, and technical conferences. Architecture \& Solution Development * Lead the development of system\-level architectures and complete semiconductor\-enabled solutions leveraging Renesas MCUs, MPUs, SoCs, analog, power, sensing, AI, and connectivity products. * Drive hardware/software partitioning, system trade\-off analysis, and technology selection to optimize performance, cost, scalability, security, and power efficiency. * Oversee the development of system specifications, solution requirement documents, reference designs, proof\-of\-concepts, and demonstrations. * Establish architecture methodologies, design standards, and best practices across multiple application domains. * Ensure solutions address key requirements for reliability, safety, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and manufacturability. Product \& Business Influence * Partner closely with Product Groups to influence product roadmaps and future semiconductor requirements based on application and system\-level insights. * Support product definition activities by providing customer, system, and market requirements for next\-generation products. * Drive adoption of Renesas solutions through direct customer engagement, design\-in support, and strategic co\-development initiatives. * Collaborate with solution marketing teams to define value propositions, messaging, and go\-to\-market strategies. Team Leadership \& Ecosystem Development * Build, mentor, and develop a high\-performing team of application and system architects. * Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous learning. * Establish strong partnerships with strategic customers, technology partners, startups, universities, and research institutions to accelerate innovation. * Promote knowledge sharing and architecture re\-use across business units and regions. * Lead cross\-functional initiatives involving engineering, marketing, product management, sales, and ecosystem partners. **Qualifications*** Master's degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. * 12\+ years of experience in semiconductor, embedded systems, system architecture, or technology development roles. * 5\+ years of leadership experience managing technical teams or senior engineering professionals. * Proven track record in developing complex embedded systems and semiconductor\-based solutions. * Strong expertise in one or more emerging technology domains such as: * Artificial Intelligence and Edge AI * Robotics and Autonomous Systems * Drones/UAVs * Industrial Automation * Functional Safety and Cybersecurity * IoT and Connected Systems * Experience with system\-level architecture, hardware/software co\-design, and multi\-disciplinary solution development. * Strong understanding of semiconductor technologies, embedded software, connectivity, sensing, power management, and edge computing. * Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills. * Fluent in English. Preferred * Experience working directly with semiconductor product definition and roadmap planning. * Familiarity with functional safety standards such as ISO 26262, IEC 61508, IEC 62061, or similar. * Experience with AI/ML deployment in embedded or edge systems. * Track record of customer\-facing technical leadership and ecosystem development. * Experience working in global and cross\-cultural organizations. **Additional Information** Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us? Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. Under these regulations it may be necessary for Renesas to obtain U.S. government export license prior to release of technology to certain persons. The decision whether or not to file or pursue an export license application is at the sole discretion of Renesas.

jobs.title: Junior Project Manager- Residential Energy Efficiency
jobs.description: Description: **About ReVireo:** ReVireo is an energy efficiency and green building services company. We provide a range of consulting, inspection, and certification services to architects, builders, developers, contractors, and building owners. **Job Description:** ReVireo is looking for an individual to fill the full\-time position of Junior Project Manager that will be focusing on **single family residential projects**. The Junior Project Manager will be responsible for supporting the Project Manager in performing a variety of tasks related to energy code compliance and residential energy efficiency certifications, such as ENERGY STAR and Efficient New Homes, for single family residential construction types and project teams. This role will support the Project Manager in consulting and managing the compliance and certification of projects under these standards, coordinating with design professionals and contractors through the design and construction phases of building projects. This role will often work in partnership with ReVireo’s energy modeling, commissioning, and field inspection teams to deliver energy code compliance certifications such as ENERGY STAR and Efficient New Homes. **Job Responsibilities:** Perform tasks related to ENERGY STAR and Efficient New Homes certifications, as well as energy code compliance, including, but not limited to, the following: * Perform energy modeling of residential construction plans in REM/Rate, Ekotrope, and other software programs to determine projected HERS Index and compliance with applicable residential energy code and/or certification/incentive programs. * Review model compliance with energy efficiency goals * Create reports, such as the Energy Compliance Analysis (ECA) and Energy Compliance Specifications (ECS), based on energy modeling with recommended building specifications * Work with Project Manager to deliver ECA/ECS results to clients * Complete plan reviews to ensure project compliance with applicable codes and standards * Assist project team with technical questions * Perform on\-site kick off meetings to ensure onsite construction managers and trades meet applicable requirements * Provide technical support to design team, i.e., architects, engineers, etc. to answer inquiries related to target certifications * Create supporting documentation and specifications for target certifications * When necessary, complete in\-field testing such as envelope leakage testing, duct leakage testing, and pre\-drywall inspections. Requirements: **Position Requirements** * Experience with at least one of the following: o International Energy Conservation Code o ENERGY STAR Single Family New Homes o Efficient New Homes (Single Family) * RESNET HERS Rater credential required * Residential energy modeling experience is required * Undergraduate degree and/or graduate degree in a related field preferred * Strong interest in reducing building operating energy and improving the built environment * Excellent organizational and communication skills * Eagerness to learn and develop new skills * Ability to juggle tasks well and willingness to take on many different assignments * Proficiency with Microsoft Office (primarily Word and Excel) * General proficiency with other online business technology platforms * Ability to work in an unsupervised environment and manage own tasks efficiently **Location** * Located in NJ, NY, CT, or PA. **Compensation and Benefits** * Starting salary is a minimum of $80,000\-$90,000 per year and will be commensurate with experience, credentials and qualifications; re\-evaluated on a rolling basis throughout the year based on performance. * Company profit sharing of 10% net profit to employees, allocation based on performance * Generous paid time off, immediately vesting 401k with 6% match immediate eligibility health insurance with 70% premium contribution, employer\-paid life insurance plan, parental leave, professional development stipend, remote work flexibility, personal company credit card, and other benefits.

jobs.title: Robot Software Engineer Internship
jobs.description: At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high\-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state\-of\-the\-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real\-world environments and handling long\-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end\-to\-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale\-up to make generalist robotics a reality. **About the Role** ------------------ As a Robot Software Engineer Intern, you'll work on the software foundation that keeps our robots running. You'll own real projects on the software platform stack: ranging from on\-robot software, networking and communication infrastructure, data collection pipelines, telemetry, teleoperation, inference infra, developer tooling etc., and see your impact run on physical robots by the end of your internship. You'll sit with the engineers who build our robots and ship code that the team depends on every day. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Contribute to the networking and communication infrastructure connecting onboard robot systems to each other, to the cloud, and to teleoperation and monitoring systems * Help build data collection pipelines that capture sensor, telemetry, and behavioral data from the robot and upload it reliably to cloud storage for model training * Work on telemetry and observability systems that give the team real\-time visibility into robot health and field performance * Build internal tooling that accelerates robot software development: deployment pipelines, logging, debugging tools, and field testing utilities * Support bring\-up and field testing on live hardware, debugging issues across the onboard software stack * Collaborate with ML, perception, and control engineers to keep onboard systems reliable and training data high quality * Automate internal workflows to improve execution efficiency of the Rhoda teams **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field — or a recent graduate * Solid computer science foundation: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and networking * Genuine passion for working on robots — coursework, research, personal projects, competition teams, or internships all count * Strong programming skills in C\+\+, Python, Golang, or Rust * Curiosity and comfort working with physical hardware in a fast\-moving, ambiguous environment * Ability to debug across layers, from driver\-level issues up to application behavior * Open to learn new things and grow from knowing nothing to an expert on arbitrary technical topics **Nice to Have (But Not Required)** ----------------------------------- * Experience with bringing up \& manipulating robots * Familiarity with networking, IPC, or communication protocols (e.g. gRPC, DDS, QUIC, WebSockets) * Exposure to cloud storage and data pipelines (AWS, GCP, S3, GCS) * Experience with perception pipelines, control systems, or learned models running on real\-time robot stacks * Prior work on prototype or pre\-production hardware **Why This Role** ----------------- * Your work is the connective tissue of the robot — the networking, data, and tooling infrastructure that determines how fast the team can develop and improve our humanoids in the field * Work across the full onboard stack alongside perception, control, and ML engineers \& researchers on a platform pushing the frontier of humanoid robotics * Real ownership on a small team, with your code running on real robots — not a side project on the shelf

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Ripple, we're building a world where value moves like information does today. It's big, it's bold, and we're already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. If you're ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value. **THE WORK:** At Ripple, the **Customer Onboarding Platform** is where every customer's journey begins — and it's about to get a full\-scale rebuild. We recently became a **horizontal platform team** serving *all* Ripple products. Our next chapter: * **Unwinding years of Salesforce\-bound logic** into modern, engineering\-owned backend services. * Integrating best\-in\-class vendors like **Persona** for KYC/KYB, while building the surrounding orchestration, data flows, and service layer. * Designing the **systems and data model** that will make onboarding scalable, observable, and reliable across products. If you're a Staff\-level engineer who thrives on **modernizing fragile systems**, **building robust services around vendor integrations**, and **driving architecture at company\-wide scale**, this is your opportunity. ### **Why This Role Matters:** Onboarding is where customers form their first impression of Ripple, and where trust is earned. As the technical anchor for a small, high\-impact team, you will: * **Build for impact** – Everything you create will serve multiple Ripple products, from Payments to Custody to Stablecoin. * **Start from zero** – Design and build new backend services from the ground up to power onboarding across products. * **Tackle the hard stuff** – Unwind years of technical debt while designing systems built to last. * **Shape Ripple's architecture** – Partner with Product, Compliance, and Engineering to influence company\-wide technical direction. * **Scale the right way** – Mentor engineers and grow a high\-performing team, with direct executive backing. This isn't just about writing code, it's about designing how Ripple's onboarding platform will work for years to come. **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** * Lead the design and development of distributed, cloud\-native backend services that power onboarding across Ripple's product suite. * Partner with Product, Compliance, and other engineering teams to design scalable orchestration and data pipelines. * Migrate core onboarding logic out of Salesforce into resilient, observable services and a dedicated persistence layer. * Build platform capabilities that enable faster onboarding with fewer customer touchpoints — while preserving trust and compliance. * Contribute to foundational data modeling work that will feed into Ripple's future identity platform (while ownership of Identity will move to a dedicated team). * Champion engineering excellence in code quality, testing, and operational practices. * Mentor engineers and help grow a lean, high\-impact team. **WHAT YOU'LL BRING:** #### **Required** * Deep **backend engineering experience** in modern, cloud\-native, distributed systems. * Exposure and willingness to frontend frameworks (React, Vue, etc.) for full\-stack capability. * Proven track record **designing and delivering large\-scale systems** in complex environments. * Strong API design and integration skills (REST and/or gRPC). * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and container orchestration (Kubernetes, ECS). * Comfort navigating and reducing technical debt while delivering business value. * Leadership skills: can set technical direction, mentor others, and influence cross\-team decisions. #### **Preferred (But Not Required)** * Experience with our current stack: **Java \+ Spring Boot**. * + We welcome candidates from other backend stacks (Go, Kotlin, C\#, Python, Rust, etc.) who can quickly learn JVM technologies. * Event\-driven architecture (Kafka, SNS/SQS, etc.). * Domain knowledge in fintech, regtech, KYC/KYB, identity verification, or compliance\-heavy systems. ### **Why You'll Love Working Here:** * **Impact**: The systems you build will be used across *all* Ripple products, touching every new customer. * **Technical Challenge**: You'll lead a high\-leverage migration and design work that matters. * **Growth**: Opportunity to shape a horizontal platform team from the ground up. * **Collaboration**: Partner with sharp, motivated colleagues across engineering, product, and compliance. If you want to help replace a fragile, business\-critical system with a scalable platform that will serve every Ripple customer for years to come, we'd love to talk. Other common names for this role: **WHO WE ARE:** Do Your Best Work * The opportunity to build in a fast\-paced start\-up environment with experienced industry leaders * A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning. * Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team. * In\-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10\+ days a month they come in. * Bi\-weekly all\-company meeting \- business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team * We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more! Take Control of Your Finances * Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity * Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support * Employee giving match * Mobile phone stipend Take Care of Yourself * R\&R days so you can rest and recharge * Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite \& virtual programming * Generous vacation policy \- work with your manager to take time off when you need it * Industry\-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits. * Catered lunches, fully\-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events *Benefits listed above are for full\-time employees.* *Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.* *Please find our* *UK/EU Applicant Privacy Notice* *and our* *California Applicant Privacy Notice* *for reference.*

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer II - Body (Tooling & Process)
jobs.description: The Manufacturing Engineer supports the Body Manufacturing Engineering team in designing, launching, and improving world\-class body manufacturing systems. This role focuses on supporting daily dimensional management, tooling validation, and process stability. You will work on the manufacturing fl oor in our Normal, IL plant, assisting senior engineers with data analysis, fi xture adjustments, and process improvements to ensure high\-quality vehicle production. This role is located at our Normal, IL facility and reports directly to a Sr. Manager, Manufacturing Engineering. * Dimensional Management: Assist in cross functional development of assembly datum schemes, shim management, and adjustments to meet GD\&T requirements. * Tooling \& Process Support: Assist senior engineers with the design review, install, commissioning and validation of tooling fi xtures. Perform regular audits of equipment conditions and participate in troubleshooting production issues to improve tooling. * Problem Solving: Root Cause builds issues of the product in a data driven way to improve form, fi t and fi nish by employing problem solving techniques. Drive improvements of body\-in\-white accuracy through the launch and ramp phase of the product. * Data Analysis \& Reporting: Oversee Measurement routines of inline and offl ine metrology systems at Rivian. Assist in the analysis of dimensional data (measurement systems, CMM reports, etc.) to identify trends. * Documentation: Assist in the creation and maintenance of tooling certifi cation reports, Tool Repeatability, PLP documentation, and PFMEAs. * Collaboration: Translate complex dimensional data from manufacturing issues into actionable insights for product design requirements. * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a similar technical fi eld (recent graduate or 1\+ years of relevant experience). * Foundational understanding of GD\&T standards and the ability to interpret technical drawings. * Basic knowledge of automotive body assembly processes (welding, riveting, bonding). * Familiarity with 3D CAD software. * Strong analytical mindset with a focus on data\-driven decision\-making. * Excellent communication skills and a strong desire to work in a hands\-on, fast\-paced manufacturing environment. * Ability to support fl oor\-level activities and troubleshoot process issues under the guidance of senior team members.

jobs.title: Sr. Machine Learning/AI Engineer, Autonomy Hardware
jobs.description: We are looking for a Research Scientist with deep expertise in quantized deep learning models for hardware acceleration in autonomous systems. In this cross\-disciplinary role, you will bridge perception model design and hardware\-aware deployment, enabling efficient execution of high\-performance perception algorithms across embedded compute platforms. You will focus on researching state of the art perception models and develop optimization pipelines for the quantized versions of these models customized to provide real\-time performance and energy efficiency on next\-generation autonomy hardware.* Research state of the art perception models in collaboration with the ADAS SW teams * Contribute to the development of optimizations for mapping quantized perception models (e.g., CNNs, Transformers, LLMs, VLMs) to embedded and heterogeneous hardware platforms. * Design and implement hardware\-aware optimizations, including quantization strategies, model compression, memory\-efficient representations, and operator fusion, targeted to custom accelerators * Collaborate with hardware teams to co\-optimize model architecture and compute pipeline under real\-time constraints (latency, throughput, power). * Benchmark and analyze system performance across platforms and iterate to achieve optimal deployment efficiency. * Partner with perception, systems, and autonomy teams to align model optimization efforts with hardware roadmap and real\-world autonomy requirements. * Hands\-on experience with quantized model deployment, ML design stacks, and code generation for embedded or heterogeneous compute systems. * Understanding of computer vision models (e.g., object detection, segmentation) and their optimization for edge inference. * Experience in deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and their low\-level IRs or export formats (e.g., ONNX). * Solid programming skills in C\+\+, Python * Familiarity with CUDA/OpenCL (or other accelerator programming models). Preferred Qualifications: * B.S. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field with a focus on ML compilers, embedded systems, or hardware\-aware AI. * Prior experience working with hardware\-software co\-design, especially for autonomous or robotics platforms. * Knowledge of numerical precision trade\-offs, quantization\-aware training (QAT), and dynamic/static quantization flows. * Familiarity with embedded real\-time constraints and hardware profiling/debugging tools. * Familiarity with rearchitecting models to best suit hardware capabilities * Publication record in top\-tier ML/Systems conferences (e.g., MLSys, NeurIPS, DAC, ICCAD).

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description: Roadrunner’s data platform is foundational to how the business operates, scales, and delivers value to customers. As the company continues modernizing its technology environment, it needs a senior engineer who can take end\-to\-end ownership of the architecture, development, reliability, and evolution of this critical platform. The Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform will design and deliver scalable, secure, cloud\-ready applications and services, with Roadrunner’s data ecosystem as a core area of specialization. This role will address complex technical and operational challenges by connecting architecture, software engineering, data strategy, and business execution. Success means building resilient systems that improve access to data, strengthen production performance, accelerate development, and enable better operational decisions. This role will lead complex solutions from concept through production, influence the technical direction of the organization, and help advance Roadrunner toward cloud\-native, API\-first, and DevOps\-enabled delivery.\&\#xa;\&\#xa; **What you’ll do** ================== **1\. Own data platform architecture and engineering** ------------------------------------------------------ * Lead the architecture, design, development, and modernization of Roadrunner’s proprietary data platform and the applications that depend on it. * Build scalable, secure, and cloud\-ready services using modern .NET, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft data technologies. * Apply API\-first, modular, and service\-oriented architecture principles across new and existing systems. * Design data models, schemas, integration patterns, and platform capabilities that support long\-term scalability and maintainability. * Establish clear technical direction for complex, multi\-interface solutions from initial concept through production delivery. **2\. Modernize systems and engineering practices** --------------------------------------------------- * Identify opportunities to refactor, re\-platform, or incrementally modernize legacy applications without disrupting critical business operations. * Advance cloud\-native development using Azure platform and data services. * Promote CI/CD, automated testing, secure development, observability, and disciplined source\-control practices. * Improve development efficiency by reducing technical friction, strengthening reusable patterns, and simplifying system architecture. * Balance modernization priorities with production stability, customer impact, and measurable business value. **3\. Build reliable data and integration capabilities** -------------------------------------------------------- * Design and implement ETL and ELT pipelines that move, transform, validate, and operationalize data across internal and external systems. * Develop RESTful APIs, web services, and integrations that provide secure and reliable access to business\-critical data. * Apply data architecture concepts including data lineage, cataloging, dimensional modeling, normalization, denormalization, and schema evolution. * Strengthen data quality, governance, security, privacy, and appropriate handling of personally identifiable information. * Support data lake, data warehouse, batch\-processing, and streaming\-data use cases as platform requirements evolve. **4\. Drive production performance and accountability** ------------------------------------------------------- * Own the reliability, performance, security, and supportability of applications and services within the data platform. * Monitor production environments and use logging, diagnostics, and observability tools to identify risks before they create broader business impact. * Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for complex application, integration, database, and performance issues. * Optimize SQL Server databases through effective schema design, indexing, stored procedures, query optimization, and performance tuning. * Provide after\-hours support when necessary to protect production continuity and critical business operations. **5\. Influence technical and business execution** -------------------------------------------------- * Partner with technology leaders, business stakeholders, product owners, analysts, infrastructure, security, data, and operations teams to define and deliver high\-value solutions. * Surface opportunities, assess technical feasibility, and translate business challenges into practical software and data capabilities. * Communicate architecture decisions, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Lead technical design discussions, code reviews, development standards, and engineering best\-practice improvements. * Mentor developers and strengthen engineering capability through direct guidance, thoughtful feedback, and technical leadership. **What you bring** ================== * Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent professional experience, preferably in Information Syst out losing accountability for outcomes. * You treat production reliability and customer impact as engineering responsibilities. * You raise the standard for both the software and the team building it. \&\#xa; **Compensation \& Setup** ========================= * **Compensation:** $110,000 per year * **Location:** Hybrid \| Downers Grove, IL * **Travel:** Up to 5% * **Benefits:** Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, and other company\-sponsored programs **Physical Demands and Work Environment** ========================================= The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Physical Demands** -------------------- * Sedentary physical activity performing non\- strenuous daily activities of an administrative nature. * While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to sit, walk, stand, reach/handle items, work with the fingers, and talk and hear others in conversations via the phone or in person. **Work Environment** -------------------- * The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. * The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. * Regular onsite collaboration expected based on business and team needs * Schedule considerations: Some after\-hours production support may be required based on business needs * The above statements reflect the general details necessary to describe the principal functions of the position and are not intended to be all inclusive. The position and any of the requirements listed above are subject to change at any time according to the changing needs of the company. * Roadrunner is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. * We will not accept unsolicited candidates from external recruiters or recruiting agencies. Thank you! \#LI\-HybridDowners Grove, IL \&\#xa; **About Roadrunner** ==================== **Roadrunner is for ambitious, smart people who excel at execution over talking about it, and who would rather invent the next standard in freight than accept the status quo.** We are looking for the Best of the Best. Action driven leaders who want to be part of real change and help design the future of LTL in the U.S. This is a place where high performers can grow, influence outcomes, and make an impact while working directly with executives and smart people from across industries. We bring a winner mindset. We take ownership, raise the bar, and measure ourselves by results. We Run Safe. We Run Smart. We Run Together. These principles create an environment of high standards, clear ownership, and direct collaboration. We trust data over intuition, move with urgency, and hold each other accountable because winning requires it. Roadrunner exists to prove that LTL can be better than the industry has settled for. To be the best means we need to think bigger, look outside the box, and question every assumption: too many handoffs, limited visibility, and the quiet belief that “this is just how it works.” We rejected that story. We built a proprietary Smart Network™ for direct, long haul, metro to metro service that delivers fewer touches, faster transit, real time visibility, and genuine accountability. We are the most tech forward company in LTL, and we are not finished widening the gap. The foundation is already strong. Recognized as one of Built In Chicago’s Best Large Places to Work. Earning top marks for improvement, quality, and service. The real opportunity is still ahead: helping invent what comes next. If you want to be evaluated among the Best of the Best and help set the new standard in LTL, we should talk.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, Finance
jobs.description: ### **About Scale** For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science\-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding. Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands. We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact. Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company. If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in. **About the Role** We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who is far more than a report builder. You are a "Data Detective" who understands the heartbeat of an e\-commerce P\&L, and where it's headed next. You will own the truth behind our financial numbers and how we forecast them. We need a Financial Modeling Master who can build the forecasts our Finance team plans around, plus the predictive models that make those forecasts sharper, all grounded in rigorously reconciled data. Additionally, you will act as a critical partner to our Finance team and leadership, bridging the gap between raw transaction data, payment processors, and the financial plan. #### **What You'll Do** **1\. Forecasting** * **Financial Forecasts:** Build and own forecasts for revenue, orders, subscription renewals, and cash by brand and channel. * **Scenario Planning:** Develop scenario and sensitivity models that help Finance plan budgets. * **Forecast Accuracy:** Track accuracy over time and refine forecasts as the business changes. **2\. Predictive Modeling** * **Customer \& SKU\-Level Models:** Build, validate, and maintain predictive models, such as subscription renewal and cancellation likelihood, refund and chargeback risk, and SKU\-level demand, using statistical and machine learning methods (e.g., logistic regression, survival analysis, gradient boosting). * **Sharper Forecasts:** Feed model outputs into revenue and cash forecasts so projections reflect who is likely to renew, cancel, or refund, not just historical trends. * **Model Health:** Monitor model performance over time and retrain as customer behavior shifts. **3\. Financial Reporting \& Unit Economics** * **P\&L Reporting:** Own reporting on revenue, gross vs. net sales, discounts, refunds, COGS, and contribution margin by brand, channel, and product. * **Unit Economics:** Own contribution margin, payback, and profitability reporting by brand, channel, and product. * **Variance Analysis:** Produce budget\-vs\-actual analysis that explains what moved and why. **4\. Financial Data Integrity \& Reconciliation** * **Reconciliation Ownership:** Own reconciliation across payment processors (**Stripe, Shopify Payments, Amazon**), bank deposits, our internal database, and accounting (**QuickBooks**) to ensure every dollar is accounted for. * **Root Cause Leadership:** Lead investigations of revenue discrepancies and drive fixes at the source with our Data Engineer. * **Single Source of Truth:** Define and document the business logic behind financial metrics for the whole company. **5\. Data Transformation \& Visualization** * **Data Preparation:** Use **dbt** or **Python** to build the financial datasets and models behind forecasting and reporting. * **Business Logic Application:** Write efficient SQL in **Snowflake** that reflects our financial business rules. * **Dashboarding:** Design, build, and maintain high\-impact dashboards in **Sigma** for Finance and executive leadership. **6\. Leadership \& Collaboration** * **Finance Partnership:** Present forecasts and model findings to Finance and executive leadership, including the assumptions and risks behind them. * **Raise the Bar:** Review other analysts' work and mentor them on financial data quality and modeling. #### **What We're Looking For** **The Essentials (Experience \& Tech Stack)** * **Experience Level:** 5\+ years of data or financial analytics experience, with meaningful time in DTC, subscription, or consumer businesses. (We are looking for a senior, hands\-on individual contributor, not a people manager.) * **Forecasting \& Predictive Modeling:** Hands\-on experience with both: building financial forecasts (e.g., time\-series, regression) *and* predictive models (e.g., logistic regression, survival analysis, gradient boosting) that leadership used to make decisions. Both are required. * **Financial Acumen:** strong grasp of accounting principles, and familiarity with compiling financial statements and cash flows. * **Industry:** Proven experience in **DTC E\-commerce** is required. You must be comfortable with **Shopify**, **Amazon Seller Central**, and **Stripe** data. * **Warehousing \& BI:** Expert SQL in **Snowflake**, strong **Python** (pandas, scikit\-learn, statsmodels, Prophet, or similar), and proficiency with **Sigma**. We're open to candidates experienced with Tableau, Looker, or Power BI who can adapt quickly. * **Spreadsheets:** Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills. * **AI Tools:** Fluency with **Claude Code** (or comparable AI coding tools) for data manipulation and analytics. * **ELT Familiarity:** Awareness of how ELT tools (like **Hevo, Fivetran, Airbyte, Azure**, etc.) function, so you can communicate effectively with our Data Engineer. **The "Financial Modeling Master" Skill Set** * You have a proven track record of designing forecasts that executive leadership relies on for strategic planning, along with the ability to articulate variance drivers and continuously calibrate model accuracy. * You know when a time\-series forecast is enough and when a customer\-level predictive model will do better. * You understand how a Shopify order becomes a processor payout and then a bank deposit, and where fees, refunds, and chargebacks create gaps. * Familiarity with **QuickBooks** report structures and month\-end close is a plus. **The Financial Mindset** * You present forecasts honestly, with the assumptions and risks in plain view. * You have the patience and precision to trace a single transaction through the entire data lifecycle when the numbers don't add up. #### **What We Offer** * Salary: $100,000 \- $125,000 depending on experience * Excellent Medical, Dental, Vision and Life insurance * Fully remote, full\-time position * Monthly WFH stipend * Generous Paid Time Off program * Discounted Products * An amazing team to work alongside Please click the link for our privacy notice: Applicant Privacy Policy Notice EAWiH2ZeDo

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator II & III - VA
jobs.description: Logistics Coordinator, Levels II \& III ======================================= **Location:** Onsite – Virginia **Reporting to:** DCO At **STN**, we don't just adapt to the digital future, we engineer it. Our mission is to help organizations thrive in a rapidly evolving technology landscape through strategic insight, cutting\-edge solutions, and a security\-first mindset. We provide end\-to\-end services spanning cloud consulting, AI infrastructure, and enterprise security, enabling secure, scalable, and future\-ready transformation. As trusted advisors, we align IT investments with business outcomes that drive performance and growth, starting with deep strategic engagement and delivering tailored solutions built for long\-term impact. Our approach is innovation\-led and rooted in cybersecurity, with a focus on leveraging the right technologies to solve real\-world challenges. We invest in our people and foster a culture of growth, inclusion, and purpose because we believe empowered teams build transformative technology. **Overview** STN Incorporated is seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented Logistics Coordinator to support the efficient operation of our data center environments. This role is responsible for coordinating the movement, storage, tracking, and delivery of critical IT infrastructure assets, including servers, network equipment, racks, cables, spare parts, and facility components. The Logistics Coordinator will ensure inventory accuracy, support asset lifecycle management, coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, and maintain compliance with company security and operational standards. Data center logistics requires precise coordination of hardware, inventory, and deployment schedules to support uptime and operational reliability.Key Responsibilities -------------------- **Inventory \& Asset Management*** Maintain accurate inventory records for servers, network equipment, spare parts, tools, and consumables. * Perform cycle counts, inventory audits, and reconciliation activities. * Track asset movement from receiving through deployment, redeployment, and decommissioning. * Ensure all inventory transactions are accurately documented in asset management and inventory systems. * Monitor stock levels and coordinate replenishment of critical spare parts and operational supplies. **Shipping \& Receiving*** Coordinate and process inbound and outbound shipments of IT equipment and infrastructure materials. * Verify deliveries against purchase orders and packing slips. * Prepare shipping documentation and coordinate carrier pickups. * Track shipments and proactively resolve transportation or delivery issues. * Manage RMA (Return Material Authorization) shipments and vendor returns. **Data Center Operations Support*** Stage equipment for deployment, maintenance, and project activities. * Coordinate with Data Center Technicians, Operations teams, Procurement, and vendors to ensure hardware availability. * Support hardware installation schedules by ensuring equipment is received, inventoried, and available when needed. * Assist with decommissioning projects and secure disposition of retired assets. * Maintain organized storage areas, cages, and equipment rooms. **Vendor \& Carrier Coordination*** Serve as a point of contact for suppliers, freight carriers, and logistics providers. * Schedule deliveries and coordinate site access requirements. * Ensure vendors comply with facility security and operational procedures. * Coordinate delivery timelines for critical infrastructure projects. **Compliance \& Documentation*** Maintain accurate records for audits, asset tracking, and inventory reporting. * Follow chain\-of\-custody procedures for high\-value IT assets. * Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and data center security requirements. * Generate inventory, shipment, and asset lifecycle reports for management review. Experience \& Qualifications ---------------------------- **Required*** Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Information Technology, or related field preferred. * 2–5 years of experience in logistics, inventory control, warehouse operations, or supply chain management. * Experience in a data center, technology, manufacturing, or mission\-critical environment preferred. * Experience with inventory management, ERP, WMS, or asset tracking systems. * Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and inventory reporting tools. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Excellent organizational and communication skills. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. **Preferred*** Experience supporting data center operations or IT infrastructure environments. * Familiarity with servers, networking equipment, racks, and structured cabling. * Knowledge of asset lifecycle management and hardware tracking. * Experience with DCIM, ServiceNow, NetSuite, SAP, or similar platforms. * Forklift certification or warehouse equipment experience (if applicable). **Physical Requirements*** Ability to lift and move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. * Ability to stand, walk, bend, and work in warehouse and data center environments for extended periods. * Ability to safely move and stage racks, servers, and IT hardware. * Ability to work occasional evenings, weekends, or on\-call schedules to support critical operations. Compensation ------------ * Full\-Time, Exempt * VA: $60,000\-$84,000/year, DOE and Level Benefits -------- * Health Coverage – Medical, Dental \& Vision * FSA Health and Dependent Care available * 401(k) Plan * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) * Observed Holidays Paid * Cell Phone Allowance * Collaborative, growth\-driven culture Candidates must be U.S. Citizens or Permanent Residents. We are unable to provide sponsorship at this time. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and reference verification. All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. VOMAA205VV

jobs.title: Manager, Firmware Engineering
jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About the role:** Samsara's AI has helped prevent accidents that would have harmed an estimated 380,000 people per year. Every model we ship runs in the real world, on real roads, protecting real drivers. Every Samsara dash cam, gateway, and industrial sensor runs AI at the edge. These models detect distracted driving, prevent collisions, and keep workers safe, all in real time on constrained hardware. As Engineering Manager, you'll own how AI moves from a trained model to firmware running reliably on devices in the field across Samsara's customer fleet. You will drive Samsara's edge AI strategy while mentoring engineers and delivering high\-impact solutions. You will oversee the deployment of next\-generation intelligent safety features and video processing by integrating high\-performance camera systems and real\-time edge computing into Samsara's fleet and industrial products. In addition, you will establish the technical strategy, cross\-functional relationships, and operational cadence required to launch low\-latency, high\-quality hardware programs at scale. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. Scale: Millions of AI dash cams, 100B\+ miles/year (\~99% of U.S. roads), 25T\+ data points. **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real\-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * **You are a life\-long learner:** We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go. * **You believe customers are more than a number:** Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes. * **You are a team player:** Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win – together. #### **In this role, you will:** * **Lead a team of \~5 firmware and ML engineers.** Your team builds, optimizes, and deploys AI models on Samsara's fleet and industrial devices. Your work directly affects whether a driver gets a warning before a collision, not after. * **Provide hands\-on technical leadership.** Lead from the front technically, contributing directly to the design, implementation, and optimization of high\-performance production systems. * **Set the technical bar for edge ML and embedded systems.** You'll guide architecture decisions on latency, power, memory, and model performance, and mentor engineers to go deep on problems most teams never touch. * **Turn new AI capabilities into shipped products.** You'll partner with Product, Hardware, and Full\-stack teams to take features from concept to deployment on devices. You'll also keep improving the ones customers rely on every day. * **Shape the roadmap.** You'll work with leadership on quarterly plans that balance product ambition with engineering health, and make the tradeoffs that deliver the most customer impact. * **Build a team people want to join and stay on.** You'll create a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement, with a high bar for execution quality and room for people to grow. * **Scale Samsara's culture as we grow globally.** You'll champion and role model our principles as the team expands across new offices: Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team. * **Hire and develop top talent.** You'll grow an inclusive,  at has shipped a mass production product. * Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work well in a diverse fast paced customer\-focused environment. * Experience deploying CV/ML models on edge devices in real\-world applications. **An ideal candidate also has:** * Experience working on products from concept to mass production. * Proficiency in C/C\+\+, Rust, or similar programming languages. * Proficiency in gstreamer, Google MediaPipe, or similar edge AI/Media frameworks. * Experience with data analysis using tools such as Databricks, SQL queries, Tableau. * Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent field. **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. **Fraudulent Employment Offers** Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Technical Superintendent
jobs.description: **POSITION OVERVIEW** Reporting to the Fleet Technical Director, the Technical Superintendent functions with considerable independence and initiative and is responsible for taking full technical ownership of assigned vessels. In this role, you will keep your vessels safe, compliant, reliable and cost\-effective, and serve as the primary technical link between the office, the ship and our service providers. This is a hands\-on Technical Superintendent role for a seasoned marine engineer who enjoys developing shipboard talent as much as solving technical problems. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** A Technical Superintendent that provides full technical management and daily support for assigned vessels in line with Class, Flag, Statutory and Company requirements and our ISM/SMS procedures. Plans, oversees and coordinates maintenance, repairs, dry\-dockings and surveys, ensuring hull and machinery meet applicable codes and standards. Monitors vessel performance and drive follow\-up actions to resolution. A Technical Superintendent that owns vessel budgets and operating expenditures and explain variances to management. Visits vessels regularly to assess condition, compliance and maintenance; prepare Vessel Condition Reports and lead shipboard safety meetings. A Technical Superintendent that coaches, mentors and trains Chief Engineers; helps recruit and select Chief Engineer candidates and recommends promotions to 1st Assistant Engineer and Chief Engineer. Partners with HSQE, Crewing, Operations and Procurement; evaluates vessel requisitions and provides technical guidance. A Technical Superintendent that supports audits and incident investigations. **QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE** Bachelor's degree in marine engineering, naval architecture or a related maritime discipline; maritime academy graduates strongly preferred. 8\+ years of marine engineering experience, including seagoing service as a licensed engineering officer. USCG Chief Engineer or 1st Assistant Engineer license (or equivalent STCW certificate) strongly preferred. Shoreside superintendent or assistant superintendent experience preferred. Proven experience planning and managing dry\-dockings and major repairs. Strong working knowledge of Class, Flag, USCG and IMO requirements, including ISM. Budget management experience and comfort with Office 365\. Clear communicator who sets high standards and builds strong relationships with officers, crew and vendors. Ability to travel domestically and internationally, pass a post\-offer background check, and obtain a TWIC within three months of hire. The selected candidate must possess access to a reliable form of transportation with the ability to work in the office during standard business hours Monday – Thursday, with a one\-hour lunch. This includes the option to work from home on Fridays during standard business hours with a one\-hour lunch. This position is expected to perform work outside and beyond normal working hours during times of critical deadlines, projects, or when there are time\-sensitive duties. **COMPANY OVERVIEW** Headquartered in West Palm Beach, FL, Schuyler Line Navigation Company (SLNC) is a U.S.\-flagged maritime transportation and logistics provider specializing in commercial and government cargo services. With a commitment to operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and financial discipline, SLNC ensures secure and efficient transportation solutions for defense, energy, and commercial customers. We operate in some of the most remote and austere environments globally, offering door\-to\-door logistics solutions tailored to our customers' needs. SLNC offers competitive pay, an exceptional culture and a generous benefits package. ***By applying to this position, you consent to your application materials being processed through Indeed Talent Scout, Indeed Smart Sourcing, and associated AI/LLM tools as part of our application process.*** ***Schuyler Line Navigation Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. In others, the incumbent will be vastly advantaged. We believe the opportunity is exponential when existing competitive attributes are paired with the power of AI. Sequence acquires ambitious, established enterprises in the service economy and refounds them as market leaders. We bring capital, engineering and operational expertise to each business we partner with. Our engineers work shoulder to shoulder with management teams to reimagine their business around what is now possible with AI. We rebuild operations, workflows, products and services from the ground up. At the center is Atlas, our proprietary technology platform, which is deployed across every Sequence company. What we build and learn from one business strengthens Atlas for the next, creating a compounding advantage that accelerates every new refounding. We elevate, not replace, human talent and judgment. jobs.description: **ABOUT SLATE** At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them. **Who we are looking for:** Slate is looking for a **Quality Assurance Engineer (Senior)** to help bring code to life. You will identify and assess potential risks, conduct technical and business evaluations, and partner closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to embed responsible AI principles into product development lifecycles, adapting to AI\-enabled and agentic systems in particular, and identifying where AI\-specific guidance or risk mitigations are needed. This is a highly collaborative role working across engineering, product, information security, legal, and business teams to ensure AI initiatives align with regulatory requirements and SIE's broader strategic goals. The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of generative AI use cases, technical and sociotechnical risk, and product development, balancing responsible AI commitments with internal and external innovation. If you are passionate about AI Governance and Responsible AI, and have demonstrable experience and skills required for this position, we encourage you to apply. This is an opportunity to build and mature an AI governance program within a fast\-evolving landscape. **What You'll Be Doing:** * Contribute to long\-term strategies for building safe, ethical, and innovative AI products and tools * Serve as a technical Responsible AI advisor for generative and agentic AI systems, helping teams assess architectures, tool integrations, MCP implementations, data flows, permissions, autonomy, and appropriate human oversight and guardrails * Engage stakeholders across the organization to gather feedback and address AI Governance and Responsible AI technical considerations * Use AI governance, risk tooling and discovery insights to identify emerging risks and support appropriate remediation and technical solutions * Experiment hands\-on with emerging AI capabilities, including agents, MCP servers, tool integrations, APIs, and evaluation frameworks, to understand their capabilities and risks and translate findings into practical governance guidance * Sit on relevant domain boards as a technical specialist, partnering closely with Product and Engineering * Conduct ethical and safety risk assessments, advising teams on mitigation strategies related to bias, fairness, robustness, transparency, and societal impact * Partner with engineers, product managers, designers, online safety and more, to proactively identify unintended consequences and emerging risks of AI * Coordinate with Information Security and relevant technical teams to align AI governance reviews and risk assessments with security requirements and technical controls * Contribute to company\-wide best practices for responsible AI development and deployment, including AI literacy materials and case studies **What We're Looking For:** * At least 3 years of experience in AI Governance, Responsible AI, Corporate Governance, AI safety, AI policy, or a related field, with meaningful experience evaluating AI technologies and systems * At minimum, 5 years of experience contributing to or leading cross\-functional programs from strategy through operational implementation, partnering with product, engineering, legal, security, and operations teams * Strong technical fluency in modern AI systems, including LLMs, agentic architectures, tool use/function calling, APIs, cloud services, and automation * Hands\-on experience working with or evaluating agentic AI systems; familiarity with MCP or comparable protocols and agent/tool integration frameworks strongly preferred * Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, or other technical approaches to identifying risks in LLM and agentic systems * Understanding of agentic and sociotechnical AI risks, including excessive agency, permissions and data access, unintended tool use, human oversight, systemic risk, and emergent behaviors * Ability to translate technical findings and risks into practical controls, mitigations, and guidance for engineering, product, and business teams * Ability to independently drive outcomes across cross\-functional teams with minimal supervision * Strong analytical and communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to challenge assumptions and navigate ambiguity in a fast\-moving environment * Ability and curiosity to stay current with emerging AI capabilities, risks, frameworks, and industry developments, particularly within technology, entertainment, and gaming **Preferred Qualifications:** * Familiarity with relevant regulations, standards and ethical guidelines (e.g., EU AI Act, OECD Principles, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001\) * Proficiency in producing meaningful visualizations and reports, and effectively presenting technical results to diverse audiences * Industry experience in tech, gaming or (interactive) entertainment jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Collectivus Holdings is a dynamic business group encompassing brands many of the most prestigious brands in the Collecting, Trading Card Game, and Hobby industries. With a century's worth of collective experience in driving product and service innovation, high\-end quality standards, and elevated customer experience, Collectivus brands are among the most recognized and loved throughout the world by the communities they serve. **Website:** https://www.collectivusholdings.com **Locations:** Nashville – Garland – Aarhus – Lisbon – Worldwide **Job Title:** Data Analyst **Job Location:** Remote \- US Collectivus is building a modern data platform on Snowflake to serve its portfolio of brands. As a Data Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain the pipelines that move data from our source systems (ERP, CRM, e\-commerce, marketing, survey, and finance platforms) into Snowflake, and shape it into reliable, well\-modeled data for analytics, Power BI reporting, and AI\-driven applications. You will work within an established architecture and set of engineering standards, partnering with the Data Architect on design decisions and with the Data Analysis team on delivery. Our data engineering team actively uses AI assistants in day\-to\-day development, and we expect engineers to adopt these tools thoughtfully and responsibly. **Responsibilities** *Pipeline Development \& Data Integration* * Build and maintain Python\-based ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from REST APIs, SFTP/flat files, and SaaS platforms (e.g., Qualtrics, Shopify, UKG, ERP, HubSpot) into Snowflake. * Implement incremental loads, MERGE\-based upserts, watermark/control\-table patterns, soft deletes, and idempotent reruns following team conventions. *Data Modeling \& Warehousing* * Develop and tune Snowflake SQL across raw, staged, and presentation layers, including views, tasks, and streams. * Design and build data marts in Snowflake (fact and dimension tables, conformed dimensions, and aggregate layers) that serve Power BI reporting and downstream analytics. *Orchestration, Security \& Data Quality* * Schedule and orchestrate jobs using GitHub Actions, monitor runs, and resolve failures. * Manage secrets and credentials securely via AWS Secrets Manager and Snowflake key\-pair authentication. * Build data quality checks and assertion tests, and detect and remediate schema drift from upstream sources. *AI \& Advanced Data Services* * Support Snowflake Cortex and MCP\-based data services (semantic views, search services) by preparing and governing the underlying data. * Use AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude) as part of the daily workflow to accelerate pipeline development, code review, debugging, and documentation, while retaining full ownership of correctness and quality. *Collaboration, Documentation \& Engineering Standards* * Collaborate with analysts and business stakeholders to translate reporting needs into data models and Power BI\-ready datasets. * Write clear runbooks and data dictionaries. * Participate in code reviews and follow Git branching and pull request standards. **Qualifications** * 3–5 years of hands\-on data engineering experience. * Hands\-on experience building star\-schema data marts (fact/dimension design, grain definition, surrogate keys, and SCD handling) for BI consumption. * Solid understanding of dimensional modeling and warehouse layering concepts. * Strong Python (pandas, requests, boto3, snowflake\-connector) for production pipelines. * Advanced SQL and working experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse. * Experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication, pagination, and rate limiting. * Familiarity with AWS services used in data workflows (S3, Lambda, Secrets Manager, IAM). * Experience with CI/CD and job scheduling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar). * Experience with Snowflake Cortex, semantic models, or LLM/AI\-assisted data workflows. * Demonstrated ability to work effectively with AI coding assistants, including strong prompting, critical review of generated code, and sound judgment on when not to rely on them. *Nice to Have* * Experience with industry\-leading ETL tools, n8n, or similar low\-code integration tools. * dbt or an equivalent transformation and testing framework. * Power BI data modeling or DAX exposure. * Retail, wholesale, or consumer\-products domain experience (ERP, CRM, PLM, e\-commerce data). **Success in the First 6–12 Months** * Independently own eight to ten production pipelines end to end. * Reduce recurring pipeline failures through improved monitoring and data quality checks. * Contribute reusable pipeline templates that shorten onboarding time for new sources. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **Only applicants who meet the Minimum Qualification Requirements and meet all selective requirements (listed below) will be placed on the eligible list.** The Iowa Department of Natural Resources (DNR) encourages all applicants to upload a current resume and cover letter to their online application. **Environmental Specialist Senior – State Revolving Fund (SRF)** **Clean Water \& Drinking Water SRF Programs** **Help protect Iowa’s water resources and guide vital infrastructure programs while making a lasting difference in communities across the state.** The Iowa Department of Natural Resources (DNR) is seeking an **Environmental Specialist Senior** to serve as a **Leadworker** within our State Revolving Fund (SRF) program team. If you enjoy mentoring team members, managing complex data tracking systems, shaping policy recommendations, solving technical challenges, and seeing water quality projects benefit Iowa communities, this could be the opportunity for you. **What You’ll Do** As an Environmental Specialist Senior and SRF Leadworker, you will: * **Direct work and provide leadworker guidance:** Direct the daily work of two or more employees, serving as the primary technical point of contact regarding State Revolving Fund statutory, regulatory, and procedural requirements. * **Serve as primary technical contact \& mentor:** Resolve complex project\-level tracking issues, deliver programmatic training, and compile documentation for Clean Water and Drinking Water SRF programs. * **Manage project priority lists \& intended use plans:** Coordinate operational workflows, lead Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) updates, and maintain multi\-project tracking for the Intended Use Plan (IUP) and Project Priority List (PPL). * **Maintain database integrity \& performance metrics:** Manage SRF program database integrity, track critical performance metrics, and prepare comprehensive reporting packages including the Annual Program Report, EPA database submissions, and executive dashboards. * **Provide strategic \& contract administration support:** Assist with the preparation and evaluation of project contracts, Intended Use Plans, vendor claims, invoices, and annual reports to facilitate efficient program administration and data\-driven recommendations for leadership. * **Research regulations \& formulate policy recommendations:** Research emerging federal and state regulations, draft proposed administrative rules, policy white papers, and program operating plans to guide SRF strategy. * **Deliver training \& stakeholder outreach:** Develop and deliver programmatic training and guidance for staff, regional partners, local watershed leaders, and environmental stakeholders on SRF requirements and field protocols. * **Build strong inter\-agency \& community partnerships:** Represent the Iowa DNR at local, regional, and statewide meetings, fostering effective working relationships with state and federal partners (such as the EPA), agricultural and environmental interests, and private\-sector partners. **What We’re Looking For** We’re looking for an environmental professional who is: * staff, coordinating operational workflows, and resolving complex project tracking issues. * **Knowledgeable in State Revolving Fund programs**, with familiarity regarding Clean Water and Drinking Water SRF regulations, statutory guidelines, Intended Use Plans, and EPA requirements. * **An effective communicator and policy analyst** skilled at drafting administrative rules, policy white papers, executive dashboards, and program reporting packages. * **A detailed data manager** focused on maintaining database integrity, tracking performance metrics, and preparing accurate state and federal database submissions. * **Organized and self\-directed**, with the ability to lead SOP development, manage multi\-project tracking, administer contracts, and meet firm program deadlines. * **A collaborative relationship builder** comfortable interacting with state and federal agency partners, local watershed leaders, private\-sector partners, and the regulated public. * **Comfortable embr telework (as approved by the supervisor). * Workout/Gym facilities available onsite at 6200 Park Ave. **Comments:** The starting salary for new state (Executive Branch) employees is expected to be at the base of the pay range. Additional salary increases may occur after the first six months, and then annually (if applicable). The State’s total compensation package features an outstanding set of employee benefits that are worth about 30% of your total compensation. Visit the DAS website for more benefit information. Ensure you are kept up\-to\-date on the status of this position by checking your email regularly for emails from info@governmentjobs.com. This is a system generated email from the DAS application system and it may be sent directly to your Junk/Spam folder. DNR Application Tips For more information about DNR Employment Opportunities and position specific notices, please visit the DNR Employment website. The State of Iowa is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. **E\-Verify and Right to Work** The State of Iowa participates in E\-Verify, a federal program that helps employers confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. Within the required timeframe, new hires will be verified through the E\-Verify system to ensure authorization to work in the United States. The State of Iowa also complies with the federal **Right to Work** laws, which protect employees’ rights to work without being required to join a labor organization.
