jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description: About Steer Health Steer Health is the AI\-native growth platform for health systems. Our platform helps hospitals and specialty practices fill schedules, close referral gaps, and recover revenue that would otherwise leak out of the patient journey. We integrate with 36 EHRs, including Epic, Oracle Health, MEDITECH, and athenahealth, and we support 45\+ hospitals covering 19 million patient lives. We are a lean team with outsized impact. Steer was named to the KLAS Emerging Solutions Top 20 and won the 2026 Hearst Health Prize. We are growing fast, and the people who join now will shape how the company serves its customers for years. The opportunity Every Steer customer relationship starts with an implementation, and the quality of that experience shapes everything that follows: adoption, time to value, satisfaction, and renewal. As Implementation Manager, you will act as the owner of each client implementation, responsible for a smooth delivery and a client who is confident from day one. You will run projects that combine workflow design, EHR integration, AI configuration, and change management, working with hospital and practice leaders on one side and Steer Product and Engineering on the other. Our platform integrates with Epic, Oracle Health, MEDITECH, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, and dozens more, so you will see a wide range of environments and learn quickly. What you will do Deliver implementations end to end * Own the implementation plan including scope, timeline, milestones, resources, risks, and go\-live readiness for each client. * Lead kickoff and discovery to capture the client's workflows, systems, goals, and success criteria. * Coordinate the technical work with Engineering and client IT, including EHR connectivity, data flows, and system configuration. * Drive go\-live through testing, training, cutover, and hypercare, and keep every stakeholder informed along the way. Manage the client relationship * Be the day\-to\-day lead for clinical, operational, executive, and IT stakeholders during implementation. * Set expectations clearly and raise risks and blockers early, with a proposed path forward. * Hand off cleanly to Client Success and Support so that value realization continues after go\-live. Make delivery faster and more repeatable * Track time to value and client satisfaction on every implementation, and report on what you learn. * Improve templates, checklists, and playbooks so each implementation is faster and more predictable than the last. * Bring field feedback to Product and Engineering and help shape how new capabilities are rolled out. Work as one team * Partner with Sales on scoping and handoff so commitments are realistic and clear. * Partner with Training and Customer Success to prepare users and drive adoption. **Requirements** What you bring * 5\+ years managing software implementations or projects in healthcare technology, health IT, or enterprise SaaS. * Hands\-on experience with EHR environments and an understanding of how clinical and front\-office workflows run in hospitals or physician groups. * Working knowledge of integrations, including HL7, FHIR, APIs, or SFTP, and comfort working alongside engineers and client IT teams. * A track record of delivering on time in complex, multi\-stakeholder projects, with strong planning and risk management skills. * Excellent communication skills and the presence to lead conversations with clinical and executive leaders. * Comfort in a fast\-moving startup where processes are still being built. Strongly preferred * Direct experience with Epic, Oracle Health (Cerner), MEDITECH, or athenahealth. * PMP or similar project management certification. * Experience with AI, patient access, call center, or scheduling and referral workflows. What success looks like * First 90 days: You are fluent in the Steer platform and implementation process, and you are leading your first go\-live with support. * First 6 months: You own a portfolio of implementations, and your clients go live on schedule with strong satisfaction scores. * First 12 months: Your time to value is measurably faster, and the templates and playbooks you built are standard practice for the team. Why Steer * Ownership. You will lead implementations end to end, with real authority over how they are run. * Variety and depth. You will work across many EHRs and care settings, from large health systems to specialty groups. * Technology that works today. Our AI is live in hospitals and delivering measurable results, so the work you do reaches patients quickly. * Growth. As we scale, there is a clear path to lead a larger portfolio and a team. **Benefits** Health/Vision/Dental/Life Insurance PTO Stock Equity

jobs.description: Description: * Are you the person friends and family call when their tech stops working? * Do you get a kick out of solving a problem on the first call and hearing the relief in someone's voice? * Are you looking to start your IT career somewhere with a clear path into NOC and Engineering, not a dead\-end support queue? **If that sounds like you, keep reading.** **Why SSR** SSR Total IT is a 30\-year\-established MSP where the Service Desk is the front door to everything we do. automation troubleshooting to resolve production\-impacting issues. * Diagnose failures across PLCs (Allen\-Bradley), VFDs, AC/DC motors, servo motors, sensors, and control hardware. * Support and maintenance activities, repairs, and findings using CMMS systems (e.g., Maximo) and internal tools. * Act as a senior technical escalation point during system disruptions or downtime events. * Partner of hands\-on experience with PLCs, preferably Allen\-Bradley, focused on diagnostics and troubleshooting (not heavy programming). * Minimum of 1 year of experience with VFDs, including diagnosing speed, torque, and drive\-related issues. * Minimum of 1 year of experience working with AC and DC motors. * Hands\-on experience with automated systems such as conveyor systems, conveyor belts, You will also partner with senior engineers and engineering leaders to shape technical approaches, identify implementation risks, resolve roadblocks, and support the evolution of reusable AI engineering patterns. This role requires curiosity and continuous learning, including staying current with developments in AI, machine learning, LLMs, agentic systems, and modern software engineering practices. optimization and production deployment considerations for AI systems * Experience building scalable, maintainable, and well\-tested services, APIs, data pipelines, applications or platforms * jobs.title: ​Associate Research Scientist, IIHR
jobs.description: The **Associate Research Scientist, IIHR** will contribute to the research mission of IIHR—Hydroscience and Engineering and the Center for Health Effects of Environmental Contamination (CHEEC) by supporting the newly launched Iowa Integrated Network for Science, Information, and Geospatial Health Tracking (Iowa INSIGHT), a first\-of\-its\-kind initiative dedicated to understanding how Iowa’s environment is impacting the health of its people made possible through the generous support of the Kyle J. and Sharon Krause Family Foundation. Iowa INSIGHT is a statewide initiative that will produce scientific evidence needed to understand how environmental exposures affect human health — from the air Iowans breathe to the water they drink. The program will work to identify environmental factors contributing to Iowa’s high cancer rates and other adverse health problems, including maternal and newborn health, reproductive health, and neurodevelopmental disorders. The Associate Research Scientists will lead research initiatives centered on environmental monitoring and biomonitoring, while contributing to a vibrant team of researchers at CHEEC that includes research staff, as well as graduate and undergraduate student researchers. This is a specified term position. This position is not eligible for University sponsorship for employment authorization. **Key Responsibilities:** * Initiate research design and methodology. Originate design, research conduct, and coordination. Maintain laboratory equipment as needed. Develop hypotheses to be tested and select methodology. Work independently on complex research tasks with oversight by Faculty or Principal Investigator. * Provide routine operation and maintenance of instrumentation involved in the analysis of environmental and biological samples. * Perform advanced data analysis techniques. Develop new applications of existing data analysis techniques. * Develop methods for analysis of complex environmental samples, including water, air and heterogeneous media, and/or biospecimen samples (e.g., whole blood, serum, urine, breast milk). * Prepare and submit first author manuscripts for publication. Demonstrate strong publication record. May contribute to public data archives or other resources; e.g., software, models, or on\-line tools to support scientific research. * Prepare and submit publications (e.g., lead and/or corresponding author) in peer\-reviewed scientific journals. * Serve as PI or co\-PI, contribute to research proposals and funding agency reports. May write research proposal to obtain independent funding as PI. Select and purchase equipment as needed. * Draft and/or contribute to original grant proposals in environmental health. * Seek leadership opportunities appropriate to the scientific discipline, which may include serving on proposal review panels. May serve on departmental or University committees. May organize outreach efforts in alliance with funding sources. Serve as a session chair or organize sessions at professional meetings. * Mentor graduate students. May provide functional and/ or administrative supervision for staff. Provide direction, assignments, feedback, coaching and counseling to assure outcomes are achieved. To obtain the full job description including key areas of responsibility, technical competencies, and desirable qualifications, please contact Alex\-Schutman@uiowa.edu **About the College of Engineering** The College of Engineering at the University of Iowa is driven by talented faculty, staff, and students who are dedicated to producing knowledge that addresses grand challenges in advanced technologies, health sciences, sustainability, energy, and the environment. We pride ourselves on producing ethical, globally aware engineers whose work makes the world safer and more efficient. As a center of innovation and discovery, the College of Engineering is committed to improving the quality of life for our Iowa community, as well as for people across the United States and around the world. We uphold the values of respect, community, and collaboration in all our endeavors, fostering a welcoming and respectful environment where members are valued and supported. Joining our team means becoming part of a supportive environment that values work\-life balance and personal well\-being. The University of Iowa offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health and wellness resources, dual career support, and opportunities for professional development. Learn more about working at the University of Iowa: Build A Career/Build a Life. **Education Requirement:** * Ph.D. in Chemistry, Civil and Environmental Engineering, Environmental Health, or related fields. **Required Qualifications:** * At least three years of experience at a Postdoctoral Scholar level or above. * Prior experience and significant expertise in method development for analysis of complex environmental samples, including water, air and heterogeneous media, and/or biospecimen samples (e.g., whole blood, serum, urine, breast milk). * Prior experience and significant expertise with analysis of environmental and/or biospecimen samples via liquid chromatography with tandem mass spectrometry (LC\-MS/MS). * Demonstrated expertise in the routine operation and maintenance of instrumentation involved in the analysis of environmental and biological samples. * Prior experience in developing and maintaining appropriate QA/QC standards and protocols associated with laboratory analysis of environmental and biological standards. * Prior experience managing complex data flows, including translating data into reports that can be shared with diverse stakeholder groups. * Demonstrated effective oral and written communication skills, including a strong record of publication (e.g., lead and/or corresponding author) in peer\-reviewed scientific journals. * A valid driver’s license and continued compliance with the standards of the University Driving Policy (University of Iowa Operations Manual Part V, Chapter 19\). * Demonstrated commitment to fostering a welcoming and respectful workplace environment. **Desired Qualifications:** * Experience with the design and implementation of field sampling campaigns for collection of complex environmental samples across a range of matrices (e.g., soil, water, sediment). * Experience drafting and/or contributing to original grant proposals in environmental health. **Application Details** In order to be considered for an interview, applicants must upload: * **Resume** * **Cover Letter** Job openings are posted for a minimum of 7 calendar days. This job may be removed from posting and filled any time after the minimum posting period has ended. Successful candidates will be required to self\-disclose any conviction history and will be subject to a criminal background check and credential/education verification. 5 professional references will be requested at a later step in the recruitment process. For questions, contact Alex Schutman at Alex\-Schutman@uiowa.edu **Benefits Highlights** * Regular salaried position. Pay level 6A. Located in Iowa City, Iowa. * Fringe benefit package including paid vacation; sick leave; health, dental, life and disability insurance options; and generous employer contributions into retirement plans. * For more information about Why Iowa? Click here. About Iowa Joining the University of Iowa means becoming a vital part of the Hawkeye community, where your work directly impacts education, research, and student success. Enjoy exceptional health coverage, university\-paid life insurance, robust retirement plans, and generous leave policies. Benefit from 24/7 support services, well\-being resources, and access to UI Health Care specialists. Grow professionally with advanced training, leadership development, and tuition assistance. Iowa City offers a great quality of life with world\-class performances at Hancher Auditorium, Big Ten athletics, top\-ranked public schools, and outdoor recreation. Join us in making a difference at a leading Big Ten university and premier public research institution. Additional Information * Classification Title: Assoc Research Scientist/Engin * Appointment Type: Professional and Scientific * Schedule: Full\-time * Work Modality Options: On Campus Compensation * Pay Level: 6A Contact Information * Organization: College of Engineering * Contact Name: Alex Schutman * Contact Email: alex\-schutman@uiowa.edu

considerations. * Guide implementations from prototype through production, ensuring solutions meet reliability, security, compliance, and maintainability expectations. * Define reusable architectural data with Thomson Reuters' data backbone. * Develop dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into AI performance, reliability, safety, usage, and cost. * Ensure compliance with Thomson Reuters cloud AI services, and observability tooling—based on capability, cost, risk, and enterprise fit. * Design flexible architectures that can adapt to changing models, providers, technical requirements, SLIs and SLOs for critical AI services to meet enterprise reliability, performance, and compliance requirements. * Integrate AI observability tooling into CI/CD processes so new models, prompts, workflows, and use cases are automatically enrolled in monitoring and evaluation. * Develop automated guardrails and policy\-enforcement mechanisms, such as limits, anomaly detection, and abuse or jobs.title: Senior Architect, Identity and Access Management
jobs.description: At VF, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness, and authenticity. So, before we get to the job details, take a minute to learn a little more about us – our values and our culture \- visit VF Careers or www.vfc.com. **What will you do?** A day in the life of a Senior Architect, Identity and Access Management at VF looks a little like this. The Senior Architect, Identity and Access Management is responsible for leading the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of IAM solutions that support VF's security, compliance, and business objectives. This role partners closely with Security, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Application teams to deliver scalable identity services across cloud and on\-premises environments. The Senior Architect provides technical leadership for IAM architecture initiatives, helping to modernize identity capabilities while ensuring secure and efficient access to enterprise systems. This role contributes to IAM strategy and roadmap planning while leading the execution of key identity\-related programs and projects. Let’s break down that day\-in\-the\-life a bit more. ***Strategic Planning \& Delivery*** * *Contributes to the development and execution of IAM roadmaps and priorities aligned with security and business objectives.* * *Lead delivery of IAM architecture initiatives and modernization efforts.* * *Partner with technology and business teams to identify and implement IAM solutions that improve security and user experience.* * *Support adoption of Zero Trust principles and modern authentication standards.* ***Agentic AI Security Enablement*** * *Support implementation of identity controls for autonomous agents and machine identities.* * *Establish processes for provisioning, maintaining, and retiring agent identities.* * *Implement least\-privilege access controls and role\-based authorization models for agent workloads.* * *Assist in developing standards for workload identity federation and OAuth/OIDC integrations.* ***IAM Architecture \& Engineering*** * *Lead design and implementation of IAM solutions, ensuring scalability, security, and operational effectiveness.* * *Define and maintain architecture standards for authentication, authorization, identity lifecycle management, and privileged access.* * *Support integration of IAM capabilities across cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and enterprise systems.* * *Drive enhancements to core IAM services including SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, IGA, PAM, and directory services.* * *Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture and Security teams to align IAM solutions with broader technology standards.* ***Business Partnership*** * *Work with business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into IAM solutions.* * *Support cloud migrations, application integrations, and digital transformation initiatives.* * *Identify opportunities to automate identity lifecycle processes and improve operational efficiency.* * *Balance security, usability, and compliance requirements when designing solutions.* ***Risk, Compliance \& Governance*** * *Support IAM governance processes, access reviews, and compliance activities.* * *Partner with Security, Risk, and Audit teams to address identity\-related findings and risks.* * *Monitor IAM controls and recommends improvements to strengthen security posture.* * *Assist in maintaining compliance with regulatory and audit requirements.* ***People Leadership*** * *Lead and develop a team of IAM engineers and technical specialists.* * *Provide coaching, mentoring, and performance management support.* * *Foster a collaborative, customer\-focused, and innovative team culture.* * *Promote knowledge sharing and continuous learning within the IAM team.* ***Vendor \& Technology Management*** * *Manage relationships with IAM vendors and implementation partners.* * *Evaluate emerging IAM technologies and provide recommendations.* * *Support platform upgrades, licensing reviews, and optimization efforts.* ***Communication \& Collaboration*** * *Communicate architecture decisions, project status, and technical recommendations to stakeholders.* * *Provide IAM subject matter expertise to project teams and business partners.* * *Promote adoption of IAM standards, best practices, and security controls.* **What do you need to succeed?** We all have unique skills that we bring to work and celebrate every day. Additionally, while formal education in a related field is great to have, we are most interested in your 5\+ years of experience and professional achievements. The foundation skills you will need in this position are: * *5\+ years of experience in Information Security, with strong experience in IAM.* * *Experience implementing IAM technologies such as Microsoft Entra ID, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, or similar platforms.* * *Strong understanding of IAM concepts including SSO, MFA, Federation (SAML/OIDC), PAM, IGA, and directory services.* * *Experience designing and implementing IAM solutions in cloud and hybrid environments.* * *Familiarity with Zero Trust principles and identity\-centric security models.* * *Experience working with compliance, audit, and access governance requirements.* * *Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.* * *Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.* **Now WE have a question for YOU.** **Are you in?** **Hiring Range****:** $120,000\.00 USD \- $150,000\.00 USD annually**Incentive Potential**: This position is eligible for additional compensation awards that may include an annual incentive plan, sales incentive, or commission potential. Lead new product/process requests and/or new product development projects. Review and ensure the systems surrounding the bearings and mechanical power transmission components will provide top performance. * Compare all potential solutions for manufacturability, cost profile, and other attributes relevant to the customer. jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: We're Tovala, a food\-tech company reinventing home cooking through hardware, software, and fresh food delivery. We're hiring a Senior Firmware Engineer to help raise the bar on the connected oven at the heart of every Tovala kitchen. You'll partner with our firmware lead (5\+ years on the team) as a true peer and own meaningful slices of the fleet end\-to\-end. We run two oven fleets in parallel: a mature legacy fleet, built on the Electric Imp stack coded in Squirrel powering most of our installed base, and a new fleet built on our in\-house IoT stack, utilizing ESP32, C and AWS. You'll focus on keeping the legacy fleet healthy and de\-risking changes, while contributing to the new fleet as it grows. AI\-assisted development is reshaping how our team works, and we expect the same on firmware. You should have hands\-on experience with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot and strong opinions on applying them well in embedded contexts where the constraints differ from typical web/backend work. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design, build, test, and ship firmware for our connected ovens — starting with the Electric Imp / Squirrel fleet that serves the majority of our customers today, and contributing to our new ESP32 based platform as it scales. * Own bug fixes, feature additions, and performance/efficiency improvements end\-to\-end — from scoping through lab testing, staged fleet rollout, and production monitoring. * Write, monitor and maintain automated firmware test pipelines. * Design and execute test plans on the bench and on real fleet subsets. We push firmware to tens of thousands of ovens in customers’ kitchens, and we take that seriously. * Use AI\-assisted development tools as a core part of how you work — for code generation, debugging, test scaffolding, log analysis, and documentation — while applying the judgment that embedded work demands. * Collaborate closely with our thermal, mechanical, and quality engineers, our manufacturing and ops partners, and our backend team to root\-cause issues that span the full stack — firmware, hardware, cloud, and the factory floor. * Help evolve our firmware development practices: code review standards, test infrastructure, release processes, and how we incorporate AI tooling responsibly. * Document and communicate clearly so your work is durable, your tradeoffs are visible, and your teammates can build on top of what you ship. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- ### **Required** * 5\+ years of professional firmware or embedded software engineering experience, including shipping firmware to a fleet of internet\-connected devices in production. * Strong fundamentals in C/C\+\+ and embedded systems — RTOS, memory, timing, interrupts, real\-time constraints, and the discipline that comes with code running on devices you can’t easily reach. * Experience working in Python, Bash for build tooling as well as testing automation * Comfort working with (or willingness to quickly learn) the Squirrel programming language and the Electric Imp platform. * Experience with common embedded interfaces and protocols: I2C, SPI, UART, and the network stacks (BLE, Wi\-Fi, TLS, MQTT/HTTPS) that connected products depend on. * Experience with CICD and automated test workflows, ideally Github automations and workflows.. * Demonstrated, hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted software development. You’ve integrated AI tools into your daily workflow and can speak concretely about how they’ve changed the way you build, test, and debug firmware. * Excellent communication skills. You can explain technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly to engineers, hardware partners, and non\-technical stakeholders, and you write things down. * Strong problem\-solving instincts — you dig into root causes, think about second\-order effects, and find pragmatic solutions in messy real\-world systems. * A degree in computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or commensurate experience. ### **Nice to Have** * Direct experience with Electric Imp OS and Squirrel. * Experience with ESP32 and modern embedded toolchains (ESP\-IDF, FreeRTOS). * Experience with cloud IoT infrastructure — AWS IoT Core, device shadows, OTA pipelines, telemetry ingestion — even at a contributing rather than owning level. * Familiarity with web technologies both front end and back end as well as databases — Typescript, React, Flask, Go, SQL * Manufacturing and factory tooling: Experience building or supporting the systems that flash, provision, and verify firmware on the production line, and debugging them remotely with overseas manufacturing partners across time zones. * Hardware\-adjacent skills: For example, ability to read schematics and PCB layouts, comfort on a bench with an oscilloscope and logic analyzer, ability to spec an alternate component, basic familiarity with switch\-mode power supplies. * Experience working in a connected consumer product or food\-tech company. **Who You Are** --------------- * **Solution\-Minded:** You focus on outcomes, not output. You want to understand the customer problem before you start writing firmware, and you’re not precious about your approach if a better one emerges. * **AI\-Forward:** You see AI tools as a fundamental shift in how software — firmware included — gets built. You’re already using them daily and have thoughts on how teams should adopt them in safety\-conscious, hardware\-adjacent contexts. * **Cross\-Functional Collaborator**: You thrive working alongside hardware, thermal, quality, manufacturing, ops, and backend teammates. You communicate clearly and care about the end\-to\-end product experience. * **Startup Mindset**: You’re comfortable in an environment where priorities evolve and where your work has direct, visible impact on customers’ kitchens. * **Curious and Adaptive**: You stay current on hardware, firmware, and AI tooling, and you have a favorite microprocessor brand — maybe even a favorite oscilloscope brand. **Location** ------------ This role is hybrid with a strong preference for candidates based in or near Chicago, IL (HQ) or Urbana, IL (The Product Manufactory, our R\&D and prototyping shop). For the right candidate, primarily remote work is possible, provided you have your own electronics bench and equipment. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- Tovala uses market data, geography, and placement of internal employees to determine salary. Additionally, we offer all employees real ownership in the company in the form of a competitive equity package. * Flexible paid time off (with a minimum of 15 days off you are highly encouraged to take) * Comprehensive healthcare coverage we really invest in * 401k with match * Free Tovala Smart Oven and discounted Tovala meals * Paid holidays and our winter holiday office shutdown where the offices and facilities close for a week around Christmas and New Years * Various other perks — recognition programs, continued learning stipend, casual dress code, in\-office coffee, snacks and drinks, and Tovala swag **Our Values** -------------- **Put the Team First**: We put what is best for the broader team ahead of what is best for ourselves or our immediate department. **Get S\#!t Done (Well)**: We celebrate people at all levels for delivering high impact work that expands the bounds of what we’re able to do. **Connect the Dots**: We engage with curiosity to learn how our work impacts others so that we can problem\-solve holistically and work collaboratively. **Be Direct**: We share our perspective openly and directly, even when it feels difficult to do so. **Embrace the Obstacles**: We rise to meet challenges with a sense of urgency, resolve, and optimism. **Champion the Customer**: We consider and prioritize our customer in all of our decisions. At Tovala we’re committed to building a workplace that represents a variety of backgrounds, skills, and perspectives and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Everyone is welcome here! We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Applied AI)
jobs.description: Traba is building the AI operating system for the industrial supply chain \- the network of warehouses, manufacturers, logistics providers, and workers behind the physical goods people rely on every day. We started by tackling labor, supplying industrial businesses with consistent, reliable temporary workforces, and quickly became the fastest growing staffing company in America. Since then, we've expanded our suite of AI agents to help logistics providers, manufacturers, 3PLs, and other industrial businesses fully automate their manual workflows, derive insights from their data streams, and transform their decision intelligence. Our mission is to build a world where the global supply chain operates at peak efficiency. We’re proud to be backed by some of the world’s best investors, including Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst. **You'll build Traba's product on top of AI agents**—taking frontier models and existing agents and putting them to work across our staffing marketplace to automate the pipeline that sources, vets, matches, and places workers on millions of shifts. (Our AI Agents team builds the agent platform; you apply it everywhere it creates leverage.) This is a product\-engineering role first, so you'll go where the priorities are—some quarters that's an agent that automates vetting or matching, others it's a payments flow or platform work. You'll partner with our CTO on architecture and roadmap, and build the platform the rest of the company runs on. **About You:** * **An applier, not a researcher.** You take frontier models and existing agents and wire them into real product across the stack—shipping reliable automation rather than owning the orchestration internals. And you don't need every task to be an AI task: you take the highest\-priority problem, model or not. * **Voracious learner.** You move easily between API design, UX, and deployment infrastructure. * **Proven full\-stack builder.** You have a track record of shipping scalable, performant applications from frontend interfaces to backend distributed systems. **You Will:** * Apply existing agents and frontier models across the stack—worker app, business app, ops platform, marketplace—to automate vetting, matching, and fulfillment. * Lead frontend and backend development, mentoring other engineers. * Architect and build core systems—real\-time matching, autonomous vetting pipelines, distributed systems, and APIs. * Own product surfaces end to end, partnering closely with product and design. **You Have:** * 5\+ years across frontend and backend: TypeScript, React/React Native, and Node.js or Python. * Strong with APIs, distributed systems, PostgreSQL, and messaging (Kafka or RabbitMQ). * Hands\-on experience integrating LLMs or agents into real product—prompting, tool wiring, evals. You've shipped AI features, even if you didn't build the platform. * A track record of shipping scalable products in fast, ambiguous, early\-stage environments. **Benefits:** * Start\-up equity * Competitive Salary * 100% Paid health, dental \& vision coverage * Dinner Provided via DoorDash, free DashPass \& stocked kitchen for NY employees * Commuter benefit * Gympass Benefit * ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, HealthAdvocate, Teledoc Health **Salary Range Details** ------------------------ The compensation range for this position is set between $200,000 and $240,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. **Our Values** -------------- **Dream Big \-** We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life\-changing vision. jobs.title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER
jobs.description: Job description: **Overview** ***Code that keeps care moving.*** Behind every Medicare member who finds the right provider, gets a claim paid correctly, and receives care on time, there's software that has to work, every time. At USAMCO, The National Networks of Choice, you'll write that software. We're a Medicare\-focused managed care organization connecting members, providers, and health plans nationwide, and we're in the middle of a bold transformation. We're rebuilding a 40\-year\-old legacy foundation into a modern, cloud\-native healthcare platform powered by Creatio CRM, a Databricks data lakehouse, and automated delivery. This isn't a maintenance gig. It's a chance to design and build the systems that will run healthcare operations for years to come. **Why This Matters** In healthcare, software quality is personal. A clean integration means a provider shows up correctly in a directory. A well\-tested release means a claim gets paid on time. A secure design means a senior's health data stays protected. We're looking for an engineer who feels that responsibility and builds accordingly. **What You'll Build** * Modern healthcare applications. Design, develop, and maintain applications, services, and APIs that support members, providers, and claims operations. * The integrations that connect it all. Build reliable data flows between Creatio, Databricks, and legacy systems, turning decades of healthcare data into something teams can trust and use. * The modernization itself. Translate legacy business logic into clean, well\-documented, maintainable code as we move off our IBM i platform. * Quality from the start. optimizing large\-scale security monitoring and analytics environments. * Strong background in security telemetry engineering, including log collection, normalization, enrichment, parsing, and data Kinesis, Event Hubs, Data Lake architectures, cloud\-native services, or similar high\-volume data processing platforms. * Advanced knowledge of security operations, threat detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, and MITRE ATT\&CK, with the ability to translate security use cases into actionable telemetry and detection requirements. * Proficiency in scripting, automation, and jobs.title: Manager, Web Platforms and Digital Experience
jobs.description: Manages the development, cloud hosting, integration, maintenance, and operation of enterprise websites, web applications, and digital platforms. Serves as a hands\-on technical manager, actively providing technical direction and support for web development, CMS platforms, APIs, system integrations, cloud services, security, accessibility, performance, deployments, web analytics, and troubleshooting. Leads the practical application of artificial intelligence (AI), including generative AI, large language models (LLMs), AI services, and automation, within web development and digital platforms. Evaluates, prototypes, integrates, and implements AI\-enabled web solutions while guiding developers on architecture, coding practices, integrations, testing, and technical problem resolution. Work includes day\-to\-day technical oversight from development and code/solution reviews through testing, deployment, production support, maintenance, platform reliability, and continuous improvement. The Web Platforms and Digital Experience Manager oversees the planning, development, and management of websites, web applications, and web services supporting UCSF programs, projects, and institutional initiatives. The role serves as a hands\-on technical manager responsible for managing web development, content management systems, cloud hosting, APIs and system integrations, security, accessibility, performance, and platform reliability. Manages the evaluation and implementation of modern web and AI\-enabled technologies, including generative AI, large language models (LLMs), AI\-assisted development, intelligent search, content workflows, analytics, and automation to improve web development, digital experiences, and operational efficiency. Collaborates with campus departments and stakeholders to ensure web platforms and services meet organizational needs and follow technical, security, accessibility, and digital standards. Receives broad objectives for managing and advancing UCSF’s web services and determines appropriate technical priorities, implementation approaches, resource allocation, and team assignments to meet organizational goals and timelines. Manages website initiatives, platform enhancements, cloud\-hosted services, integrations, AI\-enabled capabilities, and production operations while ensuring effective development, testing, deployment, security, and maintenance practices. Provides direct management and oversight of web and technical staff, including setting priorities, assigning work, providing technical guidance, reviewing technical solutions and deliverables, managing performance, and developing staff capabilities. Balances hands\-on technical involvement with people, platform, and operational management to ensure reliable service delivery and effective team performance. jobs.description: University Staff**Description** --------------- **University of Colorado Anschutz****Department: School of Medicine Office of the Dean IT Shared Services****Job Title: Senior Data Engineer****Position \#: 00853609 – Requisition \#: 41245** **Job Summary:** The Senior Data Engineer independently designs, develops, optimizes, and supports backend data solutions that enable reliable analytics, reporting, and operational use of institutional data. Classified by the Carnegie® Classification of Institutions of Higher Education as an R1 (“Very High Research”) university, it is also recognized in the Carnegie® Community Engagement classification. Prim Campus at Lake Tahoe, where education, research, and creative work thrive in a stunning mountain setting. Today, the University delivers on its original land\-grant mission of access to education and knowledge by investing in the academics, facilities, support, engagement and vibrant campus life that promote our diverse students’ cognitive growth and academic achievement – all while remaining one of the best values in American higher education. For more information, please visit the University’s website . **University of Nevada, Reno** ------------------------------

Final applications must be submitted prior to the close of the recruitment. If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, please contact our recruitment helpline at (775\) 784\-1495 or jobs@unr.edu . **Job Description** The University of Nevada, Reno (UNR) College of Science invites applications for the position of Chair, Department of Chemistry, at the rank of Professor, a tenured position, with an anticipated target hire date of **July 1, 2027** **.** Exceptional candidates at the Associate Professor rank will also be considered. T he Department and College seek a dynamic, collaborative and visionary leader to serve as Chair to advance the Department of Chemistry’s research, education and service missions. The Department is one of 10 departments in the College of Science, together with the College’s public service programs, and plays a foundational role in research and education across the University. The Department includes two dozen academic and administrative faculty, whose expertise spans analytical, bio\-organic, computational, inorganic, materials, organic, physical and theoretical chemistry. The Department offers a highly reputable B.S. in Chemistry with multiple areas of emphasis, and has maintained continuous American Chemical Society (ACS) certification status since 1941\. It also offers M.S. and Ph.D. degrees in Chemistry, and participates with the Department of Physics in the interdisciplinary Ph.D. program in Chemical Physics. The Chemistry graduate programs support approximately 65\-75 graduate students working with research\-active faculty. Undergraduate and graduate students benefit from extensive opportunities for faculty\-mentored research and access to advanced research infrastructure. Departmental research is supported by extramural grants from federal and private agencies, with over $10M in research funding in FY25\-26\. Research spans experimental and theoretical chemistry, and is supported by extensive shared instrumentation in the Shared Instrumentation Laboratory (SIL), including NMR spectrometry, X\-ray diffraction, mass spectrometry, optical and laser spectroscopy, and materials characterization capabilities. The Department also operates ChemStores, a research stockroom that provides chemicals, supplies, and related resources to researchers across campus. The Department has a strong tradition of interdisciplinary research, including the Hitchcock Center for Chemical Ecology, which brings together investigators from chemistry, biology, mathematics, biochemistry, natural resources and environmental science. The interdisciplinary Ph.D. program in Chemical Physics provides an additional bridge between Chemistry and Physics. Together, these activities provide a strong foundation for expanding collaborative research across the College of Science, the University, and with external partners. The Chair will work collaboratively with faculty, staff, students, the Dean and College leadership to establish and implement a forward\-looking vision for the Department. The Chair will strengthen research excellence and extramural funding, advance undergraduate and graduate education, recruit and retain outstanding faculty and students, strategically manage departmental resources and infrastructure. The Chair is expected to maintain an innovative, externally funded research program, with competitive startup support available. The Chair will help position Chemistry as a leader in interdisciplinary research and education and enhance the Department's visibility and impact within Nevada and nationally. Continually analyzes the environment seeking ways to improve it. Identifies existing and potential problems, opportunities for improvement, and ways to enhance the level of service provided. Formulates strategies in response to the conditions uncovered. Evaluates strengths and benefits, as well as weaknesses, issues, costs and impacts of alternative strategies. Makes recommendations to implement new technologies and presents for approval to the appropriate advisory committee. Recommends the alternative that best addresses the issue or resolves the problem. For sizable proposals, provides management with an implementation plan that documents the result of the evaluation and a time line associated with the proposed initiatives. Troubleshoots problems and provides consultation to clients about configuration and use of these platforms. Communicates to staff planned and implemented changes and status of problem resolution. Provides technical consulting services within and outside the department. Mentors staff. Serves on University and/or Medical Center specific teams as an active participant. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** * Leads analysis of use case requirements, design solutions, and deploys on premise or cloud based infrastructure. jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. **The Team** The Data Platform Engineering team (Part of Upstart's Decisioning \& Data) provides developer tools, frameworks, and scalable data infrastructure as shared services across Upstart. The team's primary objective is to provide Data Analysts, ML scientists, and Software Engineers access to high\-quality data and developer tools to create business metrics and training data for respective product verticals. You will join the Data Production Experience (PX) team, which owns Upstart’s Lakehouse (Databricks) infrastructure. This is the platform that Machine Learning, Analytics, and Software Engineering teams use to build the training data and metrics behind our lending, fraud, and pricing models—enabling growth and reducing risk across our business verticals. As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer joining this team, you will focus on: * **Lakehouse Infrastructure and Security**: Own the Databricks platform across multiple environments, including a newly launched regulated environment (Upstart Bank). Responsibilities include expanding infrastructure as code for new Lakehouse features, enforcing a no\-click\-ops policy, establishing disaster recovery, implementing least\-privilege and attribute\-based access controls (e.g., based on data classification), ensuring environment isolation, and resolving other known security risks. * **Compliance**: Close control gaps and automate evidence gathering for OCC, SOX and SOC audits across access management, change management, and data quality. * **Cost and usage efficiency**: Reduce Databricks and AWS spend through accurate cost attribution, waste detection, and platform\-level optimizations (e.g., compute rightsizing, improving pruning, migrating to Graviton and spot instances, Delta Lake Archival). **How you’ll make an impact** * Evaluate and adopt new technologies, including open\-source lakehouse alternatives, to expand platform capabilities. * Improve developer efficiency and infrastructure reliability by working with cross\-functional stakeholders like Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Analytics, Compliance, and Security. * Improve Lakehouse security, usage efficiency, and observability by collaborating closely with the Data Engineering and Security teams. * Evangelize good coding and engineering best practices while uplifting fellow engineers and mentoring junior team members. * Help break down complex projects and requirements into quarterly commitments and sprints. * Own Lakehouse infrastructure components end to end, from technical requirements and design through rollout and production support. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or data platform engineering. * Hands\-on experience operating a lakehouse or big data platform (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg). * Hands\-on experience with AWS (e.g., IAM, S3, EC2, EKS), Python, infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK), CI/CD, and Kubernetes. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience implementing security and compliance controls in audited environments (e.g., SOX, SOC 2, GDPR, GLBA, OCC), including access management, encryption, and change management. * Experience reducing cloud or data platform costs through usage analysis, cost attribution, and infrastructure optimization (e.g., Gravito ng assistants or agents to accelerate infrastructure development and operations. * Familiarity with distributed systems, data architecture design, and big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Lakehouse, Databricks) **Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in\-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in\-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2\-4 consecutive days at a time. At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k). United States \| Remote \- Anticipated Base Salary Range $166,900—$230,900 USD **What you'll love** At Upstart, our benefits are designed to support your health, financial well\-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect: * Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly * Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only) * Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada. * Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only) * Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security * Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements * Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country) * Family\-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life\-centered resources * Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only) * Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well\-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you * Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from * Connection and community through team events, all\-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs) * Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro\-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec. Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices. *If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate\_accommodations@upstart.com* https://www.upstart.com/candidate\_privacy\_policy

We're a YC\-backed team with leadership from Best Egg, PayPal, Divvy, and Lending Club—on a mission to modernize legacy call centers with real\-time AI agents that drive higher conversions, lower costs, and better borrower outcomes. **About the role** ------------------ You'll be the main point of contact for a book of our Growth customers — collection agencies, lenders and fintechs — from kickoff through go\-live, renewal and expansion. Internally, you're the bridge to our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), who build and tune each customer's agents. You turn customer asks into clear requests for the team, and turn build updates back into plain language for the customer. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Own the customer relationship** * Serve as the primary point of contact for a book of Growth accounts, with a prescriptive and consultative approach * Run regular check\-ins: agent performance, what shipped, what's blocked and what the customer owes us * Send clear recaps after every call so decisions and next steps are never ambiguous * Communicate with every level of the customer's team, from collections floor managers and IT leads to owners and C\-level executives **Get agents live and performing** * Guide customers through their deployment journey, from kickoff and scoping to go\-live, adoption and measurable results * Chase the inputs a launch depends on — scripts, compliance sign\-off, data files, phone numbers, integration access — without letting timelines drift * Monitor account health signals (using customer metrics) and step in early when something slips * Translate build updates, trade\-offs and timelines back to customers in plain language * Relay customer insights to our engineering team so what we learn in one account improves every agent **Grow the book** * Drive pilot\-to\-annual conversions and renewals across your accounts * Spot and qualify expansion: new channels, a second agent, a new portfolio or client of the customer * Help build our scaled Growth motion — onboarding templates, email cadences and self\-serve materials that let one CSM run many accounts well **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 2\+ years in a customer\-facing role at a tech company (customer success, account management, implementation or support) **or** in lending or collections operations (at a lender, servicer, agency or fintech) * Hands\-on experience rolling out automation, AI or contact\-center technology to an operations team — and judging whether it's actually working * Excellent written communication: your recaps, emails and tickets are short, specific and impossible to misread * Excellent verbal communication: you can run a call with an agency owner, simplify a technical concept for a non\-technical customer, and hold a firm position politely * Maturity and sound judgment: you own mistakes, deliver bad news early, and flag problems before the customer notices them * Comfort managing many accounts and moving parts at once, with a structured way to prioritize what matters today * A data\-driven approach to spotting risk early, and comfort in spreadsheets and a CRM * Collaborative, empathetic and low\-ego; you like working closely with engineers **Nice to have** ---------------- * Working knowledge of collections: delinquency stages, settlements and payment plans, first\- vs third\-party collections * Familiarity with collections compliance (FDCPA, Reg F, TCPA) or regulated consumer\-finance workflows * Experience with AI agents, conversational AI or contact\-center software * Hands\-on experience with HubSpot, Linear or similar CRM and ticketing tools * Experience at an early\-stage startup **Location and compensation** ----------------------------- * **Location:** San Francisco (hybrid in\-office) * **Base salary:** $120,000–$180,000 depending on experience * **Equity:** meaningful early\-stage equity * **Benefits:** health, dental, vision, 401(k), other perks

jobs.title: Principal Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. ### **What you'll be doing...** We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Embedded Firmware Engineer to architect, drive, and optimize the firmware lifecycle for our next\-generation networking devices. In this senior role, you will tackle our most complex technical challenges across Wi\-Fi routers, gateways, and access points. From writing robust C/C\+\+ code to leading deep packet analysis and system triage, you will set the technical standard for the team. If you are a seasoned expert in embedded Linux environments and wireless networking protocols, we want you to help shape our core technology. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following: * Firmware Architecture \& Development: Architect, develop, and optimize high\-performance firmware applications using C and modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11/14\) in embedded Linux environments. * Advanced Network \& Packet Analysis: Lead deep packet inspection and network traffic analysis using Wireshark, tcpdump, and wireless sniffers to resolve the most difficult connectivity dropouts, protocol anomalies, and latency issues. * System Triage \& Complex Debugging: Drive the diagnosis of critical system issues via shell terminals (SSH, serial). Extract and analyze log bundles, investigate complex kernel/application\-layer crashes, and isolate root causes that evade standard debugging. * Wireless \& Gateway Validation: Oversee the rigorous validation of end\-to\-end Wi\-Fi performance across all bands (2\.4GHz / 5GHz / 6GHz). Ensure bulletproof stability for band/AP steering, mesh networking, and core router features (DHCP, NAT, Firewall, QoS, and Parental Controls). * Defect Resolution \& Reporting: Set the standard for engineering documentation. Produce highly detailed bug reports with reproducible steps, system state observations, log files, and packet captures (.pcap) to accelerate cross\-functional resolution. * Test Automation \& Tooling: Design and maintain robust Python and shell scripting frameworks to automate complex test cases, streamline log collection, and execute large\-scale soak testing routines. ### **What we're looking for...** You'll need to have: * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time. Even better if you have one or more of the following: * Experience: Hands\-on firmware or software development experience in networking and embedded systems, with deep, specialized expertise in Wi\-Fi routers, gateways, or access points. * Programming: Master\-level expertise writing production\-quality code in C and C\+\+ (C\+\+11/14\). * Linux Proficiency: Deep command of Linux/Unix terminal environments, including advanced core commands, standard debugging tools, shell scripting, and system/memory process monitoring. * Network Traffic Analysis: Extensive, authoritative experience capturing and analyzing core network protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, DHCP, ARP, ICMP) using industry\-standard tools. * Wi\-Fi Domain Expertise: Comprehensive understanding of IEEE 802\.11 standards (a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be), wireless security protocols (WPA2/WPA3\), WPS, and the physical/MAC layer mechanisms behind common RF performance bottlenecks. * Experience architecting, configuring, and deploying applications using Docker and containerized embedded development environments. * Strong working knowledge of open\-source router operating systems (OpenWrt, prplOS, RDK\-B) or proprietary vendor\-specific router SDKs (e.g., Qualcomm, Broadcom, MediaTek). * Hands\-on experience designing hardware test environments, including RF sniffers, chambers, and network traffic generators (e.g., Spirent, Ixia, or iPerf). ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are…** Verra Mobility is a global leader in smart mobility. Verra Mobility Commercial Services creates smart roadways, serving the world's largest commercial fleets and rental car companies to manage tolling transactions and violations for more than 8\.5 million vehicles. Verra Mobility is a leading provider of connected systems, processing nearly 165 million transactions each year through connectivity with more than 50 individual tolling authorities and more than 400 issuing authorities. Arizona\-based Verra Mobility Corp. currently operates in 15 countries and in 22 languages. The company is constantly looking toward the future, ensuring it creates relevant solutions today that will work tomorrow. Seeking to understand new customers, regions, and businesses that will shape tomorrow's smart mobility experiences, Verra Mobility strives to ensure more people around the world reach their destination safely and easily. Keeping its core principles front and center, Verra Mobility is fueled by relationships, driven by impact, guided by what's right, and energized by what's next. **Culture** Verra Mobility Corporation is a rapidly growing, entrepreneurial company that operates with a people\-first philosophy and approach. The company lives by its core values—Do What's Right, Lead with Grace, Win Together, and Own It—in everything it does for its customers and team members. The company seeks to grow aggressively, both organically and through acquisition, to continue to be the undisputed market leader with these five core competencies: bias for action, customer focus, teamwork, drive for results, and commitment to excellence. **Position Overview:** Verra Mobility is seeking an experienced Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to ensure end\-to\-end quality of modern cloud\-based and legacy enterprise applications through a combination of test design, manual testing, exploratory testing, and automated testing. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience with Playwright, Selenium, TypeScript, C\#, API testing, microservices testing, and micro frontends testing. This role requires the ability to analyze requirements, design comprehensive test scenarios and test cases, determine what should be automated versus manually tested, execute hands\-on testing when appropriate, leverage AI\-assisted testing/code\-generation tools, and mentor other testers. **Essential Responsibilities:** * Analyze business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, technical designs, and system integrations to identify test scenarios, risks, dependencies, and coverage needs. * Create and maintain comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, test data, traceability, and regression test suites covering positive, negative, boundary, exception, integration, and end\-to\-end business scenarios. * Perform hands\-on functional, exploratory, integration, regression, end\-to\-end, and production\-validation testing where manual testing provides appropriate value. * Partner with Product Managers, Tech Leads, Developers, Architects, and QA team members early in the SDLC to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, architecture, integrations, risks, and testability. * Determine the appropriate testing approach for each capability, including what should be engineering and test data. * Select and integrate data analytics and BI tooling, and enable self\-service analytics for engineering teams rather than one\-off reporting. * Design pipelines and data partnership with the Platform/DevOps Engineer. * Engineer for latency, inference cost, and cloud spend as first\-class design constraints. * Build on Engineering Cloud and AI CoE platform foundations rather than constructing parallel stacks. **Full Stack Development \& User Experience** * Build applications end\-to\-end: backend services, orchestration logic, APIs, data access, and the delivery across Slack, Teams, IDE, BI, and web surfaces, and ship working pilot interfaces without waiting on a front\-end team. * Define the interaction patterns that ITES\-US Engineering \& Web Apps productionizes for scaled deployment. **Delivery \& Enablement** * Partner directly with Product Development engineers to identify, scope, and co\-develop solutions; work on\-site alongside engineering teams on a regular cadence. * Translate Product Development leadership priorities into a sequenced solution roadmap with measurable outcomes. * Run skill\-transfer sessio o an inclusive jobs.description: At Wavelynx, we design and manufacture open\-architecture physical access control hardware and software solutions. Our reader and controller technologies bridge the gap between traditional smart credentials, mobile credentials (Apple Wallet, Employee Badges), and secure cloud\-managed networks. We empower physical security systems to be flexible, interoperable, and future\-proof. Position Overview We are seeking a **Senior Firmware Engineer** to develop and optimize current embedded products along with our next\-generation of access control products. In this role, you will work closely with hardware, software, and systems engineering teams to design resilient firmware handling NFC/RFID communications, secure element integrations, cryptographic protocols, and network communications (OSDP, Ethernet, IP\-based access control). Supervisory Responsibilities None Duties/Responsibilities * Architect, implement, and maintain bare\-metal and RTOS\-based firmware for smart card readers and controllers. * Optimize high\-frequency (13\.56 MHz) RFID/NFC field processing, ISO/IEC 14443, ISO/IEC 18092, and MIFARE/DESFire protocols. * Integrate and secure mobile credentials, including Apple Wallet and Google Wallet credentials, using Secure Elements (SE) and Secure Application Modules (SAM). * Implement secure physical and logical communication protocols between readers, controllers, and cloud environments (e.g., **OSDP**, **TLS/TCP/IP**, **RS\-485**, **BLE**, **Ethernet**). * Develop robust firmware update mechanisms (OTA / FOTA) over network protocols while ensuring tamper resistance and zero downtime. * Troubleshoot complex networking issues across local serial buses, IP networks, and RF interfaces. * Collaborate with hardware engineers during schematic review, board bring\-up, signal integrity testing, and power management optimization. * Drive automated firmware testing, unit testing, and CI/CD pipelines for hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) environments. * Lead root\-cause analysis for field escalation issues related to RF performance, timing dependencies, or protocol compliance. Required Skills/Abilities * 5\+ years of professional embedded software development experience using **C and C\+\+**. * Strong background with real\-time operating systems (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar) and ARM Cortex\-M microcontrollers. * Experience with logic analyzers and oscilloscopes. * Be willing to travel domestically and internationally ranging from 0 to 10 days per year. Nice to Haves * Direct background in the **Physical Access Control System (PACS)** industry. * Hands\-on experience with NFC chipsets (e.g., ST25R\-series similar), ISO 14443 Type A/B, Felica, or ISO 15693 standards. * Proven expertise with industrial or secure communication protocols (OSDP, RS\-485, TCP/IP, UDP, TLS/DTLS, MQTT, or BLE stack development). * Deep knowledge of symmetric/asymmetric encryption (AES, ECC, RSA), PKI, secure boot, and hardware root\-of\-trust implementations. * Experience with static code analysis and RF test equipment (e.g., Proxmark, network analyzers). * Exposure to compliance and certification standards (UL 294, FCC, CE, ISO/IEC standards). Salary Benefits Salary: $120\-150k Benefits include great rates on company\-sponsored medical, dental, and vision with HSA\-eligible plans available, generous retirement with up to 6% 401k match, and holidays, vacation, and sick leave.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer (Governance, Risk, Compliance & Control)
jobs.description: **About this role:** Wells Fargo is seeking a Principal Engineer (Governance, Risk, Compliance \& Control) to join the Enterprise Functions Technology Organization. The Enterprise Functions Technology (EFT) group provides technology solutions and support for Risk, Audit, Finance, Marketing, Human Resources, Corporate Properties, and Stakeholder Relations business lines. In addition, EFT provides unique technology solutions and innovation for Wells Fargo Technology, Enterprise Shared Services, and Enterprise Data Management. This combined portfolio of applications and tools are purpose built to meet the challenges of stability, security, scalability, and speed. This role is a deeply hands‑on senior engineering position focused on building, fixing, and evolving large‑scale systems that support risk management. The individual is expected to work directly in the codebase, prototype solutions, troubleshoot complex issues alongside engineers, and step in to resolve problems when they arise. Rather than operating at a purely theoretical level, this role emphasizes practical execution—applying the right technology to the problem and delivering working solutions. While remaining hands‑on, the role also influences technical direction by guiding solution design, driving key engineering decisions, and promoting reusable patterns and best practices across the organization. The role partners closely with engineers, providing coaching through real\-world problem solving. Core technologies include Java and React, with minimal .NET, and growing use of modern AI tooling such as agent development, model integration, and prompt engineering, with openness to continued learning and AI certifications. **In this role, you will:** * Act as an advisor to leadership to develop or influence applications, network, information security, database, operating systems, or web technologies for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups * Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in\-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering solutions that are long\-term, large\-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking * Translate advanced technology experience, an in\-depth knowledge of the organizations tactical and strategic business objectives, the enterprise technological environment, the organization structure, and strategic technological opportunities and requirements into technical engineering solutions * Provide vision, direction and expertise to leadership on implementing innovative and significant business solutions * Maintain knowledge of industry best practices and new technologies and recommends innovations that enhance operations or provide a competitive advantage to the organization * Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as an expert advisor to leadership **Required Qualifications:** * 7\+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education * 7\+ years architecting, designing and leading the delivery of large\-scale solutions * 4\+ years of Financial Services industry * 4\+ years experience presenting technology strategy and concepts to C\-level executives and large audiences * 2\+ years experience delivering cloud ready and cloud native solutions * 2\+ years experience with Java full stack development **Desired Qualifications:** * 2\+ years experience AI utilization and agentic development * Preferred experience with Google Cloud Compute (GCP) or Microsoft Azure * Experience with the Wells Fargo Risk Technology ecosystem * Experience with Wells Fargo application delivery and application management processes and standards * Experience mentoring others and leading informally in matrixed organizational structures * Current ability and desire to continue developing solutions personally, "hands on keyboard", for the hardest problems facing the product **Job Expectations:** * This position offers a hybrid work schedule. * Relocation assistance is not available for this position **Pay Range**
